One exception... we called them 'Skillet Cookies' because we made them in an iron skillet. They are a favorite 'Christmas Cookie' in our family. Thanx, Irishbaker :)

Delicious!  The meat is tender, and the chili has a nice flavor.  DH and I enjoyed it with flour tortillas.  I cut back slightly on the garlic and onions, but other than that followed the recipe.  With DH manning the grill, the prep went quickly, and didn't take too long to make.  Definitely a winner.  Next time, I'll use it to impress guests!

This is an excellent recipe.  My Mother made it all the time when I was growing up.  Recipe #7062 is the frosting that my Mom always used.  Maybe next time I will try the one given with the cake recipe.  My grandchildren like the cake very much and want it again soon.
This is an excellent recipe and my grandchildren say these cookies are awesome.  Will definitely fix them again.

Carb-lover's heaven.  I ate 'til it hurt. Made this with whole wheat couscous and black beans. Only thing I thought it was missing is a little salt. Next time I'll be sure to have some fat free sour cream and fresh cilantro on hand.  Incredibly quick and easy to make.  Great creation, Very Gray Bear.
Used at my brother's wedding...got rave reviews!!

I was looking for cookie recipes that had basic ingredients I already had around the house for a party, especially ones we could ice as part of the activities and this fit the bill!  The cookies were really delicious.  They were soft and buttery right after they came out (couldn't help but nibble a bit!) and became crisp and the vanilla flavor really became apparent as they cooled.  It was also nice that it didn't take much time with no need for chilling!
I love it!  No worrying about "soft ball" stage.  Easy, tastes like my favorite Hershey's bar. Kudos!
Sorry Bergy, I usually like your recipes, but I did not see the point in this one.  Fresh grapes are so nice with a soft cheese like Brie etc. that it was a pity to ruin a good bunch of grapes.

This was a good basic casserole.   I made it exactly as was written, and found I needed to add a bit of water near the end of cooking because some of the rice wasn't cooked and it was a bit dry.  Otherwise, a nice recipe!

This is excellent! I had a little problem when I added the egg mixture to the milk, it thickened very quickly, almost as soon as it boiled, but I added a little extra juice to thin it out .. everyone loved the mousse and I will make it again soon! Thanks!

Tasty dip and quick to throw together.  I had all these ingredients on hand and decided to whip it up for a snack for the family.  For dipping, the texture was best immediately after being prepared; once it was refrigerated for overnight, it became extremely thick and more like a spread than a dip.  I think next time I may also add a bit more ham.  We ate this with those new Ritz cracker dipping sticks; I would definitly make this again.  Thanks for posting!

Breads have never been my strong suit, but I was downright proud to serve these biscuits!  I made a royal mess; but it was obvious that, with a little practice, they'll be a snap to make.  Thank you, MarieAlice, for sharing this treasure of a recipe!

Delicious!!  And very easy to make.  This was my first stew and it came out beautifully.  Spicy, hearty...soooo good.  I used 1.5 cups water and 2 cups beef broth instead of the 3 cups water called for.  Next time I will also add sliced mushrooms.  I highly recommend this recipe - especially on a cold day.
Thought these were outstanding! Was a little nervous about the cayenne, but boy, it really makes it! Can't wait to take these to our family Christmas party. Thanks a bunch!

Just the best all around..  Taste, texture... Very easy and delicious. Held up well to cookie cutters. This is the only recipe I'll ever use again. Seven minutes tops in my oven. Scraps are easily rolled out, too.
These are a fantastic cookie---I ground the walnuts in my food processor and then threw everything else in and pulsed until crumbly!  Pretty to look at and even better to eat.

Fool-proof as well as delicious! I made a double batch and took half to a school party (where people of various nationalities were in attendance, none of which had ever eaten fudge before). It went down a treat, and I was asked for the recipe by several people. Also,it doesn't melt even after several hours of standing at room temperature.  A keeper-- thanks for posting !

Hmm....I thought I'd reviewed this a while ago. Oh well, I'll do it now. This was a great way for me to share a taste memory with my kids who have never had a real slider. I didn't have the little tiny buns, so we just used regular hamburg buns (GIANT SLIDERS! RUN FOR YOUR LIVES!!) Very easy prep. I also subbed dehydrated onions for fresh, since that was all I had - I rehydrated them and simmered them a few minutes with the meat before adding the rest. Great recipe.

These nuts are really great!  I have to admit that I was a little afraid of the cayenne pepper so only used 1/4 tsp.  They were not spicy at all though so next time I will use the full amount.  I also used all pecans because that's what I had in, but I'm sure it would be even better with the combo of nuts.  Thanks for a great recipe.  I posted a picture too.

Dancer!!!!
Thanks again, another winner here.. so good! My kids didnt know they were drinking soy milk.  Again keep on putting up your great recipes..
Excellent cookies!  I loved the slight cinnamon taste.  Yummy yummy!!!
Excellent!  We had this at our Christmas party.  Everyone thought it was so tasty.  Will make this again and again.  Thanks for posting.

Be CAREFUL - these cookies are SO addictive!  Once I remove the marshmallow mixture from heat, I like to add almost a whole teaspoon of green food coloring for extra darkness, and a teaspoon of vanilla extract for a fanTAStic flavor.  When dropping the cookies onto waxed paper, I am sure to lightly butter my fingers to protect from heat and help things not stick to my hands so much.  I also sprinkle the cookies lightly with red sugar rather than red hots.  Mmm Mmm Yummy!
These make a great rib didn't use liquid smoke, still tastes great. Used Bullseye BBQ sauce thanks for recipe

I remember looking forward to these as a kid at Christmas. Just a simple little snack but very pretty, fun and messy to make with the kids. I hadn't had these in years until we enjoyed some with hot cocoa this week. Thanks, GinnyP for posting this fun recipe!
Super easy pie crust. I was able to get crusts for a double crust pie out of the dough. Thanks for sharing!
I made this for the holidays and my brother had to have the recipe. He could not believe it when I told him the few ingredients. I didn't have much left over, which was the sad part. Thanks Darlene!
These were the only things left on my party buffet.  I guess noone liked the blue cheese.
I made these for my cookie tray to add color.  They were difficult to get out of the pan and into any kind of shape so I renamed them Grinch poops.  My BIL ate almost all of them, they were tastey.

Made this up tonight ot go with our turkey salad, the last of the bird, It is excellant with lots of taste, I used regular tomatoes, 4 of them, because that is what I had, they worked very well. Loved the garlic and oregano, they go well together. We will be making this again and again,it will be great with many dishes,  thanks for sharing a good one!

Fabulous! I used half the amount of chipotles in the sauce but otherwise made as directed and baked in the oven. When hot, the havarti melts and combines with the chipotle sauce, set off by the saltiness of the turkey and crisp bacon. Amazingly good especially when dipped in extra sauce. I also made the recipe into quesadillas for the kids as they were easier for them to handle, VERY light on the chipotle sauce. Everyone loved them. Would be really good served as an appetizer this way, sauce on the side. Thanks, Mean!

I have to admit, I was pretty disappointed in this recipe. I had a delicious Chai at Borders Cafe yesterday, which the girl said was made by adding hot water to a mix made with non-dairy creamer. I quickly looked for similar sounding recipes and decided to try this one, but I thought it came out very blah, even when I added a bunch of extra mix to my mug. Not at all like the creamy stuff at Borders. I guess I'll have to keep trying!

I cannot believe I forgot to review this after making it a couple months ago!  Shame...
This is simply delicious and quite easy too.  Not only good for the healthy, it should be excellent for someone with a cold or flu - hey, chicken soup and spice!  Try this!

This is an excellent recipe.  The only sausage I had was Italian  sausage, and mixed it with leftover honey glazed ham I ground up in the food processor. The flavor was excellent! This definitely goes on the 'make again' list.
Thank you, DiAnna2!

I made these for New Year's Eve and they are amazingly good. (DH says I must use the word AWESOME!) I've never made ribs before and was surprised by how easy this is. I'm glad another reviewer mentioned that they don't look good while in the pot, because I was a little worried for a minute. I used 3 1/2 pounds of babyback ribs, simmered for a little over an hour and baked about 45 minutes. They were so tender and the flavor was outstanding. The meat tasted great even in spots that had no sauce. A VERY good recipe!

This is an excellent cocktail sauce recipe.  I used 8 tablespoons of chili sauce along with the other ingredients.  It had the perfect tangy "bite" that I love in seafood sauce.  I didn't actually make shrimp cocktails but served this as a dipping sauce with Garlic Shrimp #29828.  This one is a keeper!  Thanks Stella Mae.

Being from VA, I've cooked many a ham but this recipe by far is the best.  I added pineapple slices on mine and then cut up a little bit and put in the glaze.  The juice from this made the most awesome sauce - I couldn't believe how good it was. This is what I'll use from now on..thanx!

Made this for a New Years day dinner that I hosted earlier this evening. After all of the rave reviews I was expecting a fantastic cake. The cake itself came out really well and smelled divine and rised well. The icing however became really crusty and I did not have enough to ice my 9x13 cake. Maybe it was something that I did wrong. The cake was excellent and super easy to make. I ended up just icing it with half butter cream and half of the caramel icing. Will probably make the cake again but with another frosting. People did enjoy the cake.
Made a batch of this and used it to bake a cake and a beer bread. It worked very well as both rose beautifully!

Dark, rich-looking, and tasty; this is real French Bistro cooking! We enjoyed it with  a simple salad and will certainly have it again. (... but we love that tarragon ... and garlic!)  Leek-less, I tossed in some cold, fridge-living mushrooms that had been previously sauteed in Balsamic Vinegar, but that - and adding a crusty roll to sop up the gravy - was my only addition/change.
Thank you.
Well I made this cake , but I found it to be some what dry , but all in all it was ok. If I was to make this cake again , I might try putting the topping on bottom of the pan and then bakeing it .

Great recipe! I couldn't find veal so I used the same amount of lamb instead--which was sharp smelling when raw but once cooked it blended well. I had lots of meat left over however which was so tasty I'm sure I could use it for a stuffed pepper recipe. I wonder if you don't need 2 cabbages or if I just didn't boil it long enough to get the right amount of leaves. At any rate, my husband and I loooved it and I didn't halve it so we'll love it again and again ;) ...and again, great recipe.
While the cake was very tasty, The middle sunk in when I checked with a toothpick to see if it was done.

Made these for New Years using the large Sea Scallops.Another couple was over for dinner and we all thought this was on of the best scallop prperations we had ever had. I did leave the Bacon out as my husband thinks its an ingredient that is way over used. Perfect blend of ingredients that complimented the sweet flavor of the scallops and their delicate texture . I may put the bacon in next time I make these to see if there is much of a differance in flavor. These will definately be made again

These were excellent, I did drain the beans before I added the parmesan cheese.  I also used lean ham instead of bacon....worked perfectly, my diet doesnt allow bacon.  THanks for a wonderful veggie side!

Didnt seem to have the authentic taste I was looking for and I should have cut down on the vingar. It made a nice tasting dipping sauce simlar to sweet n sour sauce. Took A LONG TIME to put it all together :-/

These turned out wonderfull.A great addition to my X-mas baskets.The kids loved them and helping make them.I was thinking that using different colors for easter and try to make them look like easter eggs. And pumpkins for holloween. I think there are alot of ways you can use this recipe.
Lots of fun to come with this one..
Thanks GinnyP.

This is a great recipe.  My kids say I should open a pizza shop with this one.  A few changes, though. I used garlic flavored salt and only devide the dough in half, that makes for a thicker crust.  Also worked well in a jelly roll sized pan.

I loved these.  We make these every christmas, but I'm always scrambling to find the recipe.  I can never seem to make the wreaths, but we end up with something like mistletoe leaves.  I added a touch of vanilla and a touch of almond and it was just wonderful.  Yummy!!

I've never made eggplant before.  I usually find it tastes bitter when I eat it out, but I tried this recipe and liked it.  My husband didn't like the parts with skin on it so I'll probably make it again with the skin removed.  I wasn't sure how to cut the eggplant - strips or slabs or what? - so I did some of each.  The slabs seemed easiest and just as good as smaller fries or strips.

H?i there,Boy was this some good bread!!!! It was very light,but good and moist and very delicious.I used this recipe to make my Christmas bread,and will use it again next year,as it was wonderful.Thanx,Darlene

This is the first time that I had ever fixed ribs.  They were wonderful.  I fixed 7 huge ribs (4 lbs). I used almost an entire 2 liter of Dr. Pepper. I did add some course ground black pepper and a very light addition of salt before baking-but that was the only change.  Great!
I didn't have any honey so I substitued maple syrup and it was delicious, it's a nice sweet dish in the end.

Just wanted you to know that these nuts were the best.  I have given this recipe to numerous people.  They all loved it.   I did decrease the cayenne pepper to 1/4 tsp. and added a little bit more of the nuts than was called for.   LindaJim

My husband and I love this dish!  I used the sliced tomatos in a can which also had chillies in it so it added
a little bit of spice to it.
I didn't have allspice but I had an oriental five-spice which has apparently the same ingredients as allspice plus two others (clove, cinnamin, nutmug, anise, ginger).
Also, for the size cabbage I got, I could have made two stuff cabbages with the same stuffing amount.  My husband 
said he wish there were more.
We ended up eating just the stuffing the first night and the stuffed cabbage part the next night.
Thinking this could also be a cassarole of sorts by adding cheese and cutting up the entire cabbage.  My husband called this a great poor man's dinner.  Thank you for the submission.

I was surprised to find that something this beautiful came from MY oven!  My biscuits are usually hit-and-miss, but these were the best I have ever made.  My husband was impressed also!  I halved the recipe and left mine at about an inch thick....I did find that I had to add flour because the dough was so sticky.  That may be because I halved it.  But it did not seem to hurt the overall result...perfect!  I served them with homemade chicken tenders and red beans and rice (I was craving Popeye's).  Thanks so much for this wonderful recipe that will be my biscuit recipe from now on.

I made these today and they are a big hit! I used oat bran instead of wheat bran and I used up 1/2 unsweetened applesauce and 1c.whole cranberry sauce from the holidays and they turned out moist and delicious! Will definitely make these again!
We love this soup and it's so easy to make.  I've made it before from an old cookbook but couldn't find which book it came from.  I was glad to see the recipe posted.
Made these over the holidays & will definitely be making them again.  A fun, quick recipe & they disappeared in a flash! Thanks for posting it Bekah!

Karyl, I loved this!  I've made something similar in the past, but I tried your recipe for dinner tonight, and it was so much better than the concoction I'd made previously.  Such depth of flavor--the combination of herbs and spices was spot on.

BTW, I followed you over here from the SBD board where you know me as JLo's Bridesmaid (Lucy).  You have such wonderful recipes.  :)

One of my favorite childhood cakes!  I've always known it as Westhaven Cake.  Don't know where that name came from (probably from my mom so she could hide the fact that dates are in it!!!).  
The only difference from my recipe is I use a cup of butter instead of oil.  Plus I always put the baking soda with the dates and pour hot water on top of both.  (I just use hot water straight out of the tap - no boiling).  I never added sugar to the topping until recently.  Good both ways...
So much fun and so tasty.  I doubled the recipe and we still fought over them!!  I topped them with chopped lettuce and tomato. Mmmmmmm Good!!  Would be awesome for a party finger food.

Quick as a wink to make, and gone just as fast!  I've never had pho before, so I can't judge on that, but this is goooooood!  I didn't have the green onions on hand (they're rather pitiful and pricey in the dead of winter), so we just added a bit of shallot with the garlic and ginger.  I used more than 1 ounce noodles- my package says it is 16 ounces and I used half (so that would be 8 oz) and ended up with only a little leftover.  Just based on my noodles, I would say that that seems like a very small quanity of noodles...  Anyhow, followed the rest of the recipe- I used homemade broth, 1 breast and a little more pepper flakes than called for.  My broth was unsalted and I found this plenty salty from the addition of the fish sauce, so be careful!  I didn't have any sriracha or chile paste, but since I added a little extra pepper flakes, we found this plenty spicey.  We did add a dash of organic shoyu to our bowls, though.  We also added a couple sliced mushrooms, which were really yummy.  I think this would really be great if you added other veggies too- straw mushrooms, baby corn and bamboo shoots immediately came to mind.  The flavor was great, and I think the garnish really adds a lot.  I wish I'd had the green onion, but this was so easy and tasty that I'm sure I'll make it again!  Thanks Sue, for another winner.  I highly recommend this to anyone and everyone!  A real keeper.  :)
people that like the watergate salad will probably like this her iranian rice recipe is differnt than mine but looked good also will be trying

very easy, and very tasty. I sprinkled it around my plates when I was serving rice.Many comments!
Very nice touch to any dish
Simple and delicious.  I used fat free sour cream and it worked very well in this recipe.  The mustard-dill sauce kept the salmon very moist and flavorful.  Thank you for the recipe Nurse Di.
This tastes similar to other soups I've tried. Not bad, but not outstanding. A good basic recipe. Next time I'll probably up the vinegar and the spices.

Abolutely delicious and very easy to make. I substituted ground chicken as I had it on hand, made it the day before to let the flavours blend, and then gently warmed it before serving over the salad greens. Great for lunch or dinner and very filling. Both my husband and son are still raving about it!

This is yummy.  It is easy to make and very moist.  It has a slight lemon flavor which goes good with the coconut topping.  Wonder if this can be made with other canned fruits, i.e. diced peaches?  This is a keeper.  Thanks for sharing.
I have tried the tandoori chicken and I love it. I will be making it again sometime.

I've made this probably 4 or five times now, it's a pertty good recipe!  I prefer it a little more savory, so I do not add the brown sugar, I add an extra 2 cloves of garlic and a few more tablespoons of worcestershire sauce.
This is a family favorite.

Very tasty. And reheated well in the microwave.  The garlic flavor was very mild.  Next time, I think I'll increase to 5 cloves of garlic.  Also recommend heating the sour cream before adding to the potatoes, to avoid cooling the potatoes too much.

I made this to take to my sister's house and it got devoured!! I had doubled the recipe, too! I mostly picked this recipe in particular, because of the "technique" of browning the rice. My mom used to do that, too, and I had totally forgotten about doing that! It really does make a huge difference! This is my new "stand-by" rice recipe! Thanks so much!

The benefits of this recipe; It  is very moist and rises nicely without falling. I too like a little more of a chocolate flavor. I had trouble with the frosting so I had to tweak it a little, but it came out ok. I made it in the 9 x 13 pan, but I will try it again, layered and with a luscious chocolate cream frosting and it may prove to be my favorite cake. Thanks for sharing!

This soup came out very tastey. My husband couldn't get enough of it. I think he ate 3-4 bowls. 
I personally would like a little herbs. I added extra potatoes and about a cup of frozen peas, which added more color. Very good, very easy recipe. Thank you!!!

The soup was good, but the canned stock ruined it for me.

Perhaps if I could get a better stock I would try again, but I do prefer to make my own, even made in advance and frozen.

What can I say?  This is one of the best recipes I have made from Zaar.  I loved the sophisticated flavors and textures. They are going to be the main attraction for my Super Bowl party! Thanks, Mean.

I loved these bars.  I didn't have jam on hand, so I used a can of Solo cherry filling.  I also used ground almonds because I don't like walnuts.

I will make these often.  Thank you!
Very easy and very good.  I think you could substitute chicken or other fish in this same sauce and get great results as well.  Thanks for a great quick and easy recipe!

This was honestly the best thing I have ever eaten!
The amazing mix of flavors from the orange, shallots, mint, and pepper mix with the smokey taste of the meat...its the best combo...If I could choose 1 dish and eat it every day for the rest of my life this would be it no exageration.

I made this on the stove top,instead of the crockpot.The meat was tender in a hour,but continued to cook for another 1/2 hour,until the other side dishes were finished.I served with mashed potatoes,but I think it would be good with pasta too.
Will make again :0)

Outstanding!  This is just terrific and is now my favorite way to eat eggplant.  Crispy, cheesey outside, creamy, onion-flavored inside.  Not in a million years would I guess how healthy this is.  Wow.

As a Brit this was my first attempt at a real, homemade cookie (as opposed to a biscuit..our version of cookies) and I couldn't be more pleased with the result. Quick and easy to make and the end product was  beautifully buttery! I used white choc chips this time but can't wait to experiment with other fillings.I followed other reviewers'advice and flattened the balls and the mixture made about 20 meduim sized cookies.

I loved this soup.  I made a pot, then froze it so I could have an individual serving whenever I wanted.  I love the way the flavours all come together the day after the soup is made.  I will be making this soup again and again.  Thanks!

I just made the same recipe from the BC site but I used chicken breasts.  This was an exceptional meal - the breasts were so tender and juicy!!!!  I like more sauce so next time I will increase some of the ingredients but this is a KEEPER for my house!!

Ewood was right on with his assessment.  This is one excellent receipe that I can honestly say is a keeper.  Fairly easy to prepare as well.  A note to the guys out there...this dish really impresses the ladies.

This recipe was enjoyed by my family. ALOT!  I did use ground turkey instead of ground beef.  I also subbed eggroll wrappers & made 12 large Taco Cups in a regular size muffin pan as that was what I had on hand.  I had to increase the cooking time slightly to compensate for the size increase.  The few leftovers reheated well in the micro the next day.  Thanks Bekah for a recipe I will use again!

Very good flavor,we both enjoyed it. I had exactly 1 pound of boneless skinless chicken breast. It seemed like a lot of sauce for just 1 pound so I halved everything as we were having it with mashed potatoes and spinach. It was plenty of sauce for us. Thanks for posting a tasy recipe. — I used an 8"X8" pan and found that was big enough for the chicken. — I baked for 40 minutes.
Totally Awesome here!!  I used hot sausage with homemade Italian bread.  Doesn't get any better than this!!  Thanks Jennifer

Wow, absolutely as advertised.  BETTER than Hershey's syrup, MUCH better.  After being refrigerated it becomes the thickness of a perfect fudge sauce but dissolves into milk or yogurt easily.  Tastes like liquid brownies.

Sackville Girl was right - I used this on pork that I broiled in the oven and we thought it was fantastic.  I used a heavy hand on the spices and they did form a nice crust.  This one is a definite keeper.  Thanks!
A good healthy soup but I felt something was missing.  I did modify the recipe some by reducing the onion & jal. pepper amounts.  I am hoping tomorrow it will be even better.

Flavorful.  Mine didn't turn out juicy/tender, but I gave a 5 anyway because I may not have done it quite right.  Also, I used olive oil with a touch of chili oil; used cooking sherry; left out bell peppers.
Wow! I made this with special dark chips and it is heaven! Thanks for an easy  way to make such a family favorite!
We enjoyed these muffins.  They have a nice texture and taste, but I will add cinnamon to the batter next time I make them.  I was looking for a stronger cinnamon taste.
These are the same meatpies my sister in law always makes at Christmas.  They are always delicious!  Thanks for posting the recipe so now I can make them too!

This is a great recipe to serve to guests on a buffet bar, providing this tasty sauce and a spicy one for variety.  I baked the wings at 375 for about 30 minutes, since I'm clueless about broiling.  Then I used my blender stick to mix the sauce, adding a pinch of 5 spice powder to jazz up this sweet mixture. This recipe couldn't be easier or more convenient to make.
Have been making potato soup for a long time..tried this recipe, added cooked brocolli and it was very good!My son wanted the recipe cause he said it was the best...lc

This is an easy recipe to prepare.
I used an oven at a high temp instead of frying the bread. This worked well and it only takes a few minutes each. I roll my dough out between 2 sheets of baking paper. Much less mess and you just peel off one sheet and put the other in the oven with the pita.

This is one of the easiest meals I have ever made.  It was one of the cheapest also.  My family loved it, we will use this recipe again and again I am sure.  You were right this and a salad is more than enough for a meal.  Thanks
Awesome!!!  DC LOVED the recipe and it tastes exactly like fried chicken, but without the deep frying...quick recipe when one is short on time!!!
This soup was easy, tasty and quick to make. I loved it. Thank you Mean Chef for another wonderful recipe.
Oh my this was awesome!  I have made banana nut pancakes/waffles but not syrup.  It was gone before I knew it.  Didn't change a thing.  Thanks for posting.

Well, Laurie you made believers out of us!!! These tasted as good, if not better than the real White Castles. I used shredded cheddar cheese instead of velvetta. I couldn't find the pepperidge farm rolls, so I used Martins small potato rolls. DH and I were in our glory eating these.....they brought back alot of good memories. Thanks so much for sharing.

This is a winning sandwich in more ways than one!  First of all, it's flexible.  I didn't have any flank steak so I used a large sirloin that was about 3/4" thick instead.  Followed your directions exactly for marinating and grilling the steak. We used hoagie buns which we toastd on the grill.  After adding the blue cheese on top of the warm steak strips & carmalized onions, it melted nicely inside the toasted bun. Last but not least, this sandwich is full of flavor and mighty tasty.   Thanks Judy!  This one stays on my keeper list.
this is similar to another recipe I reviewed called hugs and kisses.  We love this! Very fancy looking yet so simple and tastes awesome.  Can't believe this has not yet been reviewed! THANK YOU

Delicious! These are perfect when I have a "cheesecake" craving and don't want to buy an entire cheesecake. I accidently used too large of a pan and they came out too thin. They were so good that I made another batch in the right pan.
This was really good...a real "stick to your ribs" kind of meal.  Served with salad and crusty bread.
ver easy-my 6 yr old LOVED these-we decorate with assorted sprinkles before baking!
This is a quick and easy recipe. I am not a catfish lover but I thought this was great. Excellant combination. I will make this again. (Yummy). Thanks for sharing this.

This recipe reminds me of summer, picnics and 4th of July, one of my Nana's favorites.  I haven't thought about it until it became a recipe of the day, its in my cookbook now!
Thanks!

This is awesome! We have made this several times now with a few slight additions. We serve the turkey and black bean mixture over shredded romaine lettuce, diced roma tomatoes, chopped cilantro, chopped green onion and sliced black olives.  Then, we top the turkey/bean mixuture with 2% sharp cheddar cheese and my homemade low fat chipotle ranch dressing. Yummy and better than any restaurant quality full fat taco salad. Thanks Karyl Lee!

I love the combination of Sundried tomatoes and pesto - quick easy recipe.  The raw garlic flavor is great. I cut back the oil to 2 tbsp and added 4 tbsp of fresh chopped Basil. Used lots of Parmesan on top.  Served with Pork cutlets, steamed green beans, sugar snap peas and steamed carrots - Thanks Evie for a lovely dinner
a wonderful way to dress up the plebeian carrot. not only did the glaze taste fabulous but the carrots looked so bright and pretty too. thanks for posting.

This is a great healthy alternative for breakfast. The taste of the cereal completely changes depending on what fruit you use as it flavours the grains. I used brown rice and oats as I had no other grains and they are my favourite and did one with mix dried fruit and another with dried apricots, mangoes, pawpaw, pineapple, peaches. Use any fruit you want I like the tropical flavours best. I also plan to use dried apple or anything else I can find for that matter! Great for the kids too.

This is fast and good.  Used a prepared hummus that contained spinach and artichokes and the olives were a marinated mixture of several types of olives - also, used some chopped beets as noted by submitter and added some chopped red onion since I wasn't going anywhere else that day :). This is so simple to make, takes so little time to make and is SO delicious, that I recommend it to everyone!  I halved the quantity of the ingredients in the recipe, because only my Burmese cat and I were going to be dining at home tonight.  He had just a small cat-size serve, and he ate it with considerable enthusiasm.  He is a cat with let’s say broad culinary tastes: he eats all vegetables and even eats olives!   I omitted the waffle bowls, because I’m not sure what they are, but I’m sure that they would give this dish even more flair in presentation.  Instead, I simply put a scoop of ice cream into a serving bowl and spooned the berry sauce over the top.  I used in total about 500g of mixed berries – strawberries, raspberries and blueberries – and heeded Bri22’s caution about the rum.  It was good to have the reminder about the rum, because it was a while since I’d used rum in cooking.  I also added some orange zest and about 2 teaspoons of orange juice when I combined the rum and the sugar, because I know that orange flavourings blend well with rum.  As a result, I used slightly less rum.  Delicious!  And there’s ample left for Bilbo and me over the next few nights.  I’m sure it will be equally delicious served cold.  Thank you, Bri22, for a fabulous recipe!
I really thought I would like this dip, but it just didn't suit me.  I thought the lemon flavor was way too strong.

I agree with PCrocker: this is a really hearty soup.  I ate it on a NOT so chilly night and it was still delicious!  But I agree: great cold weather food!  I made the recipe unchanged except for halving the salt and adding 4 cloves of garlic and 1 teaspoon of dried thyme.  And because of personal taste preferences, I made two substitutions: I used sodium reduced chicken broth and instead of the Polish sausage I added my Pork, Mushroom and Soy Sauce Meatballs #120300, which I always have some of in the freezer.  This also speeded up the preparation time!  I sautéed the onion and garlic together – about 5 minutes – added the other ingredients, then left the soup to simmer largely unattended for about an hour and a half.  It probably didn’t need that extra half hour.  I just always tend to simmer my soups for a bit longer than the recipe has stated.  Very tasty!  Thank you, PCrocker!

Sorry I couldnt rate it higher.

Excellent recipe. So easy to make and flavorful. 
We did not have any frozen beans and used a drained can of french cut beans it still turned out great. Thanks for the great recipe.

Although I didn't care for the lemon taste, this turned out very good. The chicken was moist and delicious. You really can't go wrong with parmesan cheese! YUM!!
On another note, I did have to cook it a little longer (probably another 20 minutes).

Delicious!  The sauce was great and it went so well with the other herbs.  I added some more garlic to the rub.  I used low-fat sour cream for the sauce. Yummy. Mine wouldn't finish freezing in the ice cream maker so I poured it in a bowl and stuck it in the freezer. Everyone thought it was really good. TYVM
This will go in the "make again" file! Very good. I made the crumbs in the Kitchenaid, which worked and was acceptable but didn't look quite like the photos.
these are absolutely fabulous! i was searching for a recipe that didn't use cake mix, but also required caramels for the sauce. this is definitely a keeper, thanks for posting :)

Mezza-mezza for our tastes.  The corn wasn't nearly done enough, and it was messy to put butter on before grilling.  I would recommend soaking the corn, grilling, then using the butter mixture at the table instead.  I just don't think I'd make it this way again, sorry.

Love, love, LOVE this recipe!! My whole family has been eating pho at a restaurant for years! Not anymore!! We were all impressed at how quick, easy, and wonderful this recipe is! I made without chicken and it was still great. I heartily recommend adding sriracha chile sauce + hoisin sauce for the full pho experience. Delicious!!

Awesome.  The fact that it's so easy to make is just icing on the cake.  I got carried away with putting toppings on the 6" tortillas (smaller than recommended) and couldn't roll them up, so I topped it off with another tortilla, more or less making a quesadilla and enjoyed the "sandwich" that way. Worked beautifully.  Next time I'll know that I can add more heat to the sauce because the roll tempers the chile. No way could I deal with a whole can of chipotles. Recommend you add a chile at a time if you have any reservations.
Great recipe, even my husband who isn't fond of leeks, ate a lot of it. Really simple! Thanks fo a great recipe I will certainly use again!

To die for!  Next time I need to double the recipe  :)  Okay, I baked into 2 loaf pans so that I could slice and freeze.(reduced cooking time) Layered about 1/4 c of blackberry preserves on the hot crust before adding the cheese mixture.  OMG!  These are awesome.  Thank you for a great recipe!!

We enjoyed this very much and will be making it again, sure makes a lot!! and it has a very nice kick. I was out of fresh mushrooms so used a can of sliced, they worked just fine, everything else just as in your recipe, ground chicken etc., except I served it over brown basmati rice cooked in beef broth. Thanks for sharing a good one!

For my summer vacation I spent 2 nights with each of my 3 married children and cooked or them.  I chose this one for my very picky SIL.  I was excited when he had seconds!  The meat was fork-tender and we served the gravy over mashed potatoes.  The only addition I made was quite a bit of salt.  Quick to prepare and delicious.

This was very easy to prepare.  I planned to serve this as a spread on crackers as part of a snack tray.  I found the texture of this salad a little odd for my tastes. (I think it was the garbanzo beans).  I did add the suggested Tabasco to spice it up a little.  I also added dried parsley flakes to perk it up visually.

I liked the combination of flavors but was not sure of the smooth consistency. I cut up the tomato, onion and pepper, put everything into a blender, and pulsed. Left the lots of small pieces in mix. Lined a half pita with 
bibb lettuce and this filling. Very tasty but could use some spicing up for my taste.

The flavor of this was not particularly appealing to me. I ate it for lunch two days in a row. I did like it better the second day, chilled, and with lettuce between two pieces of nutty wheat toast - but I suspect I was somewhat covering up the flavor.
I made the salad exactly as directed. This made for a very pleasant tasting and healthy lunch.

I thought this was just ok, not great.  I did have to add salt and pepper and lemon juice to mine to give it some taste.  I thought it was a waste of feta cheese as the flavor of the cheese isn't noticeable.  I also would add to this recipe to chill it for the flavors to mix together.  Sorry but it was just average.
This got raves from 3 people who had this as a dip with butter crackers.  Thanks for posting this! :)

While on a mini camping trip, I made this for our friends.  While I do not like rhubarb, hubby and our friends went wild.  They said it is definitely worth 5 stars and asked that I make it again.  Thanks for sharing, Gerry999.
We had this at RedWonder's BBQ and it was wonderful! Not too sweet and the frosting was a flavorful addition.
Wonderful recipe!!!I made a bowl and broiled chicken breast, topped it with the tomatoes and melted Provolone cheese on top.  What a meal.  Thanks for the recipe!

I loved the photo by Derf and hurried out to get my ingredients. I used the smaller portion of salsa and added fresh minced basil, which enhanced the flavor on the order of Thai. Roxygirl
This is great! My boss made it and sprinkled in chopped pecans! I love it! Thanks!

I was at the same party as Nic and gosh, this tea was great! I was probably responsible for cleaning every last drop out of that jug before she went back for seconds, ha ha! It wasn't overly sweet, just cold and refreshing.

Yummm.  I used fat-free sour cream and an extra 1/2 teaspoon of zest (love tart flavors).  Served this on top of a fruit salad made with cantaloupe, strawberries and blueberries.  The lemon complemented the fruit beautifully and the sour cream and puddy give this a creaminess that makes you forget you're eating light. Thanks KC!

Fantastic flavor!!  I left the skin on my chicken breasts and it turned out so crunchy and good, I would recommend it.  Marinated overnight, might even do it two days next time.  Wonderful!!  Thanks!!

I made this almost exactly as posted, except I used 1 tsp Thai red curry paste because I did not have the Szechwan chili pepper paste.  I also added a med. zucchini.  It turned out great!  I don't know how people are getting away with less oil.  I needed the entire 1/4 cup, maybe more.  Eggplant just sucks it up.  Besides, it was not at all greasy this way.  Make sure to cook the eggplant til soft (either in the 1st or second phase of its cooking).  Next time I will be a bit more generous with the sauce.  I think this will be my stirfry of choice for some time to come.  DELICIOUS!

These were a great addition to Sunday dinner.  As Wildrose suggested, I increased the garlic cloves to 5 medium and used yogurt instead of the sour cream.  The yogurt added a delightful twang.  I also added some chives to the dish.  Thanks.

I found this recipe (with the same odd name!) somewhere else too, a while back, and it immediately became one of my favorite soups.  Unique, delicious, spicy flavor.  Cooked turkey works fine too for the meat.  Hope you enjoy!

Used this to frost Blackberry Jam Cupcakes the other day -- my family loved this! I think what we liked most about this frosting is that it reminded us of penuche fudge. We didn't like this very much. The garlic taste was too sharp. I'm wondering if maybe I didn't put enough cucumber in it. It looked lovely, but didn't taste right. I also substituted chives because I didn't have scallions, so that may have affected the taste.

I liked this a lot and will certainly make it again!! Had it as a main dish for two, with just enough leftover to try it cold. Was good, too, but I added a few drops of lemon juice to the cold dish to brighten the flavor. I made the dish with 1/2 t oregano, a little over 1/2 t salt and I had to sub the black beans with kidney, as black weren't available. I further added 1 really hot chili pepper and cooked it whole in the pilaf to add some heat that we usually like with beans and with broccoli, and it turned out just great!!! Oh, and I used ea red bell pepper as suggested in the description. :) Thank you for a great addition to my cookbook.

Could barely wait until they were cooled and refrigerated, just had to sneak a bite. Good when warm; better when cold! I spread a layer of blueberry preserves on top of an almost cooled crust (after step #4) and followed remainder of recipe. So easy and so delicious. Thank you!
Not for chocolate "sissies", this is deep, dark and delicious over vanilla ice cream.  I love all things "dark chocolate" and this fit the bill.  Would probably make an extraordinary milk shake, too.

Addictive.  The Kahlua flavor was not very strong but it didn't matter, these were so good. Great recipe.. Is a keeper.. I made some..and wrapped them in aluminum foil just like the york. They are very cute in my candy dish.. I did not roll them out and cut them. I rolled them in balls and flattened them in my palm and put them on the pan.. easy...

yummy, I espically liked the sour creme and peas, a nice change to traditional potato salad.
I used russet potatoes and left the peel on. We did chill the dish before serving, ( i think because we are use to eating it cold) but I think this salad would have been better served right away, slightly warm. Still very Delicious. Thanks for the recipe I will definatley be making it again.

This recipe is most outstanding! DH and I love twice baked potatoes and this recipe I found to be a bit different. I have never used egg in a twice baked potato recipe before . It was so,so GOOD! This recipe is a keeper for sure. Thanks for sharing such a wonderful new and interesting recipe for twice baked potatoes!
Dh made this for dinner last week- It was simple enough for him to figure out, yet tasty at the same time. No changes necessary! Thanks for sharing!

i had no molasses so used treacle instead, and brown instead of white sugar to make up for it, and soy margarine instead of shortening.  i was suspicious when i made this, because it looked like so little batter for such a large pan.  but i am glad i  trusted the directions; the 'cookies' are rich, gooey and addictive, and don't burn in my temperamental oven.  will definitely make again!
Nice little pudding.  Super easy to put together though I did have a little aftertaste that was odd to me.  Thanks!

I have lots of macaroni & cheese recipes and so far, this one's the best!  I served it at a dinner party where it was the main attraction at the Kids' table.  Let's just say, it didn't stay only on the Kids' table.

I'm not sure if this is the same recipe that I saw the Barefoot Contessa make on her TV show, but did a Google search and selected this recipe.  In a word -- FABULOUS! This is a wonderful baked potato,the filling is delicious.I also used the microwave to cook the potatoes first.My grandson who is a potato freak will love them.Thanks.How about more recipes from that cookbook you mentioned,MORE KITCHEN KEEPSAKLES!

This was very good!  I prepared exactly by the recipe, using dried parsley and tarragon.  I would have preferred to use fresh, but it was not available at my grocery store. Thanks Shirl(J)831!

I do not bake or cook very often and this could be part of the reason this recipe was not completely satisfactory to me. Also, there was a very specific taste I was going for and did not acheive. I also had a problem with the jelly absorbing into the cake until it was all gone from inbetween the roll. It tasted fine and my mom actually enjoyed quite a lot. I will keep looking however for better ideas.

Living in Japan it's sometimes difficult to know what kind of fish you're buying.  I was in a pinch, cooking unidentified white fish fillet for a party of 14!  I had very little time and am an inexperienced cook.  I was dying for an alternative to deep frying too.  I only had one lemon but I stretched it by mixing it throughout the wine and used celery salt and large grated fresh pepper mixed with Chinese spices.  I used two large fry pans and did two sets each of 3 or 4 pieces.  Afterwards I poured the leftover sauce and garlic over all the fish on the serving plates and it looked great!  Fortunately the fish itself had a mild flavor and it came out great!  This simple recipe totally saved me and everyone was favorably impressed!

I started to follow the directions...2 onions, sliced...Half a stick of margarine...Put 'em in a covered bowl and nuked for 10 min...Transferred the onions to a small fry pan on low heat...Added a can of mushrooms and about a tsp or so of Worcestershire sauce...In just a couple of minutes they were turning golden and delicious...Quick and easy...
Positively Scrumptious!! No need for change except, I did use fresh basil which was delicious! I will definitely make this again :) Thanks for sharing, Shawn
Wow, my Italian husband really liked this. Looks like a keeper!

I feel the amt of bread crumbs was a bit much though needed to use it all to keep the loaf together. The next time I make it I will use about 1/2 c less and maybe use smaller eggs. I may even add a little more next time. 
I have sliced the rest of it in 1 inch thicknesses and vacuum sealed it for freezing, leaving out 1 slice for later this week.

The slice I left for later was eaten tonight and the taste improved with the wait!

I made this recipe a couple of days ago because I had some canned bisquits I wanted to use up.  I only had the big bisquits and I wouldn't reccomend using them - too much bread.  I carmelized the onions and didn't have any poppy seeds.  It was simple and the onion mixture tasted good. These were ok, but I am sucker for sweet stuff and I will add some additional sugar next time. I did add some cherry pie filling for and extra treat-yummy!

I give this recipe a very high rating.  These burgers were awesome.  I think they taste like Crystal burgers.  The only change I made was use regular hamburger buns. What a hit! Delicious little gems. So easy to make, too. Everyone enjoyed them. I'm making another batch this afternoon.

I am not awarding stars because I may have done something wrong in the process of making the recipe. I expected the slices to puff in the oven turn golden and have a crisp coating. I did cut the recipe back to 3 slices but there was lots of egg mixture in each slice.
These are really good.  I doubled the recipe and baked in an 8X11 pan to make the bars a bit thicker.  I layered strawberry preserves over the baked crust and it was delicious.

I tried it and these were wonderful!  The only change I will make next time is to put 1/2 cup of the mixture aside for topping as I like a thicker crust.  Other than that this is a keeper!  Thanks for sharing!
I omitted the chopped tomatoes for a can of "Rotel" diced tomatoes with cilantra and green chilies.  My entire family loved it! This is one that I will enjoy sharing at our church potlucks! Thanks!

The cake was very good--very moist. The caramel icing was also pretty good. Although the cake and icing went well together I thought the cake might have more chocolate flavor. I think I liked it better the second day.

This turned out pretty good.  The barbeque sauce itself was very nice-- I added a little red pepper for spice, as well as a couple cloves of garlic with the onion, and it was very tangy-sweet and spicy.  The chicken turned out good-- we shredded it up and used it for BBQ sandwiches.  Yum!  Thanks for a very nice sauce recipe!

Very good Tzatziki. Amazing the liquid that drained off it when it sat in the colander over night Served it on top of chick pea/feta pitas recipe #67116 and it was delicious. Thanks Debbie for a great recipe.

I made this with tilapia and a Clois du Bois Chardonnay. It was almost hard to remove from the pan because it was so tender and flaky. A huge hit with hubby and the kids and super-easy to make, this is definitely going into the menu rotation. Thanks!

Gotta love this chicken, amazing what a cup of cornflakes and seasonings can do for chicken. Terrific taste. Crispy, crunchy with the pepper giving it a wonderful zing. Thank you for posting this recipe that so tastes like fried chicken!

I have not tried this yet but it looks wonderful.  I just want to say keep posting!!  I will make this immediately and let you know the results.  I love okra and do not see many recipes that include it.  Thank you!!
Yummy.... need I say more, definately not for the weight conscious but soo delicious.  Thanks for sharing

Excellent

Absolutely delicious! I am a risotto lover and I liked it a lot, evan my husband who's not a huge risotto fan said it deserved 5 stars. I added some bacon to the mushrooms, and it made a perfect meal!

This was extremely easy to make.  My husband loves radishes, but I usually only like them in salads and then only sparingly. This was so delicous that half of it was eaten before dinner was even ready. Great Flavor and pretty easy to make. I will make this one again and again!

I made this for my stepfather and stepbrother, they like it hot!!  They both loved it!!  Because I was trying to imitate my stepbrother's favorite restaurant recipe, I sprinkled bleu cheese on top.  I don't think he'll be going to that restaurant any time soon!!  Thanks Doc!!

Yummo!! This is a fantastic recipe, I didn't and wouldn't change a thing they are much nicer than store brought. I had mine cut into triangles served with Tzatziki.

Is it still healthy if just 2 of us ate the whole dang thing in one sitting???? Ohhh Yum!!! Wonderful peach cobbler, the best we've ever had and we will be making it again, what a treat, thanks for sharing it!!

This is a good recepie, I use to make the golabki in similar way. Made this and it rolled up nicely, good flavor and made a great combo with MaeEast's Blackberry jelly!  Thanks for sharing. kmax
super-duper yummy chocolate sauce.  I followed the recipe exactly and it was wonderful.
This was great.  I added some extra honey to the marinade and a splash of OJ.  I reserved some marinade to serve over the cooked tuna steaks.  I made them on the grill.  Delicious!
Delicious marinade!
Very tasty and slightly out of the ordinary.
Nice, easy to make chocolate cake. I topped it with butter cream icing and chopped walnuts.  Everyone loved it.  Nice enough for company, easy enough for everyday, thanks, dee
Excellent! I made this with a catfish fillet and a scrod fillet. The butter could be cut down without losing any flavor. Very good and easy. Thanks!

Yes this is yummy! I did cheat! I didn`t have nectar so I blended can peaches adding frozen concentrate lemonade. Leading me to skip the sugar. I gave one drink a kick with some coconut rum. Oh so yummy!

Whenever I see Catfish recipes, I immediately respond with "Gimmee".  I was introduced to this delicious fresh water fish some years ago on a trip to Arkansas and Missouri. I followed the recipe exactly as written and am delightfully surprised that the "cajun quality" was not so overwhelming as to spoil the succulence of final outcome.  Not a grits fan, Cheryl, I compensated by increasing the selection of mixed greens, with mucho successo...  Any nut who loves nuts as much as I, cannot be all bad. Very good. I didn't have apricot jam, so used  orange marmalade. I used boneless chicken breasts, and cooked in the slow cooker. They were a little dry, but it didn't matter, because my intention was to shred and serve on buns with cheese as a bbq chicken sandwich. Well received by the hubby.

This is fantastic bread!   Whipped it up in the Kitchen aid, and it worked great! Had them with homemade tzatziki for a snack.  Going to have my Greek Salad Wrap later.  #106863 My favorite sandwich.... Can't wait!  :)
Thank You for a wonderful recipe I will make again and again.  I am also happy it made plenty, so I have some to freeze.  YAY!!
Used Special K instead of corn flakes. The pepper was a bit much for the kids, but the results were very very good.

This was so easy to prepare - a great week night meal, you would probably have most of the ingredients on hand.  The flavours were lovely - I used chickpeas as I had no kidney beans in the cupboard and it tasted great. Leftovers were great the next day. Thanks Dale!

I had never had breaded liver before.  I could have added more onion because I smothered each bite of liver with the onion.  I added the seasoned salt to the crumbs and to the onions and I also added more salt after.  Thank you!

We enjoyed these lemony cookies! My husband, who doesn't usually like lemon, thought these were very good. I ran out of glaze, so I made a second batch of glaze with lemon juice instead of the water. These are definitely going on my Christmas cookie tray! Thanks!

So healthy and easy to prepare, and great for the whole family, even if you don't eat all at the same time.  It can just be scooped out as it's needed. Roxygirl

I only made 1/2 the recipe cause there are not alot of lemon lovers here, BUT they are gone so I will make a whole batch this week.  I will also used the lemon juice in the glaze the next time.  These are a great cookie and sure to be a Christmas hit here also!  Thanx katie!!

I would make (DID make) three amendments to the recipe to make life easier for the next chef who takes this one on. The first is, an old chicken frying trick -- after dusting the stuffed breasts (pat them dry with a paper towel!)  with flour, let them sit aside for 1/2 an hour or so before further drenching and dredging. This makes the coating stick MUCH better to the chicken. I did this and all the coating stayed firmly attached during the frying and subsequent baking process. The second is, you will NOT need 7 cups of bread crumbs -- you can easily get away with half that amount or even less, keeping the other "dredge" ingredients the same. The third is, because I was using bone-in Breasts (I cut off the "rib" section), I increased the baking time to about 55  minutes and the chicken was still very tender and juicy.  
Now, as for flavor, this is the perfect meld of chicken and seafood (which can otherwise be tricky). I made up the filling on the night before and it was so munchable, I had difficulty resisting just eating it all on crackers! I will say that this is probably not a dish for kids who are enamored with McDonald's. This is an elegant entree for those who enjoy fine dining -- and fine it was!

Great tasteing ham loaf. We loved the taste the curry gave it. We made a full recipe of the glaze and had a lot leftover.
We will definitely make it again.
Yum! I made it to go with Tandori Chicken, one of the best meals I've made in ages!

I used frozen peaches, cut the sugar in 1/2 and used orange juice concentrate with almond extract! Put it all into my vita mix and walla no refreezing or waiting just make and eat! I didn`t like the orange in it so if I make a gain I`ll go for just almond liqueur. Kids were enjoying this that is why I opted for the oj.

This turned out great, but didn't have the flavor I was expecting. In the future I would substitute capers for the peas, and I think it would fare better. The cayenne pepper adds suprising flavor, and is the perfect amount for the recipe.
This was recently on FoodTV.  It sounds delicious!  I'll have to let you know when I get a chance to try it myself.
This cake was just wonderful!  I frosted with peanut butter frosting and my husband has eaten half of it already!!!

Very tender cookie that stays soft and moist inside even days after it's made. The combination of quick oats and milk in the recipe makes the oatmeal not as distinctive as in more traditional oatmeal cookie recipes, but results in a hearty cookie base that's full of chocolate. Closer to batter than stiff cookie dough. I used light Karo corn syrup and vanilla. I'm sure maple flavoring would be good, and I think some  cinnamon would be a nice addition. Kitten's suggestion of cranberries and nuts sounds good, too. Instead of greasing pans, a silpat is a real timesaver and makes cleanup a breeze. Thanks for sharing the recipe!
I really loved this recipe and it was a great recipe. I will make this recipe. thank you for sharing.
Very basic-cheesy taste.  I added some sausages to add more color and flavor.  My bread crumbs weren't as crunchy as i expected (i used fresh breadcrumb).  Maybe i should've used dry.

A great recipe! I don't have an 8 x 8 inch pan so I used a 20 cm x 15 cm instead (a bit smaller than called for); lined the pan with foil and then greased the foil. As per suggestions reserved only 1/2 cup of topping and baked a minute or two longer because of my smaller pan. Absolutely delicious - the crust has a caramel-like taste and the cheese part is fresh and not overly sweet. These instantly became my DH's new favourite! Thanks so much for the recipe Bev!

Kitten, my children adore you!  This recipe was prepared for our lunch entirely by them and they had a blast doing it!  The taste is just like pizza, and it even has something of a 'crust', although not the kind of crust a real pizza has - but certainly very nice - especially for the amount of work that went in.  We used a whole small chopped onion in the batter (probably double the 2 tblsps called for in the recipe) and 1 very small garlic clove for addd flavour.  We also added 3/4 cup of sauce as 1/3 cup was just not enough and we love our sauce in this family!  Note to all who make this recipe.  Do not add the mozzarella till 5 minutes before it is done or it will overly-brown and become hard at this high temperature.  I actually baked the dish entirely, then added the mozz and put back in the (turned-off) oven just until the cheese melted.  Wonderful!
love this recipe. chicken and the rice taste so good and its so easy to make. my husband just loves this

This Catalina dressing is delicious!! It is much better than any store-bought and very quick and easy too! My family prefers homemade salad dressings over the premade and I definitely won't be buying Catalina anymore. Thank you for sharing this wonderful recipe...it is definitely a keeper!!
One of my favorite recipes.  Tonight, I will be making it again.  Extremely flavorful.  I did add more garlic.  Perfect recipe for any garlic lover.

YUM!!! 
I have no idea how authentic they are, and I do not much care...they are fantastic!!

Turned out just great.  I used whole wheat pastry flour and I think that I'll give it a try with regular whole wheat flour next time.  And there will be a next time because these are super easy and taste great too.  Had them both hot off the grill (ok hot off the pan) and reheated as well.  I am not so great with yeast breads, so this was a real treat for me as I had no problems with it.  Thanks for sharing!
These were nice and fluffy, and tasty as well, not dry at all.  They went great with the beef roast we had for supper.  I used honey instead of sugar.
Served last night for a party, was a big hit!  Very tasty, very pretty to serve!

Perfect!  Not too thin, not too thick.  If they were any thicker, they would be cheesecake.  Those that have trouble getting them from the pan, might spray with cooking spray first.  My family loved them.
These are fabulous!  You've made my day Laurie.  Thank you! Dh and I are both from Minnesota and we're now living in Germany...no sliders to be found here! I'll be making these on a regular basis.
I made this tonight for dessert and it was wonderful, nice an rich, I used semi-sweet chocolate chips.  My family loved this
Very good, I think it could have marinated longer, the flavor was mild.
This is the ONLY way my 17 yr. old son will eat ham anymore!  Very good!!!

Please add me to the list of those who really enjoyed this dessert! Because we have two in our family who need to reduce sugar intake, I made the filling with sugar free instant pudding (I used cheesecake flavour) and low fat cool whip. Instead of the chocolate frosting, I made a ganache of 6 oz. semisweet chocolate, 2 TBSP. unsalted butter, and 6 oz. of heavy cream. This was a winning combination, and we all loved this dessert, decadent in taste only.

I could not get this to taste good.  It might have been the curry paste I used, which was Maeploy.  The technique for making it seemed to work great, but mine just came out tasting pretty.  I wouldn't attempt to make this again with the same curry paste.

Laurie, these are fantastic!  I couldn't find the Pepperidge Farm rolls but DID find PF hot dog buns and so I used those whole, didn't cut them in half.  Full thumbs up from my husband and daughter.  I live in 'White Castle Territory' but now have a substitute for when we move.  Thanks for posting this, it was a fun, easy and delicious Saturday night supper :)

This rice was GREAT.  I served it with a tasty Indian curry and I didn't like the flavors together, so be ware, it's very sweet.  I used almonds and currants this time and will try pistachios next time!

Yum. I used regular fat-free cream cheese, so I added about 1 Tbsp of milk so it would be softer. I ran my olives/pimentos through the food processor quickly to chop, then added everything else. This is fast and really tasty. DH & I enjoyed as a Sat snack spread on Triscuits & Wheat Thins.

This is the best chocolate cake I have  made. I made it for my little girl birthday and its gone like a breeze. It was supermoist and so easy to make. Slightly too sweet for my family and will certainly make it again. It's a real hit.

These were so very good and not soggy.  I made the following minor changes:  I peeled the eggplant (personal preference), I soaked the slices in cold water for about 10 minutes, then drained on a paper towel.  I used italian breadcrumbs, but still added the herbs in the recipe.  These were a hit with everyone, including my daughters friend who was staying the night. I served a marinara for dipping and had this on the side of a bow-tie shrimp dish that I'd prepared.
Made this and frosted it with coconut pecan frosting.  This is a sin for those on a diet. Whoops, I'm on the diet.  Worth every bite.

This was simple, quick & tasty.  I bought raw, shelled & deveined prawns which I stir-fried separately in a little olive oil along with some hot chilli flakes and freshly cracked black pepper.  I added salt & plenty of black pepper & chilli flakes to the sauce, mixed the cooked prawns through, then added the pasta. I used bucatini, bottled pesto, & low-fat milk.
Very good and easy cheesecake bars.  I especially liked the crust and topping.  I used light cream cheese and it worked fine.

My pie turned out terrible! I don't know what happened but, my apples were half cooked, lots of juice in the pan and my topping was burned and it tasted terrible!!! I think I cut the apples to big and I doubled the topping being we wanted more. So this could of been my error and not the recipe. This is the first apple pie that I did not precook the apples as I have always done in the past and I will not double the topping anymore and I will precook my apples to make sure they get done!!! Nothing like serving it and taking a bite and there not cooked!!!
