This is a great recipe. Quick and easy.  Will make again soon. Thanks for posting.

This is such a wonderful coffee cake.  I used cake flour (adding an extra two tablespoons of flour per each cup required by the recipe), and 2 and 1/2 cups of rhubarb, and it came out unbelievably moist, fluffy, and delicious.  I also put a little ground ginger and lemon zest in the topping, which really punched up the flavor.

Wow--everyone loved this!  I bought some rhubarb from the Farmer's Market and this was my first time to use rhubarb.  I made it with raspberry jello as the other reviewer suggested.  Very easy to make--and tastes like it was difficult.  Thanks for a great recipe--I'll use it anytime I get rhubarb!

This drink is fantastic!  The sweet/tart ratio was perfect and the orange and grape juice just enhanced the wonderful strawberry taste.  The only change I made was to use 1% low-fat milk.  This is a refreshing, creamy and delicious smoothie.  Thanks, mosma~ :-)

I used 1 kiwi and 1/2 a banana (3 year old DS wanted 1/2 a banana). I used about a teaspoon of splenda instead of sugar, and 3/4 cup crushed ice. I wanted more when I was done!!!!! Next time I think if I use a full cup of ice, it will still have plenty of flavor.  Thanks for posting a healthy, delicious summer treat!

I made a half batch, but I mixed it all together at once, and cooked it a little longer so it wouldn't be sticky.  This is the same consistency as the stuff they sell at the store!  I definitely won't be buying anymore.

great but it was very very rich even for a chocoholic like me.
But the rest of my family liked it

Wow!  This was the first "white" pizza we've ever had.  What a treat.  I used non-fat ricotta and mixed the ricotta with the basil, some mozz, and some minced garlic.  I added some chicken and black olives as well.  Instead of regular pizza crust I used flat bread wraps.  Worked perfect, thanks a million!
This is not a low carb recipe. It is rated 9% carbs. Get rid of the corn, breadcrumbs, & cornmeal & then it might be okay for diabetics.
I have had this recipe for years and it is always a favorite. I am in trouble if I don't make these at christmas time.
Very Good,we enjoyed it

I used fava beans grown in my garden. Instead of mashing by hand I pureed in the blender.  Also, I added lemon juice.  My Moroccan husband nodded in approval!  A healthy thing to eat!  Thanks Toni for sharing the receipe.

This is a lovely crockpot recipe, I only cooked it for 6 hours (2 of them on high) as I was late putting it on but it turned out wonderful, full of flavour and with the beans thickening the sauce, it was very filling indeed.....An easy meal to pull together on those rushed days... a couple of minutes in the morning and dinner is done when you get home... just the sort of meal I love... Thankyou PaulaG for posting... this will become a regular for me :)
This recipe was easy to make and it froze beautifully in my ice cream maker.  I made as posted and my family ate it up ~ there is none left!  Thanks for posting!

I didn't make this one exactly as directed (I used ground turkey in a tube, even, and left out the mushrooms). I ended up tossing in a little ground cumin and chili powder, mixing some ready rice in with it, and adding some sour cream. It make an incredible starting point, though, for experimentation. It was delicious. I do think, though, that it's more than 4 servings. I ended up with six good-sized servings. It did take a fair bit of prep, so I don't know how often I'll make it. But I'll definitely be using this recipe again!

This was a fun project for a slow summer afternoon, and it tasted about like any other devil's food recipe (thank goodness).  We filled it with the mocha filling from the Joy of Cooking and frosted it with White Mountain Cream, recipe #117823. Nice to have a homemade cake once in a while, and fun that my little daughter was interested in helping. Thanks for posting.

Wow! These were wonderful ribs and probably the only way I will make them from now on.  I used 4 cans of Dr. Pepper and they covered the 4lbs of ribs nicely.  I only had diced onion that I had previously cut so I used that and just a cheapo bbq sauce.  It will be nice to try these with different sauces. Very very good!

I made as written and it was very good.  We served it over red chard, which was good because it soaked up some of the vinegar, which we thought was a bit much for such a mild fish like halibut.  I would like to try this again with salmon because it was very easy and very tasty!

really really good!
i like the top to be a little moist =)
I've started having this once a week!

I love dips like this and this one is no exception.  I halved the recipe because it was just DH and myself and also used "real" bacon.  Yummy!  So easy and uses ingredients easy to keep on hand.  I used reduced fat Triscuits, but this would be great with any chip especially homemade tortilla chips!  Thanks akanails76!

loved the mushy part, but remembered too late that i hate fruit cocktail, especially the grapes. next time i am going to make this with raspberry jello and 18 ounces of canned peaches. then it will become a 5 star recipe!!!!!! now it is great no mushy fruit cocktail and i used raspberry Jello and canned peaches. thanks for a great recipe!
A fantastic, rich gelato, easy to make with a little patience.  I melted in 1oz of semisweet chocolate after straining the coffee. Served with ganache, this would please anyone.
A nice recipe.  I made it for our lake party and doubled the recipe.

Loved the flavor.  I used thighs and followed the rest of the recipe exactly, except for the jalapeno.  I only used half of 1, and found that I wish I had used two.  I think the heat would have balanced the sweetness.
Very yummy! Lots of chips, great combination of peanut butter and chocolate. Halved the recipe with good results. Will make these again. Thanks for sharing the recipe!

This was the longest hour waiting for this to cook!  The smell was heavenly and I thought DH might attack the oven to get at it.  I made a 1/2 recipe.  I suggest spraying the dish well or using foil as my dish is currently soaking to help get it clean.

My whole family, especially my husband, loves this ice cream. I used 1/2 C splenda and 1/4 C granulated sugar and it tasted perfect!!!! I make this recipe 2x a week, sometimes adding brownie bits to it. Thanks for sharing the recipe.

The first time I made this, I was halfway through the prep of the eggplant when I realized I was out of parmesan cheese.  I went ahead and made it without the cheese, and it was wonderful!  I couldn't wait to try it again with the parmesan, thinking that this would only make it better.  I was wrong.  The second time I made this using the parmesan cheese, and I ended up throwing most of the eggplant away.  It just wasn't nearly as good as it was when I prepared it without the cheese.  I do love this recipe, and I'll definitely keep making it, but only without the parmesan.
Nice change from plain old Iced tea! My family does not care for anything other then plain old tea but I LOVe variety! This was nicely flavored and very refreshing! Thanks Juenessa!

this dish by Rachael Ray was absolutley hrrible.  My husband said he liked it but i think he was being nice.  Then he went to have it the next day( left overs) and it stunk up the house.  The pasta looks like worms after cooking it in the red wine/ water.  I will never do this one again, but don't take my word for it try it out yourself.
Delicious!

The sauce for this was out of this world! I was tossing up whether it was a four or a five, because I thought the pork was a waste of time. But the sauce sold me. I found the pork grainy and lost in the strong sauce, and I think I will try this with chicken tenderloins next time, I used thin hokkien noodles, as I couldnt find flat egg noodles. Definately a keeper!

Absolutely delicious! My children and I enjoyed this dish very much and it has come to be a part of our family menu. I shared this recipe with my dear best friend and her and her family as well fell in love with it. It has such wonderful taste. For the sake of my children's taste buds I used just a milder pepper and it still tasted wonderful. I can not wait until my husband is back from deployment so he can share this wonderful dish with us. Thank you!

This was great! I actually didn't even make it with shrimp and scallops - I just made the sauce and served it on homemade gnocchi.  I added maybe a tablespoon of flour and 1/4 cup of grated cheese at the end to thicken it up.  I served it on the side with a tuna steak. Next time I think I'll cut down on the onions (it was a little much for 2 servings). Thank you!

Wow - this gets moved to my Tried & True File.  I didn't have any jalapeno peppers so I used some cayenne pepper in place of them.  Served with steamed rice and sauted asparagus.  Excellent recipe.  Thanks for posting.

Loved these...light, delicious lemony sweet treats.  We enjoyed them at room temp. a few hours out of the oven and over the next couple of days chilled too.  I loved the lemon filling, it was just the right consistency to not be overly icky gooey sweet...these bars melt away in your mouth!!  So light they are almost refreshing!  Excellent recipe - Thanks MA HIKER!! :)
Easy and very yummy! I love the addition of fresh basil! :)
This recipe is super simple and the cake is delicious.  Very moist and flavorful!  It was a big hit in my household and with my co-workers.
Very good.  One question is where you suppose to be able to taste the marshmallows because I couldn't tell it had marshmallows in it.
My husband found this recipe and asked me to make it.  It was really delicious.  I served it with rice pilaf and pine nuts.  Thank you!!! I will make this again!
Really moist and yummy! It wasn't too sugary like a lot of other chocolate cakes I've tried. I only used 1/2 cup cocoa cause my family doesn't like stuff too decadent.

These were so tasty!  I doubled the recipe and made them for a poker party and there was none left afterwards.  The hint of the cloves gave it a nice compliment to the sauce, which was a little sweet.  Way better then dumping a bottle of bbq sauce over them, which I've had and are just ok.

I think this was my first time trying fava beans...I bought them because I kept on seeing them in middle eastern recipes...I also kept on thinking of Hannible Lector...LOL. Anyhow this was easy to make and was pretty tasty...it was more of a refried bean texture than a puree. I think I would puree it next time as we didn't care for the texture but the flavor was good. I also thought it was going to be too hot for me but it wasn't. I had to hand grind cumin seeds because I was out of the already ground kind. The spices pop with the addition of lemon juice. My husband really loved this. We ate it as a side like refried beans.

What a wonderful breakfast!  I used fat free 1/2 & 1/2, and two boxes of the precooked bacon, crumbled, instead of the sausage the second time we made this.  I had to bake it for about 20 minutes more than listed.  Love it with bacon or sausage.  Thanks for a great casserole!
This was delicious! I followed the recipe except for the shrimp. I substitued crispy bacon pieces. The whole family loved it so we will definitely have it again. Thank you for sharing!

Loved the end result but the amount of cornstarch is a bit questionable, it thickened way before 6 minutes more like 2-3 minutes. Make sure you chill it really good before adding to ice cream maker, but it is the richest creamiest custard ever!
instead of garlic powder, sprinkled with a little season salt. all else the same! yummy!!

Great recipe....loved by the entire family. Soooo easy to make (I love that). I only made a couple of changes to the recipe. I used whole wheat biscuits and I added a can of mixed vegetables. I just felt like a chicken pot pie biscuit needed veggies.

A RR fan friend of mine made this Thursday night and it was WONDERFUL!  She made it exactly as it was listed on RR's show.  She also said it took longer than 30 min. to prepare but well worth it.  I took a spinach-strawberry salad and bottle of good wine.  What a feast.  Now it's my turn to make it.

These are very good... although credit should go to Gourmet Magazine (April 2003), which is where the recipe actually came from.  Don't skip the salad... it's the perfect compliment to the goat cheese cups.

This is a great salad if you like the old waldorf salad... I added a little apple cider vineagar, sugar & a touch of mustard to fat free miracle whip to create the dressing.  Very interesting flavor combination in this salad...B

These were great!  Last night I made Black Beans (Recipe #233154) and had lots of leftovers, so I cooked some lentils for these burgers.  My black beans were a little liquid-y, but I solved that by adding more breadcrumbs.  They took some time to cook, but were absolutely delicious.  I spread a combo of olive oil and roasted garlic on the roll and we thought these were great!  Not spicy though, even with the jalapeno.  Thanks so much!

An easy and very tasty vegetable accompaniment - thanks Mimi! I used finely chopped shallots and also some finely chopped chives - as well as parsley for a garnish! I also did not add the sugar, as the carrots were very sweet already. Made for a camera-less chef tag game - FT:-)

Just finished making this - used a 9x13 pan and only one package of dinner rolls.  The cook time was WAY off for this.  It took almost 45 minutes for the eggs to set and by that time the crust was a little too dark.  Other than that it was good.  I think next time I won't pre-cook the crust and see if that works better.

I'm conflicted about the rating for these.  We inhaled them so I'm giving them a 5, and I know I'll make them again.  But next time I'll add a touch more sugar and a touch more lemon zest.  Loved the consistency and will make these again!

So yummy and easy!  Served with canned marinara and it was very good.

The only thing I did different than the recipe was to slice, salt, and drain my eggplant before breading and  cooking it.  This keeps it from getting soggy and removes some of the bitterness.
Good salad...I especially liked the water chestnuts and bean sprouts on it...the dressing was very good.  I made it with splenda. I am sure I will make it often...
Delicious!  Followed the directions exactly using American cheese and savored every mouthful.  I have actually made this several times and neglected to review it!  Will make many more times too!

This was very easy to make, and went over really well.  I love coming home from a party with an empty dish! Next time I will probably add a bit more salad dressing as it seemed kind of thick for the chips.  Or I'll just use the thicker scoop chips.
I don't usually make chocolate cake from scratch, but will from now on. It was great and pretty easy to make. I can't wait to have the leftovers at lunch today.
how is this healthy?  it has 13.5 g saturated fat and 21 g sugar PER SERVING????!!?  i'm sure it tastes good, but duh!
Mine came out a too salty.  Otherwise very good.

This light, fluffy cake was SO delightful...I could make it for any occasion. There was just enough chocolate so it wasn't over doing it. It was most definitely the best cake I've ever tasted it. However, I just spread peanut butter over the cake without measurements while the cake was hot, and then sprinkled chocolate chips over the cake. When the chips melted, I took a scraper and spread chocolate around the cake. It was amazing and thanks, littleturtle!

I made this for my ex husband and he upped the child support!  Okay- only kidding, but this was wonderful, and a definite keeper! 
Thanks ratherbeswimmin'

What a moist cake.  I've never been a big fan of chocolate cake as I've always thought they were dry and crumbly.  Not so. This is a delicious recipe....thank you for opening my eyes to chocolate cake....mmmmmmm.  This is a winner in my books since its so simple and basic ingredients.....thank you.....Stephanie

This cobbler is quick, easy, and delicious.  I also substituted in olive oil for margarine when I made a 2-serving version for my husband and me.  He and I loved it.  I plan to make it for a dinner party this weekend.  Thanks for a great recipe!
Very easy to make! I used all shrimp instead of scallops and served it over linquine. I fresh squeezed 1/2 a lemon, and used about 1/4 cup of cheese. Will definetly make it again.

These are absolutely fantastic!!!
I've made these twice now... they're a "keeper"

Delish!!!!
Everyone wanted this recipe....

Great recipe.
The results are a very good looking tasty little appetizer.
Will make these again.
Highly recommend!  I marinated the chicken for 2 days and the flavor was stong, but we enjoyed it.  I love the simplicity of this as well.

Loved this recipe! I used celery as this is what I had on hand and I used vegetable broth as I am a vegetarian. I also used whole wheat rotini instead of bow tie pasta and I subtituted thyme as I did not have any bay leaves on hand. Very "earthy" tasting, will be making again! Thanks for sharing! BTW, this is very good to eat when you have a cold :)

YUMM I just had my first bite of one of these great cookies! I added some graham cracker crumbs, extra butter, coconut, and oats to the crust.  To the cream cheese mixture i added a small amount of sour cream and 2.5 tablespoons of lemon juice.  I thought it turned out rather good with the additions! A recipe I will def. make again.

Is sugar really necessary in making Soya milk ?
I do not think so.
We should try to avoid sugar (particularly the refined white one) as much as possible.
I have been preparing soya milk from soya beans in a machine for a year now and have never added sugar.
When using the milk we add chocolate powder or an instant cocoa.

Wow!!!! Where was this in college??!!! 
I used Betty Crocker tripple choc cake mix (it's the one with mini choc chips) and added 3 tbs of instant esspresso mix to buttercream frosting, then sprinkled the top with chopped nuts and a handfull of mini choc chips......
It looked pretty neat, but served chilled, this is a killer cake!!
THANKS!!!

VERY GOOD! I loved it! It definately needed more marinating time though... I cut the chicken pieces in half and marinated for twice the time and the flavor was FANTASTIC.  The honey wasnt very sweetening...I would have added more.  Overall-delicious.  I served this with Roasted Green Beans (another recipe I found-fanatabulous)  and some basic mashed potatoes.  Great meal! Spicy and yet the potatoes totally balanced it out!  Thnx!

I was pleasantly surprised by this dish!  I used potatoes, onions, baby carrots and cauliflower.  As for the dry soup mix, used Knorr's leak soup.  This turned out quite tasty - all I added was some nice fresh pepper.  I also only cooked it for about an hour (as my veggies were not whole).  Thanks Mandy - this is a keeper!! :)

Even though I was out of sun-dried tomatoes, we still enjoyed this delicious bread. First, I subbed 1 cup of whole wheat flour for the white flour. I omitted the cheese, and topped the bread with salt free lemon-pepper seasoning, salt free garlic powder and fresh rosemary from the garden. This was a cinch to prepare! Very good flavor and I really like the texture of the bread. Next time I promise to test the bread with the sun-dried tomatoes. Thanks!

What to do with some leftover salmon?? A nice little recipe from Tulip-Fairy solved the problem, thanks for posting! I grated the ginger and finely minced the garlic clove, wonderful!!I love fresh ginger so will be using this dressing recipe again.

great muffins! i didn't have nutmeg or allspice, so i used 1/2 tsp. ground ginger and 1 tsp. cinnamon.  also - i added about 1/3 c. ground flaxseed to add good fats and fiber.  these were excellent - thanks for the recipe.

This was a delightful addition to dinner tonight.  The twang of sundried tomatoes with the saltiness of cheese and pesto was great.  I sliced prior to spreading on the topping for ease and cooked in the toaster oven.  Thanks for posting.
Moist, Moist, moist! I only used 1/2 a cup of boiling water because I wanted to make a black forest cake out of it. Is sooo delicious!

My husband is Greek and he went crazy over this pita. I can't believe how easy it is!! No more "store bought" pita for us. Thank You.
I gave this 5 stars but they aren't showing up.

It should be noted that about two lbs. of waxy (NOT starchy) potatoes should be used.

The flavor of the sauce was excellent.

This was a very tasty and lovely recipe.  I cooked the trio of broccoli, tomato and fresh herbs for about 7 minutes.  I also used fresh oregoano and part skim mozzarella.  This was a wonderful combination.  Thank you  for posting such a nice tasting, healthy recipe.  Fresh farmer's market tomatoes really do add a wonderfully fresh taste.

These were great!! Very easy... I used pepperment liquer instead of extract(could't find any) Made more than 200 and was planning to serve these at a function, but they all disapeared before the main course even started!!!
Very tasty... they melt in your mouth!!

A refreshing and delicious tea drink. I made it just by the recipe except in a half amount and I put a cinnamon stick into the pitcher. I made it last night and chilled it overnight. It's highly recommended with a high Yumm factor.
Wonderful summer recipe. We have made this a dinner staple in our family rotation.
This was just what I needed for dinner last night. I didn't have mixed veggies so I put in a little corn, a little green beans and a little peas. Worked great. I froze the leftovers.

Just perfect.  I used whole baby carrots instead of sliced.  These were a great veggie to serve to my nieces and nephews.  They actually ate vegetables with no complaint.  Even with the honey and sugar, I don't think they have as many calories as you might think because most of the sauce isn't actually eaten, it almost serves as a marinade.

Zesty, zingy, and delicious!  We had these tonight with some mac and cheese and ate the whole thing!  These ribs are just spicy enough, without being "hot".  They are a keeper on our menu.  Thanks for posting!

This is fabulous! It's light tasting and filling. I must have had super-absorbent lentils, though. I had to add about twice as much water as the recipe called for. I also added extra garlic and salt to give it more flavor.

I made this recipe for my first attempt at pickling asparagus, and brought the jars to a family reunion.  It was a hit!  Everyone loved and and wanted the recipe!  I used a pickling spice that I put together following a recipe on this site.

This is one of the absolute easiest loafs I've ever made.  I got it in the oven in less than 5 minutes.  I used skim milk and 2% cheese with no problem.  Be sure to check it in the middle though.  (I didn't and had some gooey places to cut out!)  Really nice flavor and would be a great easy addition to a soup or stew dinner in the winter.  I'm sure I'll make it again then.  Thanks Derf!

Almost exactly as my Cuban grandpa made.  I marinated for 2 days, and tossing the marinade isn't usually done when making "traditional" Cuban pork w/ mojo sauce.  It's much better to either baste or leave it on while baking.

I've made this several times since discovering the recipe.  It is absolutely wonderful!!  Instead of slicing the tomatoes, I dice them.  I've also added a little feta to them just before serving (I like a little more zing than mozzarella provides.)I serve it with a crusty loaf of French bread for an easy bruschetta.  It smells so good sitting there on the counter, I can hardly wait to dig in!!

This is very good!  Next time, and I will make this again for sure, I think I'll try other meats and cheeses.  I think you could use deli turkey and ham with swiss and/or havarti or many other combos.  I didn't have jarred roasted peppers, so I used fresh green.  Mine only took about 18 minutes, but ovens vary.  Thanks for a really good idea, Kristen!
Excellent! This is soooooo good...you can't stop eating this.... wonderful food...Thanks, Chia for posting...will make many more times!

I was so hoping this would have been a 5 star recipe for us.  I love golden mushroom soup and think that the soup, along with the onions, is the only reason I can give this recipe three stars.  The meat was tough.  I think next time I will use Morton Tender Quick the night before.  A lot more season salt and pepper were needed.  I also think garlic powder would have helped.  We served it with mashed potatoes.  It did make a nice gravy, though.  Thanks for sharing.

This is a beautiful chocolate cake! It really is super moist, definitely the best consistency of any cake I have ever baked. I don't get many good cake mixes here in the Czech Republic so I will be using this a lot. Even my BF who has a thing against cakes loved it. The cake I ended up with was pretty huge for the two of us, but now our friends love us lots and lots!

DH loves these little guys, not only are they great for get-togethers, but they are a quick and tasty way to use up leftover taco meat when it's just DH and I. Guys have fun eating them b/c they get manly-man tacos without all the mess.  A great superbowl party food.

My MIL use to make this with brandy and she called it black bottom pie.  After she passed away I searched and searched for a black bottom pie recipe that was like hers.  Well this is it.  Most black bottom pie recipes have the egg whites as a meringue on top of the pie and no whipped cream.  Thank you for bringing this recipe to me.  YMMMMMMMMMMMM!!!!!
Great recipe, light and fluffy! The kids loved them. Thanks for sharing

Very good recipe - I am sure if it would have been even better if I had followed the directions, oops.  First of all, I halved the recipe, and since I didn't have fresh dill, I used dried and silly me forgot to add the garlic.  Other than that it was great.  I loved that it used sour cream instead of mayo, like so many seafood recipes do.  Thanks for posting!!! :yummy:
Made this last night with a crock pot chicken cacciatore from this site(recipe # 94033) over the top. It was good on the side without the cacciatore but together? SUPERB! Can't wait to make it again!
delicious.  i paired this with my Recipe #247950 for an easy oven meal.  i love the sweetness of the onions in this dish.  it was wonderful.
Had lots of zucchinis and tomatoes so made this - mmmm good!!  This dish would make a zucchini lover out of anyone!! :)  Thanks lazyme!!

Good recipe, the kids and husband loved it. I felt like it was missing something but not sure what. I served it with green beans stir fried in EVOO, butter and garlic and mashed potatoes which was a very nice combination along with a glass of the same wine I used in the recipe.
Wonderful steak dish.  Used horseradish and babybella mushrooms.  Really delicious combination served with Recipe #220946 and sliced tomatoes with blue cheese.  Delicious!

Wow, this marinade was awesome.  The only mistake I made was using Chuck cubes instead of Sirloin.  They were a little chewy.  The marinade was probably the best I have had in a long time.  I've already added Sirloin to my weekend shopping list.  I did cut the recipe in half, but I still used 4 cloves of garlic.  Thank you Susie for a great recipe and definitely a keeper.
My kids ate this up. They just loved it. Thanks!

Very creative contest entry! The entire family, except me, thought they were too sweet, but i thought they were perfect...I do love things sweet! If I made these again I would not sugar the tortillas after frying, maybe just sprinkle a touch of cinnamon and I would cut the sugar in the whip cream. Again, I thought it was perfect as is but some of the family couldn't finish their servings...so I ate them, lol!

My husband called this, "the best dessert ever!"  This looks beautiful and tastes divine.  There are a few steps, but none of them are too complicated and it's well worth the effort.  Next time I will double the fruit mixture for sure.  Thanks for sharing!
Great recipe! Great cookies! Enough to give away and still have plenty for my family. Thanks!

Absolutely fabulous. Extrordinarily delicious, easy to make, and unusual enough to impress.  The delicate texture of the crispas, the soft warmth of the apples, the cold sweetness of the whipped cream, and the crunch of the pecans was a perfect harmony of flavor and texture. My DH passionately dislikes Amaretto â€“ even the smell makes him ill -- so I substituted Captain Morgan spiced rum because I thought it would go well with the apples and cinnamon and it did. The Amaretto could only be better. The directions are well-written and the steps well organized to get this dish made efficiently and right. I ended up with a lot of extra cinnamon sugar so I made extra crispas for the kids to have as snacks tomorrow.
These were pretty good.  I am always trying new biscuit receipes.  This one will probably be put in my to keep file.  Thanks
This is really good & flavorful. To me it makes a great supper dish. My family liked it but said they would rather have a more traditional breakfast. We will definitely make this again.
If you're looking for an easy cake to make that's not out of a box, this is the one for you.  Great recipe!

Loved, loved loved it.  The batter was so light and browned beautifully.  We don't eat much fried foods, but this is worth it.  Flavor was great.  Had some extra batter, but so what.  I got one and Dave ate the rest.  Made as directed without any changes and I have no suggestions to make it better, except to maybe add a little salt and pepper, but not a biggy. This does not serve 2 if they are anything like Dave.  LOL  thanks Anme.

This recipe was a huge hit with my family. Loved the sweetness from the flour tortillas sprinkled with cinnamon and sugar. Then to top that a warm tender apple slice then a dollop of Cream. Mmmmm! This was *Delicious* ... Good Luck to you Chef, what a nice way to use the ingredients! Wish I had thought of it ;) ~V

I halved this mix & put it on muffins as a kind of mini-pizza, tastes great but even though I drained my tomatoes well I did find the topping quite oily, if I was to make this again I would cut back on the butter by about half I think. Thanks for posting!

I remember a car trip we took as kids to a Doubletree in New Orleans... waaaaaaay back in the 80's... and these cookies brought back so mnay memories.  It has been a long time since I have eaten the real thing, but these really seem close.  I made them just as directed, except I refrigerate the dough overnight before baking.  I think it really helps the flavors marry and it really replicates the original cookies in texture and appearance. I love the chewy texture and the slight hint of cinnamon... We love these as a treat!!!  Thanks!

Great concept chef! Way to come up with a very different and exciting contest entry. I knew I would be short on time the evening I prepared this so I prepped as much as possible which allowed the dish to come together much quicker for me(did the measuring and chopping etc.. ahead) I apologize for the necessary deviation from your instructions. That was the only thing I did differently. Oh, I also forgot to add the pecans before I took the pic and the batteries were dead when I realized that. We rated this 4 stars as we have enjoyed sauteed apples such as these here that had a different measure of liquor/sugar/apples that we found very nice. Would have also liked to have some of the cinnamon sugar sprinkled over the top as a garnish as the cinnamon really was nice in this dish. Good luck to you chef! Great idea!

I marinaded chicken thighs and took them camping this weekend. We went camping with neighbors and everyone loved the chicken. The marinade plus grilling perfect recipe for great chicken. Thanks Margo we will be using this marinade quite often.

This makes a wonderful light dessert after a heavy meal.  I don't think that I cooked the gelatin enough and therefore it was spooned into dessert dishes as well as spooned onto puff pastry baskets and then dusted with powdered sugar.  The mousse did set and tasted great after being refrigerated.  It is nicely flavored and the taste of the fresh mango really comes through.

Awesome, Delicious, Fantaboulus,
I love it!!!

This is the first mac & cheese recipe I've made where you don't precook the noodles. This was good but I prefer a little more creamy. I thank you for posting a very easy mac & cheese recipe Thanks, Grandpa!
I made and photographed this recipe for the Camera-less Chef Game. I love strawberries, but had never made a Strawberry Pie. This recipe was simple and turned out great. My whole family loved it!
Good, quick, easy meal.  Thank you for a recipe that will be made when I need a quick dish that all will enjoy.

i boiled for 90 minutes and had my hubby throw on the grill.  he had the heat up too high, so they carmelized instantly & started to burn!  they are already cooked, so put grill on low and WATCH them.  despite the crispy edges, these were perfect & we will make them again.  it is agreed that sweet baby rays is the sauce for these ribs!!!

I LOVED the hoisin-marmalade sauce....it could go on any kind of meat (pork, chicken, beef, fish).  And this was so easy!  I used really thin turkey and put it over brown rice.  Thanks for a keeper, PetiteChef :-)

Great moist muffins!   Made mine with zucchini rather than carrots (used about 3/4 of a cup), and used King Arthur's White Whole Wheat Flour.  Baked them in large muffin tin -- it made six giant muffins!   I feel that they need more spice . . . next time think I'll add 1/2 teaspoon of nutmeg and 1/2 teaspoon of cloves.   Also feel that the salt is required, not an option and maybe a bit more than 1/2 teaspooon.    Thanks for sharing a great recipe.
Thhis was awesome since we are garlic fanatics here!  The chicken was moist and so flavorful!  Thanks for a great recipe ; )
This is a good creamy drink.  Not too strong.  Maybe I'll add a little bit or regular rum next time to make it less sweet.  Thanks Mommy Diva :)  Made for Beverage Tag.

The first time I had beet greens, I hated them.  My husband made them but he overcooked them so they were mushy like overcooked spinach.  These were great though.  I didn't have fresh ginger so I used dried.  I also sauteed a little bit of chopped yellow pepper with the garlic because I had some that I needed to cook.  A little sweet onion might be good with it, too.  Next time, I might not boil the greens first, or I might just very lightly steam them.  Thanks.  This was a great recipe.  I used the beets from recipe #72831 but didn't add them to this mix.

I made this for a special event dinner and everyone loved it. I added onions and used fresh chopped tomatoes. I found this recipe easy to make and will make it again.  I loved the mint in the soup I added a little extra at the end just to give it a little aroma.

A bit sweet, a bit peppery, altogether delicious.  I was surprised at how long it took to cook the sugar in the butter, until brown.  But I cooked it on
v-e-r-y low.  Worth every minute it took at make.  Undoubtedly, I shall make this soup again.

How can you go wrong with cinnamon and banana? add coffee and yum-o. This is mild and tasty and takes about90 sec's to make. I heated the milk in the micro and it was done in a flash. Mandy, I'm loving your coffee's!

You gotta have this with kids -- I mix up a big batch and pack it for trips, along with small disposable drinking cups to pass around the car.  Keep it in the cooler though; M&Ms may not melt in your hand but they sure will in a hot car.  :)

Delish! When I first came across the recipe I was just a little skeptical. Worcestershire sauce? Who'd have thought! I did make a few changes. First of all, I reduced the amount of worcestershire. For an 8 lb turkey breast I only used the 3Tbs. Also(from force of habit/Thanksgiving tradition), I put 1 chopped apple, 1 small onion and about 2 Tbs of dried rosemary both in the cavity and on top of the turkey. Not sure if it made a differance but my Granny would have approved. By the time I made it home from work and attempted to place the turkey on the serving platter, it literally fell apart! We just pulled it apart and sat down for a no-fuss Sunday dinner on Thursday. Thanks for sharing! My family and I both thank you.

This was terrific.  I made it exactly as written; I only wish I'd doubled the recipe so we'd have some leftovers.  This is now my new favorite cucumber salad.  The blend of flavors was just fabulous, and the texture was great -- very crunchy.  Thanks so much for posting this!
this is good bread

Fabulous!!  The sauce really makes these enchiladas (and I used my food processor instead of a blender bc it was going to get dirty anyway from shredding the cheese).  This makes a lot, which is great bc I plan to freeze the leftovers in indivdual servings.  I was afraid of all the serranos, but there was enough tomatillos and cilantro to balance it all out.  I used to poach boneless, skinless breasts but skin on/bone in is the only way to go.  I did use flour tortillas bc of personal preference, and sour cream bc I had some I wanted to use up.  I also find that the monterey jack is better than cheddar here too.

I made this with fresh pumpkin and it was excellent.  I subbed two cups of pumkin for the can of pumpkin.  I topped mine with chopped pecans.  I would recommend this recipe to anyone.  Simply delicious.  My family loved it.

Yummmmmy! I followed the last reviewer and replaced half the oil with applesauce. I also used regular tub margarine and added 1 TBSP of instant coffee. I left the nuts out of the actual muffins, but doubled the amount in the topping. I did a few each with pistachios, walnuts, peanuts and macadamias. All of them were really good. We have been dreaming about them ever since!
We liked this dish but next time I think I'll add a few things to jazz it up a bit. Thanks for sharing this :)
Once you get past the way they look cooking in the Dr. Pepper they are AWESOME!

Wow.  This is the best chocolate cake recipe I have ever used - and I have tried a fair few.  I didn't have any white suger in the house (crazy - i know) so i used two cups of soft brown sugar insteed, and it worked perfectly.  Thanks a million
This is wonderful. It's going to be part of our dinners alot!

Total comfort food!  I made it as written minus the green pepper. It reminded me of a thick stew, but it went great over rice. I ground up some of the leftovers (it makes a lot) and fed them to my delighted nine-month old.
These are great!  I add to my Dh lunchbox.  Sometimes I add raisins.  I also like to sneak in some flaxmeal  :)  I have made these a few times and will continue to make!  Thanks for posting!!
My cake turned out overcooked and my frosting melted and separated.  Didn't work for me.  Sorry.

This was really good, except I just really didn't like the flavor of the bell pepper with the sauce. Could be just me :). After picking them out I liked this a lot and will definitely keep this recipe. Thanks!
I liked this...it was a change from the normal garlic chicken pizza with its Chinese flavor.

(I halved the recipe) In a hurry this morning to feed 4 adults and 5 kids, when I realized I only had a smidge of store bought syrup left. I had all the ingredients except the maple extract, so I just added the finished recipe to the syrup I already had. Topped the pancakes with the syrup mixture, diced nectarines & bannanas. EVERYONE GOBBLED IT UP. This was SUPER EASY TO MAKE. I like the fact of no refrigeration. But, next time, I will MAKE SURE TO HAVE MAPLE EXTRACT on hand.
its great !!!!!!!update: just pour it over brownies n serve with a scoop of vanilla icecream u wud be in seventh heaven yummmy!!
I made this for an afternoon treat for my DH and he really enjoyed it! He never knew I used skim milk! Thank you Mary!

The cake itself was good here, but didn't care for the pie-filling in it. It seemed like the apples were too mushy. Maybe next time I'll make my own pie-filling with more tart/crunchy apples. 

Very easy to make. I made this on Panic when I realizes my peaches were bad and had nothing else to make for company. Thanks for the save.

I looooove rhubarb and CountryLady's picture is gorgeous!! A great recipe Gerry, I reduced the sugar to 1 1/2 cups and it was perfect for us. I just love the tart rhubarb with the creamy sweet custard-like filling!

An excellent, easy recipe!  I used baby back pork ribs, cooked them for 6 hrs and then finished them off in the oven with foil and then took off the foil the last few mins.  I used sweet baby Ray's, but next time I'll use something else as I thought it was a tad too sweet.  Tx for any easy recipe.

These were very good. My pan was a 9x9 so it wasnt as thick as it should have been, but still was tasty. I will definately make these again and I will go and buy the right size pan. Thank you for a recipe that my hubby can eat without wondering if its loaded with fat.
This is supper easy and a lot of flavor; i used fresh frozen basil and goat cheese.  Will make this often!  Thanks

The flavor was pretty good but we found the brownies rather dry. I only baked them for 25 minutes so I think it was because there isn't as much fat as the recipe I usually use. I added about 1/4 cup of powdered sugar to the icing to make it more of a frosting consistency. Quick and easy to make. Thanks for sharing.

Made this with Paula Red apples just picked, very good, easy.  Next time I would put some cinnamon on the apples before rolling them up in the crescents, and maybe some in the juice-butter mixture as well, since it was a little bland as written.  A crowd-pleaser!

These are superb! I made them exactly as directed, but in a cake pan. It looked elegant and smelled heavenly. I would probably call it a cheasecake tart. The crust is almost like shortbread and the dish melts in your mouth. It was extremely fast and easy and very impressive. I served it with fresh fruit and it was a big hit. This is definitely a keeper and is what i'll go to when i need something impressive and easy.

Talk about comfort food.  This was it. This gets the automatic 5 star because DD loved these. She ate then with mustard :) But DH and I really liked the stew. Be careful  to simmer this on LOW. I simmered it too high and had to add about 1/2 cup more broth. I used ground turkey instead of pork, I also browned in a non stick pan with a little cooking spray. Will definately make this again.

Before I give my review I'd like to let a few things be known upfront. I am somewhat a beginner cook and I certainly have never cooked an eggplant before. This recipe gave me a boost in my confidence that I can become a good cook. 

This dish is fabulous! Amazingly easy to put together. The ingredients listed here are a perfect measurement of everything. No waste and no skimping. I served the eggplant over regular spaghetti noodles and a store bought spaghetti sauce. Thank you, this is a keeper.

This was great! I had already decided on this dish for dinner when I realized that I was out of breadcrumbs, so I subbed wheat germ, and it worked perfectly - you couldn't tell the difference! I also only had 2 chicken breast halves, so I cut those in half and pounded them out, so they would be easier to roll - worked great and there was more than enough to feed the 3 of us. We all loved this! Thanks!

TO DIE FOR MUFFINS!!!So moist and delicious!!!  I can't imagine using another banana muffin recipe after trying this one.  My family loved these and they are a new favorite in our house.  I did not make any changes and cooked for eighteen minutes in 350 degree oven.  
Thanks so much!!!

We really loved this Sauce. I was unsure what to expect and was surprised at the wonderfully vinegary taste .... We love horseradish and were a little disappointed that it took the back burner. Our guest loved it and so did we. I would make this again, but would use fresh horseradish to bring it over the top. Great entry!

I made these true to the recipe and found that they were a little bland.  It also seemed that there was too much "crumb" mixture on the top.  I had read many of the reviews and should have included some fruit topping as many others had- I'm sure I would have enjoyed them more.  They are very easy to make though so I will probably try again.

This is one of THE best recipes I've had from Taste of Home magazine!  I use the broiler when I fix it:  NOTE:  Salmon can be broiled instead of grilled.  Place the fillet on a greased broiler pan.  Broil 3-4 inches from heat for 6-8 minutes or until fish flakes easily with fork.
It is most defintely a keeper!
I make something like this everytime I have leftover mashed potatoes. I've never used the flour before but think I will from now on. It makes them hold together better.

Okay, I did some tweaking on this one....
First, gotta have some veggies...so I saute'd diced green pepper with the onions and garlic.  I used 1lb of ground turkey instead of beef...I added about 1 generous tsp of basil to the sauce. 
I added two eggs to the cottage cheese and about 1/2 c. parmesan to the cottage cheese mix. (Next time I might add 1/4 c minced parsley to it)
On the top layer I mixed in some Mozzarella with the cheddar cheese on top.  
This was an outstanding dish that my family loved.  It's good enough to serve to guests! Try my additions and see if you like them!

Just like my mother made! This is so easy and everyone loves it. We never used the Parmesan Cheese, but it sounds good, so I'll try it the next time I make this. Also, I have only used regular rice and it turns out perfect everytime.
Fantastic!!  I made this and was planning on canning it, but it smelled so good all day cooking that I decided to have 1/2 for dinner and can the rest.  Thanks for a super recipe!

Made this tonight, and ventured out!  I poured it over lightly sauteed fresh asparagus, and topped with crisp, smoked bacon chunks spread over.  This is sublime!  I can see a lot of varied uses.  The recipe is simple, directions perfect, and the outcome unbeatable!  Thanks, Oolala! I'll be trying this on a lot of things other than "BBQ".

I followed your directions to a T and bbq a thick sirloin steak, resulting in an incredibly tender, juicy steak that was oh so flavorful, it was robust and savoury. I loved the addition of the lemon juice and olive oil. I will always make my steak this way now. Nimz you rock.  Thanks so much for sharing.

This is a great recipe. I originally forgot to zest my oranges so put some lemon zest in instead so mine was an orange lemon cordial. Fantastic as there are no unnatural preservatives or colours added like store bought.
Thanks for posting, will make this again!

This was definitely the easiest chocolate cake I've ever made. At first the boiling water sounded peculiar, but it is the ingredient that makes this recipe special. I frosted the cake, but after tasting it I knew it wasn't necessary. I warmly recommend.

My daughter doesn't like sandwiches (makes lunch bags difficult!) but gave the "go-ahead" when she saw your photo. I used Recipe #117322 (since I had it on hand) and it worked really well, since it makes really puffy rolls I didn't even need to let rise for the second time). They turned out like your photo, too! This is the third day I've put them in my daughter's lunch and I haven't heard any complaints. Thanks Calee!

Roxygirl
Liked this very much. A simple no fuss recipe. Very delicious
very tasty!
My husband liked it, but the rest of the family did not like the peanut taste.
You can't get any easier than this! I used a chicken & rib bbq sauce and followed the recipe as written.  Will definitely make again!

I only used half the worchestershire sauce, and it was still much too prominent in the finished dish.  Either that, or it was the vinegar.   I'm sure it's a matter of taste, and others might enjoy it.  The pork chops were tender and flavorful.

Excellent cake! Everybody loved it! I used vanilla buttercream icing and it was sooo good! Next time I'd like to try chocolate icing. The directions were very clear and this was very easy to prepare. And I got to brag that I made a "homemade cake" LOL! Thanks!
This recipe was so easy and so delicious.  I made it with a simple raita and everybody devoured it.  The only thing I did differently was use half whole wheat flour and half all purpose.

Very very good! I have tried many blondie recipes over the years but I still haven't found one that is a kepper. Finally, my search has reached its end.  I will definitely make these again - and I think that I might add some butterscotch or cinnamon chips to the batter next time as well.  Thanks Pan Nan and Al Roker for such a great recipe.
Mmm...quick and easy and so delicious :) I prefer it with ham and I can take or leave the salsa...it's good both ways.  Thanks for submitting this great recipe!

This was very tasty! DH and kids really liked it.  I used an 11 oz pack of spicy chicken sausage and 3 bone-in chicken breasts instead of thighs.  I removed the chicken from the bone once it was cooked, chopped it up and put it back in to absorb the sauce before serving. I also didn't add the celery as I didn't see it in the ingredient list--we didn't miss it.

These are awesome!! I thought I would have a problem with the ham but didn't. What I did have a problem with was the cheese, it did not stick to the dough. But that was no problem, about 5 minutes before I took them out of the oven I sprinkled the cheese over them. I used Recipe #71360 so I don't know if that would be the problem. I will make these again and try Kittencal's bun recipe! I have so many ideas of what else to put in these, like pepperoni and mozzarella cheese, then DS can dip it in sauce!! These is a great recipe, Calee!! Thanks for posting.
These were awesome and they were so simple to make.  I forgot to buy the liquid smoke, but they were still really good!!  Thanks!

Yep, this is a good one for sure. I made a large cup of this the other day except I never have fresh ginger on hand so I used a sprinkling of ground ginger. I also added a bit of honey, too. This is zingy, with a bit of tart and a bit of bite. THanks, Mirj. :)  Had to add, on an ironic, punnish note, that the lyrics Mirj used to title this excellent drink recipe came from a song called "Jitterbug" which I grew up listening to.  This drink won't leave you jittery at all, though, lol! :)

What a lovely cake!  The texture is so light and airy! I ran short of granulated sugar so added 1/3 cup brown sugar to make up the volume. At 35 minutes convection baking time, the cake tested clean and the sides had started to pull away. It was sweet enough for me w/o the frosting so I just garnished it with some sifted cocoa (and saved another inch or so on my hips ;-)).  Thanks for posting this super recipe!

I made this for my husband and I but we had a difference of opinion.  He loved it, especially the sauce over rice.  I on the other had didn't like it.  I thought it sounded good but after I tasted it I thought the onion soup overpowered the sauce.

Outstanding, outstanding! I was running out of time tonight, and had just gotten some organic chicken thighs and legs from our local store. When I rubbed the Hungarian hot paprika, cumin, and S&P right into the chicken and browned it in the oil. I moved the chicken off to the side a bit, and added the plantains to brown in the browned bits. Terrific! I put the chicken in the pot/with plantains and added a bit of wine with the onions and reduced until it was a juicy bit of delicious topping. We will be making this again, and soon. Thanks, Toni!

Oh for the love....these are MARVELOUS!  The texture is melt-in-your-mouth!  I sometimes have trouble with from scratch cake as it tends to be tough but these are divine.  I would strongly recommend using the coconut milk as it really adds a depth of flavor that an extract wouldn't.  These aren't too sweet so when you pipe on the icing, it's the perfect combo of levels of sweetness.  I am going to make a second double batch tonight. ALso, these were quite easy to put together and quick to bake.  FANTASTIC once again Bev!!!!
You MUST make these! So easy and so delicious! You can't eat just one! Truly a crowd pleaser.

Can I give this 10 stars?!! I am not even a huge fan of peppermint flavor and I thought these were outstanding! I used low-fat sweetened condensed milk and melted 14 oz. of Ghiradelli's 60% dark chocolate chips in the microwave. I made made some changes based on comments from other reviewers. I omitted the shortening completely, formed the patties into balls and flattened them onto a parchment paper lined sheetpan then froze them overnight. After I covered them with chocolate, I again froze them on the parchment paper lined sheetpan! They were creamy and refreshing and I've already been told I have to make these (at the very least) for every special occasion to come! Thanks!!
Added Tomatoes.  It was delicious.

For the life of me I can't figure out what I am doing wrong with this cake! I have made it 4 times now and I give up. The first time I made it it was wonderful. Light, fluffy, everyone loved it. So, I thought, I should make this again!! Well, the second through 4th times I tried the recipe it was disaster. I have read and re-read the recipe to make sure I am doing everything correct and can not figure out what i am doing wrong. The cake is fallen, heavy and tastes terrible. I gave up trying to get the cake to cook through after 8o minutes. This one goes in my disaster file. If anyone knows what i am doing wrong let me know, because when this cake comes out right it is terrific, but when it dosen't it is TERRIBLE.
Well, I decided to give it one more try, cause I hate to admit defeat, donchaknow. This time Yipee! Success! As the first time I made the cake, it was terrific, we all enjoyed it a ton. So, I a revising my rating and giving the cake 5 stars.
What went wrong? I have no idea, but the last two times I have done this now it has turned out fine. Same everything...different result.

Wow, this was wonderful.  I wasn't able to get smoked sausages, so used fresh herb & garlic chicken sausages.  I used a full can of tomato puree instead of juice.  Other than that I followed the recipe.  It was easy to put together at 5am & the aroma when we walked in the door was fabulous.  Served with crackers.  Thanks Paula for this keeper.

I used leg quarters, which required longer baking time, one hour.  The chicken was truly scrumptious.  I basted with the chicken broth while the chicken cooked and I made the plantains separate. The chicken is very flavorful and I imagine it is even better baking on the onions and plantains, however I had the satisfy the onionphobes in my family and leave them out!
mmmmmmm!  This was very good!  Didn't change anything.

Delicious! Made this for DH's birthday along with recipe#89207 as Marg suggested. I live in a very humid area so took Marg's advice and used 2/3 cup water. Mine did fall slightly as it cooled but was still quite moist without being heavy or thick. Thanks for sharing the recipe!

Made for PAC Fall '07.

When I read this recipe I thought there is no way this is going to work but I kept thinking about how good it sounded.  So I gave it a try and well let's just say that my blood sugar hasn't been this high in a long time.  I could eat the whole thing but then I would probably be over the toilet the rest of the night.  Everyone should try this recipe.

Isn't this a Sri Lankan dish? This is excellent by the way. I've had this many times while I was there and have been making it for a while since returning home. Its great plain too, hot out of the pan with some butter....yummy!

This is great! This saves me the high cost of mayonnaise. I hardly ever use a full jar. Even when I buy those little jars that cost over $3. Now I can cook all the wonderful recipes I've seen on Zaar that call for mayonnaise.  Hurray! I used white wine vinegar in mine. It was delicious! Thanks!!

I could not find any sheets of fruit roll ups only the strips so I made the "insides" and rolled the rollup strip around it.  I also could not find licorice laces so I used fruit flavored twizzlers.  Ours tasted like bubble gum - maybe because of the flavored candy.  Anyway they were a very cute addition to our meal.  Thanks.

I made this using 1/2 the noodles twice the red curry, frozen peas and added a touch of brown sugar for I enjoy it in my curry`s. I used lean semi frozen boneless pork chops that I ground in the food processor cubing and pulsing a couple times. Thanks for the good eats!
Very nice smoothie.  Made it as stated with the exception of the lime juice.  Very nice snack.
This was great! Very easy to make, and I have never made eggplant before.  We served it with spaghetti and marinara sauce and will definitely make it again.

This really is wonderful. I cut the recipe and only made 1/3 because there are only 3 us these days. My husband called it delicious and healthy too! My 18yo son who complains when I cook vegetarian or too many soups devoured a large bowlful without a complaint. I served it with some fresh crusty french bread. This is a keeper! Thanks Larry! I'm sure we will make this again and again. It looks like it would freeze well so next time maybe I will make the full recipe.

Not too often do I find a recipe that my entire family enjoys!  I have a 6 year old and a 5 year old and they both loved it!  I used boneless porkchops instead of chicken and added some waterchestnuts!  Amazing recipe!  Thanks for posting it!!

Very easy recipe. Cake turned out great, the only thing I did not like was the cake was a little dry. Next time I will add some pineapple juice and a little more butter and brown sugar for the topping. Other than that is was great. Thanks for the easy recipe.
This is a good quick fix meal for dinner. I used canned tomatoes and ledtovers were even better the next day. Will make again.
We make this once at least once a week.  If I cannot find red chili pepper, I use red pepper flakes. Leftovers are great for lunch and easier to pack than salad with dressing on the side.

This was so easy to make and was delicious!  I halved the recipe and it turned out great.  Even my boyfriend, who says he doesn't like meatloaf, liked it!  It was nice and dense and the perfect amount of garlicyness. :)  Thank you!

This are delicious.  I made the carrot version and added some chopped dried cherries instead of raisins.  I also made 6 large muffins instead of 12 regular size.  I skipped the glaze.  For a breakfast muffin, it really doesn't need it.  Made for Fall 2007 PAC.

I made these as the recipe stated except I used green onions, I doubled the garlic and used only monterrey jack cheese.  I baked them at 400 degrees for 10 minutes, then topped with the cheese and baked another 5 minutes.  They were perfect with the pepper still having a nice crunch in contrast to the softer filling.  I loved these!  I also had some seasoned hamburger so I made a couple with a meat filling topped with cheese and my DH liked them also.  Thank you for a delicious recipe that will continue to show up on my dinner table!

Super easy recipe and delicious!!  I made half a recipe and put in a 9x9. I used my apple peeler/corer/slicer to make thin slices.  It was ALL GONE!!  It would have been great with some vanilla ice cream, too.  Thanks for the wonderful recipe!

These are great, my kids LOVE them.  I've made them several times. It's especially good with that homemade salsa.  A great break from the ordinary taco dinner.
Thanks Bekah
These are excellent cookies. I used a swiss chocolate cake mix and I did not melt the butter. My kids loved them. Thanks for the recipe.
My hubby really liked this.  I used sweet potatoes instead of regular ones.

Wow. I had a bunch of brats leftover from a party and found this recipe. Fantastic. I was awarded 
"Most popular son-in-law" for making this soup.....and I could use the brownie points.

loved this recipe...tried it out for hubby's bday....was AWESOME to say the least.. i stuck to d suggestion of reducing the sugar to one&a half cups...made a mild coffee cream frosting...used two round baking pans...best bit is d cake remains really moist even after a day in d fridge :-)
This is so delicious. My whole family devoured it ! I increased the the aborio rice to 2 cups and used 1 litre of chicken stock plus 1 cup of hot water.

I liked it ok but it was a bit lacking on flavor (aside from fish flavor)  Perhaps the addition of a few spices might improve this.  Also it was a bit greasy.  I would suggest using sour cream instead of mayonnaise.
This is one of my favorite foods.  My mom used to make this with all kinds of "stoups" during the winter.  I'm wicked excited to have found it!!!!

This made a nice high loaf in a 9" loaf pan. I actually had buttermilk to use up, so I didn't use the soured milk, but everything else was as written. DH took all but one piece (my piece) to work with him (sliced, buttered while warm, and topped with cinnamon sugar), and was quite miffed when his two guys ate nearly all of it on him (lol). Nice recipe for a classic, thanks for posting! Made for PAC Fall 07

I liked this very simple, easy focaccia.  I followed the instructions exactly, using red onions.  But when the time came to put the bread together (after the ten minute rest) I had to leave--so the dough had an hour or so to rise.  I knocked it down and then shaped it and baked it and the extra rising time did not seem to do any harm--perhaps it was a bit "breadier" as a result.  Th topping is delicious.
this was soooooooooo good! used a whole pint of cream, and doubled the lemon and orange zest and mint. also added a little more lemon juice.  absolutely loved it!

I did the recipe for 1 bread and used 3/4 cup of sugar.  It was enough sweet for us.   I used margarine.  After 60 minutes, the bread was cooked.  It was perfect.  The smell was yummy!  The texture is moist.  One of my favorite.  Thanks Mommy Diva :)
Made this for my bruschetta last night. Very simple to prepare, very good garlic taste. Thank you.
This was a very good cheesecake but we didnt care for the crust.  I used an orange marmalade glaze on it.

These are a big hit here! I had a craving for something apricot, so I baked these up. I also added about a half a cup of slivered almonds. Very good, except next time I may add less white chocolate chips. They can get overly sweet when you get a cookie with a lot of them in it.
Thanks!

This was awesome, I made it last night to go along with the Greek Phyllo Stuffed Chicken and we were blown away.  You can also steam the vegetables for 20 minutes and then combine with tomato sauce if you want it faster...

grandma2969, this is an excellent frosting.  I had this at a friend's house. She made a vanilla cake, frosted it with Brown Sugar Frosting and served it fresh sliced peaches. This recipe is in my permanent recipe collection. Thank you for sharing a frosting recipe that is great on virtually any cake.

So easy and so good!  I will definitely make this one again. I used whole wheat orzo and it made a great side dish.

This is the most amazing marinade recipe.  It makes a lot though, which also makes it perfect for OAMC and freezing with meat.  I ended up spliting it into thirds.  In one bag was two boneless, skinless chicken breasts, and two bags had 2 boneless pork chops each (I could have easily quartered this though since I only had a small amount of meat in each bag).  I then froze all three.
I did leave out the meat tenderizer, simply because I didn't have any.  I also used 1 t each of garlic salt and onion powder (again all I had).
I cooked the chicken for dinner tonight and it was amazing.  I took the meat out this morning to thaw in the marinade (thawed in the fridge).  My husband remarked on how nicely the meat was coated when he grilled it.
The meat is perfectly sweet, not hurt your teeth, dessert sweet, but a nice sweetness with a hint of tange, almost like a really good barbeque sauce.  
The only warning I would give is because of the high sugar content from the dressing, ketchup and sugar itself watch the meat closly when you grill to prevent burning.

SO good! I made a few changes: egg beaters instead of egg, skim milk instead of whole, and I also added some paprika, wheat germ, and parmesan cheese to the dry ingredients.  Super quick recipe, definitely a keeper!
This is a great recipe! It was fairly easy to make and the cake turns out very light. Just delicious! I will definitely make this again.
This was so yummy.  I will be making this one again.  I used hokken noodles and also green curry paste as thats what i had.  I also added some corn.

This recipe is not as daunting as it would appear.  
I love that the ingredients are listed individually for each of the four components. Because we were five for dinner, obviously quantities had to be adjusted.  (No hardship; my math is pretty good)
Preparation of each component was made well in advance of the dinner hour, and that is the key to a successful outcome.  Fortunately, these components lend themselves quite nicely to advance preparation.  It was a simple matter of finishing each step just before serving.

1)The Fennel-Pear Puree reheats successfully.

2) The Napa Cabbage in combination with radicchio and spinach leaves  creates a tasty red, white and green complement to an already deliciously crisp and tender squab. Following instructions at Steps 15 and 16 ensured this success completion.

3)  I do not mess with other people's recipes because change creates a different outcome from what was originally intended.  This time, however, while the honey was reheating, and just before brushing the squab skin, with the warm honey,  I did add a dash of Chinese five spice powder to the honey and allowed the birdies to respond with crispness;  I then sliced the breast meat accordingly and presented as instructed.

4)  The serving platter is rectangular. I made a line of the hot Fennel-Pear Puree, from corner to corner creating 4 distinct divisions, for final assembly and presentation. One serving mound of the gingered cabbage and squab into each "division" and a fifth in the centre of the platter, with the squab legs standing up against each "mound" was appealing to the eye.
Four guests and their hostess were absolutely delighted with your recipe, Chef Kate.

Would I recommend this?

Thank you so much Sue. I grew up in "Little Saigon" (Garden Grove, CA) and have recently moved to NJ. I had several Vietnamese friends and we would always go for Pho Bo Vien (I think that's how you say Beef Ball noodle soup) and cafe sua da. Somehow I ended up helping "a little." I just made it again and we loved it. I improvised since both times we didn't have chicken broth. I substituted 2 organic vegetable bouillons (Rapunzel brand is great) with 32oz of water and threw that in when it said to add the broth. I also added a couple of dashes of Chinese 5 spice powder the second time.  Lastly, I used rice noodles instead of bean thread. We are addicts. This is a perfect invaluable recipe for our family and can't wait to make it when my mom and sister visit! Thanks again! We LOVE it. Best of all it is easy!(I know because my friend's mom used to make pho at home and it was a PROCESS!)

I just reviewed these, and I think I hit the wrong button.

I made these twice.  The first time, I don't believe I got all the moisture out before putting them in the oven.  They were a little limp and not great.  I gave them a second try.

The second time, I drained them on Bounty wrapped in kitchen towels.  I cooked them covered for about 10 min.  I then cooked them another 10 min.  I took out about half and returned the remainder to the oven.

The ones I took out a little early were good, but sure were not "crunchy."  The ones I left in the oven another 5 min. or so were wonderful; crunchy; fully baked. 

The next time I do these, I will try some cayenne pepper or garlic salt.  There's lots of room for different seasonings here, depending on what you're serving them with.  Make sure you don't take them out early.  They are still good, but you'll miss the crunchy part!!!

Loved these but my icing turned out too runny.  Easy to fix though.

This was very good.  The boys really enjoyed it, and that is more than half the battle around here!  Thanks Boomette1!

I served this as a side dish with recipe #176499 and recipe #84440. It was a totally decadent side dish, and did make about 8-10 servings (although as a main dish I would say closer to 4). Wonderful.  The duck was very crispy all the way around.  I drained the oil off, then added brandy to the drippings and some peach jam to make the sauce.  My guests were very impressed and dinner was wonderful.

Made this for a large group & the comments never stopped.  Everyone loved it and couldnt get enough of it. In fact we ran out well before everyone got some.  Didn't change a thing. A lot of chopping and work but WELL worth it.

Well,,,if I could give this more than 5 stars I would.  These were fantabulous CQ....

What a delightfully different way to prepare broccoli.I really wouldn't change a thing.  I love the combo of sweet and savory.

This is a wonderful drink.  I followed all the ingredients except I didn't have any grape juice.  I loved the blend of flavors.  I will have to try it again with the grape juice. Made for Please make my recipe.
Yum! It's DOES taste like a Tootsie Roll! Plus it couldn't be easier. Freddy Cat says thanks for the drink! Made for the Zaar tag game.

I tried this the other night, and the mac n' cheese hater in my house was won over!  So easy, so creamy... I can't wait to make it again.

We LOVED this! This is the BEST Egg Drop Soup we've had! I made 2 servings with regular chicken broth and all of the ingredients. I wish I made 8 servings! This easy recipe is a keeper! Freddy Cat says thanks for the chicken and eggs! Made for the Zaar Stars tag game.

I've been making these mints for the past two Christmases with much success. I'm not a big fan of Peppermint Patties but those in my family that are (and that is the whole reason I made them in the first place), say that these are better than York's because the chocolate to peppermint ratio can be controlled to an individual's likings. I like to dry out the discs for a nice long time and then fridge them so that they are nice and hard before I coat them. In addition to fridging the discs, I find that the thicker I cut them, the more they look like the real deal. Depending on who I'm making them fore, I coat once, cool and then dip again. Also, these look so pretty wrapped in red and green candy foils for the holidays. This is a time-consuming recipe but well worth the praise at the end! Enjoy!
One of my favorite comfort foods.  Great taste and easy to make and get on the table.  My kind of recipe!  Thank you.
Amazing.  Great for my girlfriend who doesn't drink Guinness but loves Kahlua.  Now we can have matching drinks at night! :D

This recipe is very similiar to the naan bread that I make from this site.  It is easy to make, and the ingredients are all something most have on hand already. We are having it tonight with Kittencal's Greek Salad.  Yum!  Thank you Najwa for a fabulous recipe that will surely become a staple in our home!

These rolls were alright, but the sauce is fantastic.  The sauce, at least, is sure to appear around here again.  Since the sauce is quite spicy, I elected to serve it entirely on the side to be applied to each individual's taste.

Made this several times- lost the recipe-OMG- found it again! Thank goodness I found it again- this stuff is fantastic and easy.  Makes great gifts! Thanks for posting. Can't wait to get this made again- Off to the kitchen I go;-)

Excellent, easy recipe - my kids absolutely loved it!  4 stars only because I personally could have used a bit more flavor, but really nothing else to improve on.  I used seasoned panko breadcrumbs for a nice crispy topping - yum!  Thanks for sharing a great recipe.

This was great! It does make alot so after couple days of eating it as cabbage soup I added tiny clams, bacon and tiny diced potatoes to make it a Manhatten Clam Chowder. It was fantastic. A good base eaten as is or add your own ingredients and create another soup.

Makes GREAT cupcakes... Is a favorite at my daughter's fourth grade class. Teacher seems to like them too. I do cut down on the sugar by half and add 4 tbs of honey. Other then that.. Ty so very much for this great chocolately heaven cake!

I am making a second batch of cupcakes out of this right now for some friends for Valentines Day. The first turned out great; it was moist and had a good chocolate flavor. I took the suggestion for the boiling water and used between 2/3 and 3/4 of a cup and the cake turned out perfect.

the other moms asked for recipe.
This is DELICIOUS! Even the picky DH that does not eat cheesecake ate it and asked for more. Moreover it's so simple to prepare. Thanks Bev.

DH loved this casserole, very tasty. I used fresh broccoli and fresh mushrooms cus I didn't have frozen or canned. Worked very well.  I also saved some of the cheese to sprinkle on top, just for pretty sake.  It was quite delicious and I willmake it again, thanks for posting.

Oh my - this is wonderful!  I was only able to find a 2 1/2 pound turkey with bone-in.  I don't think the bone-in mattered because the meat was cooked so perfectly, the bone just fell out anyway.  I added all ingredients at once since I turn the crockpot on and go to work.  I cooked for the full 10 hours and made gravy on the stove with the juices. As other reviewers said, I really can't think of a reason to roast a turkey now that I've found this great recipe!!

Fabulous muffins!  I absolutely loved the allspice and nutmeg! And the topping was the finishing touch to make them match their title!  I got 11 muffins out of this recipe.  It is a nice dense muffin that does not break apart when eating.  I made this for the "Share the Love" tag game in the Photo Group.  I'll be making them often now for my family!  Thanks Charlotte!

MizzNezz, these brownies are scrumptious! What a huge success: fast, simple, de-lish! I used pecans instead of walnuts, and allowed another 10 minutes baking time.

I'll never buy brownie mix again.
I love this recipe. I used to make this in the early 70's, but I lost the recipe...and believe me I've searched for it! Thank you for giving me back my favorite homemade salad dressing recipe.
A lovely moist cake. Not all that chocolatey, but the dates give it a rich flavor. My kids helped me make it... and gobble it up!

This came out perfect.  I served it with fresh green beans and tomatoes.  I made egg noodles with just olive oil and parsley.  This was a meal that complimented itself perfectly.  I did use one whole onion coarsley chopped instead of the shallot.

A really nice break from hot dogs on a bun.  A lot less carbs too.

Wow!  Very close to tasting like deep-fried chicken and SO juicy.  I loved the flavor, even though I cut the cayenne in half (due to another reviewer's suggestion) because I have a toddler. Absolutely the best ribs I have ever had - ANYWHERE! I used Recipe # 59772 with boneless counry style ribs. Have made this numerous times. I imagine this is someones Grandma's recipe.  Makes a wonderful moist cake just don't let anyone (kids) stomp around in the kitchen, or cake might fall. Boy I used to get it if I made my Grandma's cakes fall lol
Was very pleased with this recipe. I made them yesterday evening and they are so good.

OMG....this is awesome.  I like eggplant but my kids didn't.  However when they tasted this they ALL ate it, and liked it.  When they asked what it was they were a little stunned....lol. Pan fried eggs, move over! These were such a great change from our normal scrambled eggs. Even my picky, PICKY eater said,"These are really good," and had seconds. I am sure you could get that from salsa if you followed the suggestions and served it with it but I think maybe some spices in the cooking might be good too. I will make this again but I will play around with it.

Very good muffins.  I substituted some of the butter for apple sauce, and couldn't tell the difference.  I also added about 1/4 C of cinnamon chips.  Yum!  I made large muffins, and came up with 9.  Pretty light and fluffy!
I made this for a birthday party when i had no time to buy cake mix.  not only was this cake better, but it was almost as easy.  Thank you for posting such a great recipe!

We really enjoyed this...bacon, eggs, cheese, shallots....OH YEAH!
These were very good! Lovely flavor and I didn't think they were too thin. Thanks!

YUMMY!  I made this with an Italian Vegetable soup and we all loved it! Thanks for a great recipe that I will definitely be making again!
