Invest in a pressure cooker and your meal will be done in a fraction of the time and taste every bit as good!

This was a very easy and tasty risotto.  It was so creamy and extra cheesy, just the way we like it.  I also used arborio rice as that was what I had in the pantry.  We'll be making this recipe again.  Made for ZWT4.

I enjoy Satay without the  customary peanut sauce and this filled the bill.  I cut back on the tumeric & curry and added some Pico de Gallo. Marinated the chicken all day.I served them as the meat for dinner alongside oven roasted sweet potato chips, whole steamed green bean & steamed carrots -  Lovely dinner thanks Magic Duck

I personally can't stand the thought of eating liver but my husband LOVES it.  I made this for him and he said it was better than Luby's!!!  Plus you can't beat the price - this is probably one of the least expensive recipes in my cookbook!  Thanks!!!
Thank you for this recipe.  I am trying to replace as much as I can that is store bought with high fructose corn syrup in it.  This syrup has a good consistency.
Awesome cookies.  Great to make with kids since you don't have to wait for dough to chill.

These are really top-notch, fudgy brownies!!  I used Ghirardelli 100% Cacao unsweetened chocolate and I melted in a double boiler instead of microwave.  Used whole wheat pastry flour.  I used 2/3 cup evaporated milk and only 1 1/2 cups powdered sugar for my icing because I don't like how sweet powdered sugar can get.  The icing was still super sweet and sets up, it's just a little creamier.  These brownies are the ultimate, thank you!!!

This was a great launching pad! My modifications: Added a green onion, about a cup of sliced cherry tomatoes, a tbsp of fresh lime juice and a couple of chopped fresh sage leaves. Also omitted the water and used 4 cups of veggie broth instead. Served it as a meal topped with vegan sour cream. Outstanding result - thanks for sharing.

While definitely low-fat, and plenty healthy, this dish is lacking in flavor, and I ADDED 2 cloves of garlic!  One hour at 350 is definitely not long enough for cook time either... even with a 3 minute pre-cook of the eggplant in the microwave before hand, the vegetables were ALL too crunchy at the end.  Next time I'll try a lower temp for a longer time.
UM-O!  This was very good and quick and easy for a weeknight meal.  Made for Tastebud Tickling Travellers for ZWT4.

GREAT! Flavorful, healthy and Vegan. I made this with a mix of red lentils and brown lentils. I used ghee and the optional black onion seeds. I doubled all of the spices and am glad I did. I cooked it almost twice the amount of time for a thicker dal. I think next time I would only use 2-3 cups of water. Freddy Cat says thanks for the yummy food! Made for the ZWT4.

yummy! although mine did not look like tink's LOL! This was very good and fairly easy. It had a light italian flavor. I thought it could use more garlic and more cheese. I did add the cheese into the mix as well as on top, but I like cheese :D
Thanks Kate for posting such a delicious, moist cake recipe.  A new family favourite for sure!

Made & reviewed for ZWT 4 ~ Kumquat's Kookin' Kaboodles! I couldn't resist trying this torte as it is hot today & I wanted something cold & delicious. The family was super impressed, as this is both beautiful & delicious. It is also not hard to make! Thanks Sue for a great recipe!

This started out as a disaster. I followed the recipe exactly. Used whole wheat rice and green onion. I started this in a pan making 2 burgers 1/2 cup each. They just didn't bind together enough for me to flip them and eventually I ended up mixing it all up and making a burrito out of it for my 6 year old. She was happy, with cheese, extra salsa and sour cream. Next I tried 1 burger using 1/4 cup of the mixture. I cooked the bottom and then put it under the broiler to stiffen up the top. It sort of worked. It fell apart a little but in manageable pieces. The taste was ok. I ate it on whole wheat toasted bread. It was much better after adding a piece of cheese. I have the left over mixture sitting in the fridge. Maybe it will be better after sitting over night. It seems like it needs more of a binder. The rice isn't enough. All in all 3 stars is generous. Sorry, I really wanted this to be good too, especially after all the good reviews.

These are AMAZING!  The flavor and texture were great and the frosting is such a great match.  These really are beautiful cupcakes.  I tinted my frosting a light lime green to hint to the lime flavor and topped with some lime zest with the coconut.

Great creamy mashed potatoes.  I did use low fat milk instead of water and I added just a tad of I can't believe its not butter with salt, garlic powder.  Yummy!!!  i can't tell the difference from my full fat version.

Very good!  A tip for other recipe users, though;  we got the soul seasoning that has salt as the first ingredient (cheapo dollar store kind) and it was pretty salty.  It was still really good, though, and I'm sure it will be better next time.  We just used regular cheddar, too!

These are good!  I liked the suggestion of cutting off the bottoms to make them sit up straight. I put the bottoms inside the pepper so there was no hole and the stuffing wouldn't run out while cooking.  I had enough stuffing to stuff my pepper tops for mini stuffed peppers!  I used Muir Glen fire roasted diced tomatoes and this gave it even more flavor!!  Thanks for this great stuffed pepper recipe!
Excellent shrimp recipe!  Loved the flavor and the easy prep.  Came together very quickly which is a huge plus.  Made for the Tastebud Tickling Travellers during ZWT 4.

I love yukon gold potatoes whem making mashed and these were great! Perfect amount of garlic for us and who wouldnt love cream cheese, sour cream, and butter. Love the tanginess and will definitely be making these again. Made and reviewed for ZWT 4.
I have made this for years, it is great but really rich it can easily serve 12-16 instead of 8 it is super easy and a family fave

OMG this is SO yummy! This is the first time I have eaten kale because we don't really get it in south australia but I bought a bunch at my organic grocer to try. When researching what to do with it I stoked to see it could be eaten raw-no need to destroy all those green nutrients! I would recommend adding 1-2 tbls of lemon juice which is nice w the curry spices. I also used agave nectar instead of sugar and as I had seen in similar recipes I massaged the kale for a couple of minutes to help soften it before refrigerating it. Quite a few other things like tomatoes and red onion would also be nice in this. Also agree with the other reviewer that it is best enjoyed in small doses. Thank you for taking the time to add this recipe.

We loved these mushrooms;I served them with a filet mignon and they were perfect! The onions make them extra special.
I made these for WY4.Thanks for posting,
Rita
We really did not care for this salad at all.  The sour cream really needed something 'more' done to it to make it taste more like a dressing - some herbs?  A bit of tart from vinegar?
Excellent...just like eating warm chocolate pie!
A bit too bland for my taste.

Made this last night in anticipation of a steamy morning. I used only two cups of plain milk, rather than a quart of chocolate milk (which I did not have), and I don't think I would want it to have any more milk in it. Chocolate would make it more mocha, which would also be nice. I look forward to making this more often this summer.
Fantastic!  I left out the anchovies and added some bacon I had left over, otherwise made the recipe as written.  Definitely one I'll be making again.   Made and reviewed for ZWT4.
Love these! I love to have mushrooms and onions when I serve steak and these were perfect. The caraway seed is a nice touch. Made for Zaar World Tour 4 for the Tastebud Tickling Travellers.

This is an excellent recipe for low fat and healthy muffins.  It is very adaptable and always turns out.  I add a ripe banana or two which helps them to rise and makes them more moist.  I also have added different kinds of nuts, cranberries, dates and even strawberries/raspberries.  I have made these muffins many times and they are always a big hit in my family.

I'm giving 5 star just for the idea and a great dinner. Made some changes tho--- we don't like red enchilada sauce, SO--subbed a sauce of Sour Cream lite and mushroom soup. Otherwise, followed the recipe--since I had made the Best Shredded Chicken prior to this.  Awesome!
Made for PotLuck event in Cooking Photos.
Strain the seeds. Added chopped semi-sweet chocolate chips. There was none left from the dinner party to put away!
Tropical & fruity, my kind of drink, yum! made for ZWT 4.

Made this ade up in no time & thoroughly enjoyed it, although I did have to FORCE myself to strain the juice, 'cause I much prefer having all that pulp IN the drink! Still, I followed directions so that I'd get the full brunt of this Romanian drink! Very, very nice! Thanks for sharing! [Made & reviewed while in Eastern Europe during the Zaar World Tour 4]

So delicious and easy to make! It was done cooking after 15 minutes so watch carefully to see when the breadsticks start to turn brown. It is not exactly a "pie" since there's no bottom, which is good for saving fat grams but probably not the best presentation for company. A great quick weeknight meal! Made for the Photo Tag game.

My family loves meatloaf and rated this five stars.  I used a meatloaf mix which my grocery sells (veal, pork and ground chuck) instead of the 2 lbs of ground chuck.  It was delicious.  Thanks Luvin for this recipe.  It's a keeper in my book.
I concur.
This was good, but I like cheese based soups a little thicker.
My husband and I really enjoyed these, thanks! :)

These went so good with our steak yesterday.  I made Recipe #254778 and wanted something good to go with it.  Cooked everything right out on the grill.  The veggies had great flavor with the lemon and the spices.  We loved them!  Melissa
So good! The ribs were falling-apart tender, and so tasty. Thanks!

Very good for a wonderful Sunday supper; used a cheese bread, so didn't add the cheese into the strata.
Made for CameraLess Chefs in Cooking Photos.

I love citrus, so when I saw this recipe, had to try it!!!  I made this in the morning to have later with lunch.  This is so refreshing and I love the combination of the lemons and oranges.  I followed as directed, but cut the recipe in half.  Next time I may even cut back on the amount of sugar or use a sugar substitute.  Thanks Japan for a great recipe!!!
I halved the recipe, and couldn't find my horseradish, so left it out.  This was very good and it was served over a nice wedge of iceberg lettuce. Thanks Lynn! Made for ZWT4.

Whoa mama!  Some advice- let these babies sit overnight before serving...the flavors develop and meld much better together!  Whipped these together yesterday for my dinners this week while DH is away and tried the mixture after I got done cooking it...just so-so.  Reheated one tonight for dinner, topped it with just a bit of 2% cheese, jalapenos and light sour cream (no vegans here) and snarfed it down!!!  So good, so hearty.  Will make often. Thanks so much for the change of pace Chef!
Very good! I mixed some limoncello in the butter sauce as well.

These were very good!   I didn't have scallion so I used freeze dried chives (about 1 tbsp.) and it was too hot to grill outside today! We are having a dangerous heat wave here so I used my grill pan and made them on the stove top.  I served them with jasmine rice and fresh snow peas that I sauteed with corn oil and a few drops of sesame oil.  I used garlic powder on the chops and the snow peas. Thanks for a nice marinade!

This is very good. I used fresh tomatoes and added some extra water. Even my friends 3 year old twins liked it which is great I will make this again but next time I will chop the tomatoes in my food chopper in order to chop it in smaller pieces. Thanks for sharing your recipe. Made for ZWT 4 Creamy  Risotto Challenge.
OMG This is amazing. It was today's lunch and I'll definitely be making it again. Thanks for posting. Made for ZWT4

Thanks for another good one!  Next time the only change I may make is to make sure that when I'm drizzling the extra butter over that the chunks of garlic are spread evenly or use garlic powder.  I'm not a huge fan of getting a bite of chunky garlic, but I do love garlic!  These were excellent!

This was awesome sorbet - the best I've evr had.  I read some of the reviews that said it was too lemony, so I used 1/8 c lemon juice and 1/8 c pineapple juice.  Now if I could just figure out a way to mix in some vodka I'd be in business......
Delicious! I cooked these for a bit less time. I would have never thought to add caraway to mushrooms - the flavors compliment each other so well. Made for ZWT4 by a Jefe de la Cocina.

Five stars for a quick and easy way to make mushrooms that are very tasty. Loved the smell of the caraway seeds when the mushrooms were cooking. DH enjoyed them tonight for supper. Made and reviewed for ZWT 4.

5 stars without a doubt!  Ribs were very tender and flavorful.  We used 4 (12oz) cans of Diet Dr. Pepper (that's all we had on hand).  Since the recipe specifically calls out NOT to use diet, we added about 1/4 C of sugar.  We added enough chicken broth to cover the ribs.  Since we didn't have liquid smoke, we decided to use some wood chips while grilling to give it that smoky flavor; but forgot when the time came.  They came out fantastic anyways.  We definately will be making these again.

Delicious and easy! I didn't have time to drain the yogurt, but it still tasted great.  I used dill weed instead of mint and left out the olive oil.  It was very simple and a great topping for Recipe #81725.
What a great and different way to prepare carrots.  We loved this!  I did add a bit of sugar to sweeten it up a bit.  Thanks for sharing this, Halifax Liz.

DH and I were hungry for ham, we haven't had it for a while. I made ham on a Sunday and we finished it on Wednesday. I figured DH would tell me he was tired of it but he didn't! I used a large can of crushed pineapple, I didn't have pineapple juice! While I was eating it I would scrape out the pineapple from the pan and spread it over my ham. Wonderful!!! I will be following this recipe whenever I make a ham. DH tells me he doesn't like pineapple but after he ate this I tend not to believe that!!!:LOL: Excellent recipe, thanks for posting this!!
Quick and tasty mushroom side dish!  The caraway seeds are a nice touch.  Thanks Um Safia!  Made for ZWT 4.

This was a delicious dish and a great new way for us to cook fresh vegetables! It's very healthy and I loved the fresh flavors. Living in Asia, we did the Asia thing and ate it with rice. ;) My DD's weren't too sure about all the cooked veggies at first, but ended up liking it more than they thought and my oldest even asked for 2nd's. Made for ZWT 4 for our awesome team, Los Jefes de la Cocina!

I only did the bread part, and used a different filling. The bread came out great, light but with a firm texture to support the filling. I think it would work well with smaller, serving-sized shapes as well as in one loaf. I did do two rises, one as a ball of dough and one after being shaped.

I baked this for a Memorial Day BBQ, served it with a scoop of French Vanilla ice cream and it was delicious, moist and very rich. I made it with Kittencalâ€™s Chocolate Buttercream Frosting/Icing, Recipe #89207.  There was a little bit of the cake left over but that only lasted a few hours until people snuck back to polish it off. I am definitely through making cakes from a mix...why should I when I have a winner recipe.
My DH like this salad dressing.  It was good .

Really enjoyed this along with chicken and a salad. I also love Greek style yoghurt and it's really worthwhile tracking down for this recipe. I didn't have a cheesecloth so just squeezed the cucumber dry and left in a strainer a while to drain.

We really liked these!  The only change I would make is to not broil them next time as they dried out a little.  I changed the serving size down to just 2.  Thank you for posting Mama, made for ZWT, please see my rating system as I rate tougher than most.
I wish I could give 10 starts!!  These were awesome, so easy to make and they melt in your mouth.  Great flavor.  The best recipe I've tried, by far.  Thanks so much for posting!!

I made this yesterday for my out of town family. Very easy to put together and very very rich with "Hershey's Perfectly Chocolate Frosting". Every one loved it. I did use a full cup of boiling water and didn't have a problem with the cake falling.

I made a half recipe exclusively for DH and he didn't hesitate to bestow 5 stars after sampling. Then he said "They sure are sweet! I won't be eating these as fast as usual" but he firmly stuck with 5 stars. If this man commented on over sweetness, I'd advise caution. As to my part of the review: I must say that these REALLY spread, fast and far. The dough mounds on the sheet started out at about 3/4 inch high and I ended up with pretty much one cookie of baking sheet size. I'd say to cut back on the butter/shortening or up the amount of flour. I took mine out at 8 mins and got crispy edges on very soft, chewy cookies, perfect! I omitted the nuts because DH isn't a nut fan. I used 2- 50g boxes of Raisinettes for 18 cookies and the chocolate didn't melt at all. Made for Photo Tag.

I was looking through your recipes and found this. It's also my mom's recipe (and probably her mom's). Easy and good. Best on fresh, still warm Challah. I always use chicken fat, not diet friendly but its comfort food. When I make chicken I like to healthy it up by pulling the fat and skin from the bird. I don't waste it, I freeze it for the holidays to use in recipes like this one. Take care and thanks for posting.

It's been so hot here, and I was looking for a good drink to have to quench my thirst.   This one looked so good, I just had to try it.  I used Duncan Donuts coffee, and made it nice and strong.  I used Splenda in mine and it was so good! I also added a squirt of Hershey's chocolate syrup to mine.  WOW! Very  delicious and refreshing on these steamy days.  Kitten, you have a winner here!
Sensational mushrooms! The caraway seeds make such a difference to the overall taste. I also added pinches of dried parsley, mint and oregano. Thoroughly enjoyed for Zaar World Tour.

Yummy, We all like Greek style yoghurt and love we yogurt/garlic/cucumber dips.  The red wine vinegar added a different flavour to the Tzatziki but it was still yummy.  Thank you Sue L - *Made for Zaar World Tour 4*
These could have been fabulous if they weren't so oily/buttery.  Almost swimming in it.

This was an excellent chocolate cake recipe. The cake was moist and worth the extra effort. I first made as cupcakes for my sons class and they loved them however there were alot of crumbs. Then I doubled and baked in my 18x12 pan for my sons birthday and it baked perfectly. Even with the large pan it did not rise to much in the middle. It was a hit from the kids to the grandparents. Thank you for posting.

This is a great cake.  Very rich and moist.  I baked it for my family and it was a huge hit!!!  Instead of boiling water, I boiled some coffee (not instant) and it was wonderful.  Thanks so much for this great find!!

These rock.  BIG TIME>  gone in 5 minutes tops!  I also popped the empty wonton wrappers in the oven for 3 minutes to crisp them FIRST...and I'm glad that i did.  We didn't have any problem with them falling apart or being soggy.

Wow!  I chose this recipe to make for the ZWT Risotto Challenge and it was a success.  Great because I've never made a risotto before, nor had I eaten one.  = )  This was really tasty, had a perfect balance of flavors, and will be repeated in the future.  I used jasmine rice, which might be a no no, but being that I've never had it before, I didn't know any better.  I will try long grain brown sometime soon.  Thanks!!

Delicious!  After a long day at work all I wanted to do was come home to a cooked meal.  That didn't happen but this recipe was so easy enough to put together that my family didn't miss out on a home cook meal.  I used chicken drumsticks instead of thighs and it worked really well.  Thank you MarraMamba - * Made for Zaar World Tour 4*
No wonder they call this Ultimate!  It's the perfect name for these chewy, nutty, chocolatety taste sensations.  I made with walnuts and pecans and everyone devoured them!

I was hankering for juice for a change in this hot weather and I'm so glad I found this! Lemon and orange? Great combination!   I used sugar substitute for this btw.  So refreshing! Totally awesome! Thanks Japan bound! (Made and reviewed for WZT4 EE)
Delicious!
This was dish was wonderful. Watched RR make this on TV a while back and had to give it a try. We enjoyed this dish, it was a different way to make chicken.

This was soooo delicious!!! It is the first time I have ever had rhubarb and I am hooked! We prepared it exactly as described, and it looks just like the photo. I could have eaten the entire thing myself... I hope I can still get rhubarb at the Farmer's Market next week!

A great, easy cake. My batter was thicker than most cake mixes, not thin like the description, but came out great. A little on the sweet side for my tastes, so I cut the sugar back to 1 1/2 cups, and used 3/4 cup of water. It took 30 min. in a 9x13x2" pan lined with tinfoil for easy removal. I made four of them and iced them together for a huge double-layered cake for a goodbye party. It baked up into perfect 1" layers with very little sinking in the middle. Thank you Marg! Will definitely be making this again when I want chocolate cake.

I made this for my sister's birthday and it was a hit. I used dark cocoa and reduced the amount of sugar to 1 1/2 cups. I also subbed coffee extract for 1 tsp of the vanilla. Nice, moist and tender cake. Easy to make and delicious. Thanks for sharing.

We really liked these potatoes.  DH requested to try these and to have them with your Recipe #132765 as part of his father's day meal.  So thanks for doing half the cooking! ;)  The only change I would've made would've been to use less cream cheese (almost tasted like too much of a good thing with all the cream flavor. lol), but that's just our preference.  Thanks!
This was the first time for me to make and I think also eat couscous! It was so delicious, thank you for this easy and tasty recipe. I will be making this more often from now on!

YUM! YUM!  I made this exactly as written.  It was definitely tart, but very refreshing.  My DH loved it as is--7yo DS said he would like it a little sweeter.  Next time I make it (and there will definitely be a next time), I'll use all the sugar syrup.
I didn't have a juicer, so it took me longer than ten minutes to make.  Thanks for posting!  Made and reviewed for ZWT4.

Thank you for posting this recipe! I wanted to take a picture of it but, the cake was gone before l had the camera out. I used 34 cup of coffee and thaught the cake wouldnt turn out but, yes it did and very well l might say. The frosting l just wipped up a gnauch. Very tasty and fast cake.

Lovely flavors! Pretty package! The tangy and sweet combination of the onions with the creamy cheese and the bonus of pastry was a delight to our tastebuds! I served this for a "girl evening" to my best friend who is visiting from out-of-state, but others cruised the dining room and enjoyed it as well! I will make this again. Thanks Lori!

I was pleasantly surprised by this drink.  I thought it would be way too strong for me but the juice from the lime and the sugar made this actually taste like a very strong glass of limeade.  Nice drink for a hot summer day.  Made for ZWT4.

I used fresh fruit but substituted the oj with fruit cocktail that was in the house. Rita's idea of adding almond liquer sounds really worth trying as i served my sorbet with almonds on top and everyone liked it!

PS: it got a little too sour

DH and I really enjoyed this recipe, and it is one that I will make again, trying out a few modifications. We halved the recipe for the 2 of us (and we will still have plenty of leftovers) and followed the instructions exactly as posted. The dish came together very nicely and I did not find it difficult to prepare. It smelled wonderful. I think the meat filling could have been more flavorful, and next time, I will use the proportions of spices listed for the whole batch, while continuing to use half of the meat and rice. I will also add salt to the meat mixture instead of only sprinkling it on the top of the dish.  We served the dish over mashed potatoes as suggested. Thanks for a nice meal and one that I will try again. Made for ZWT4.

This was my first time making risotto and I'm glad I chose this one to make.  This dish was very easy to make and had a lot of flavor.  I used a can of Italian style diced tomatoes with basil, garlic and oregano.  I really enjoyed the cheddar cheese in this risotto.  Thanks for another great recipe.  Made for ZWT4 Risotto Challenge.

Simple & easy, decent flavor but something was just missing for me.  I was looking for a recipe I'd previously found & darn it all I didn't save it, something like Meuller's Mac n Cheese off a box recipe, that one was the bomb.  This is still good but I have to agree with another rater, just lacks a little something and I'm not quite sure what it is...
This is a great Tzatziki. Made one-half the recipe as directed. Thanks, Sue L! Made for ZWT4.

This was pretty tasty, nice and crisp on the outside, very moist on the inside. I also served it with ketchup on the table to add a little more flavor. I added an extra egg because it wasn't sticking very well, so modify the wet ingredients as needed. This is the kind of recipe that doesn't have to be an exact science.
This was creamy and cheesey and just great. I've never made a risotto before and this was a tastey combo of flavors. I threw in some green onions too, thanks. Made this for ZWT4 for the Chic Chefs.

My husband absolutely raved about these! The flavor is quite good! Personally, for a side dish I would rather have the mushrooms in larger pieces so their texture isn't lost, but I think these would be great on a burger! Either way they are fantastic! And I am thinking that a Czech burger is in my future!Any suggestions for cheese? :D Posted for ZWT4, team mate! Thanks for sharing-
~Sue

Made these for my grown daughter's birthday she requested them.  Followed the recipes exactly (always try to) and they were a hit.  I colored half of the frosting to make raspberry colored and also added toasted coconut on half and half with just coconut.  Mine came out very moist, we even thought they would be good without the frosting.  Lovely!

Wonderful. I made an entire pan of these and they were devoured! The only change I made was I used ground turkey instead. I had meat mixture left over so I formed meat balls and placed them in the pan along with the rolls. Also, I hate to waste a thing so I took the smaller leaves from the center and chopped them and spread on the bottom of the pan to keep the rolls from sitting on the bottom and possible burning- plus the loose cabbage soaked up the sauce and released even more juices and flavor. MMM it was so good. I have never had cabbage rolls before that had mushrooms and carrots in the sauce. What a great addition. Thanks Rita for an authentic and delicious Polish recipe! *Made for ZWT4- East Europe*

This was really good. In haste I grabbed balsamic vinegar, but it was still good (just a bit dark!) I loved the English Cucumbers and I used Greek Yogurt! Made for the Tablesetting Forum's Challenge for Zaar World Tour 4. Whine and Cheese

The ingredients were mixed 24 hours in advance and refrigerated.  The mixturefroze quickly and was transferred to a covered bowl and allowed to age for a couple of hours in the freezer.  This is very tart and I think that I could have used a little more of the sugar syrup.  Also, for my taste the lime flavor was a little strong and the lime zest might be better reduced by 1/2.  Made for *ZWT 4*
This may not be the traditional way to carmelize onions but who cares?  They are delicious!  My kids even ate them!

This was so refreshing and delicious! I knew I'd love this because I love oranges and lemons. You can't go wrong serving this on a hot spring or summer day. Made for ZWT4 and the Tastebud Tickling Travellers.
I followed everyone's advice and precooked the wanton wrappers for three minutes. I followed everything else, and they came out great!
These were pretty good. We added a little lemon at the table for a little more zip. They cooked up beautifully (and smelled fab!) Made for ZWT4

Yippeee Pork Chops immersed in lovely caramelized onions...and oh so good. The Gouda is the "piece de' resistance all melted over and the whole thing in one bit is heaven on a fork. I followed this pretty much exactly expect, I halved the recipe, used 1/4 cup flour, reduced the oil to 2 tablespoons, and used the same pan (dumped out a bit of oil and other little bits of flour) and caramelized the onion right in the same pan. The gravy is just as wonderful and this is so nice it can be made for that special occasion, but we just loved it just for us! Thanks, lazyme! Made for *ZWT4* June 2008.

A good reminder that we don't need to buy koolaid mixes, we can make fruit drinks from actual fruit. With some very sweet oranges, I used half the sugar. Overall, I found this too watery, like if the ice had melted and diluted the drink. I would use at least one more and maybe two of each fruit.

This was very good.  I did what a few raters suggested:  1/2 whole wheat and half bread flour, oil = olive.  Hope this helps anyone else.  I'm thinking to try twiggyshell's suggestion of herb flavored oil and seasonings.  In Turkey, they would serve this type of bread with goat cheese and honey.  Very odd combination, but very delicious!

Completely perfected-I'm thrilled after being married 1 1/2 years to benefit from your 25 years of practice plus Mom's recipe! I made a half recipe so did not need to layer. I did not have a cheesecloth and wasn't a role-model roller, so would have needed two cabbages to make a full 24 rolls. This is delicious. Made for the Eastern European stop on the 2008 Zaar World Tour.

My husband absolutely devoured this at dinner tonight.  This is a perfect example of how simplicity lets good ingredients shine through.  I used a mixture of half white button mushrooms and half morels.  Delicious!  Thanks, Um Safia.

This was so incredibly good that my husband said a) we should keep the ingredients on hand, and b) that he wants to have it again really soon! I followed the recipe closely but not exactly -- I wasn't able to find cellophane (bean thread) noodles at our usual grocery store (though I know where to get them, and will), so I used Mai Fun, very thin rice noodles, but I am sure the bean thread noodles would be better. We also used mostly Trader Joe's Ginger-Soy broth instead of chicken broth because we had some on hand that we needed to use up, and felt that it added an even richer flavor to the broth. This soup was so good, though, that I can't wait to make it again. Wonderful! Thank you, Sue L!

The other review is spot on..  like strong lemonade it is!!!  Although if I knocked these off on too hot of a summer''s day I think it would catch up with you rather quickly... not for thirst quenching unless you were planning a nap afterwards anyway LOL. The  limes and sugar work well together and the ice makes it very refreshing. ( My iceblocks were too big for the glass I photographed this in, I had another, deeper glass on hand to transfer this to once i'd stamped the limes.) Please see my Rating System: 4 lovely stars for a lemonade with a kick!   Thanks!

I used all the sugar syrup in here after reading the reviews and I also used sugar substitute and didn't use an ice cream maker but a blender. Works for me! It came out as if I used an ice cream maker. lol
   Love having this in this heat! Thanks!  Made for WZT4.

I followed this recipe exactly. Got to the end and realized the salt hadn't been added! I guess it was supposed to be added with the dry mustard, etc. Hmph. Well, I added it after the 2nd addition of oil and it seemed to come out fine consistency-wise. Upon immediate tasting it was too tart, too salty and a little oily tasting, even though I used good quality canola oil. I'll let it sit in the fridge for an hour or two and taste it again once the flavors have had a chance to meld. UPDATE: After letting it sit overnight, it tastes better, although still a tad oily. Maybe next time I will try a lighter oil or do half olive oil. I think I'll also sub fresh lemon juice for some of the vinegar.

DH and I had this last night for dinner.  YUM!!!  We loved it.  We followed all directions as posted with the exception of adding more gouda on top because we're cheese fanatics.  I served this with Recipe #109756 as a side and it complimented the pork chops well.  This recipe is definitely a keeper.  Thanks for posting.  Made for ZWT4.

tasted great -- easy to make-- I didnt have time to wait the full 2 hours of waiting time so the batter fell off the chicken while cooking-- nevertheless, the chicken tasted fantastic!  thanks for this great recipe

This was really good and had a nice flavor..... The nuttiness of the sesame dressing and the almonds combined with the sweetness of the oranges and cranberries was nice..... I was unable to find sesame ginger dressing and used Kraft's toasted sesame dressing and sliced almonds because I was unable to find honey roasted...... Thanks for sharing.....
I made this dish for hubby tonight and he said it was very yummy.  I served it as a side dish with Recipe #242482 and hubby was happy.  Thank you mama's kitchen - *Made for Zaar World Tour*

This was excellent! I had to use full fat mayonnaise as I didn't have any low-fat or fat-free on hand.  I was tempted to use Miracle Whip but my husband absolutely despises the stuff!  This was a great light lunch, and I look forward to making this again (only this time with the fat-free mayo!).  :)

Yum! I would've liked them a bit bigger sliced, maybe quartered, so they stay a bit firmer. The smell and flavor is really good. Added a bit hot paprika because i like my mushrooms a little spicy.
Made for the Tastebud Tickling Travellers, ZWT4

Very nice cucumber sauce, only did half a recipe and didn't have mint around. I also ran out of red wine vinegar (so many Greek recipes this week!) so I used balsamic...and no, it was not the prettiest shade but it still tasted good. Had it with our beef gyros last night. Will use the leftovers as veggie dipping for the rest of the week. Thanks for sharing. Made for my Babes for ZWT4.
Good and easy!!! Thanks Boomie! Made for ZWT 4.

My DH and I tried this tonight and he said to give this 7 stars! Wow! I used the minimum sugar -- i.e., 1/2 cup and DH said he wouldn't make it any sweeter! To those that found the recipe a little tasteless, try varying it as follows:

Saute the leeks first in butter with a pinch of rosemary and sea salt.

Instead of using just plain milk, add 2 cloves of finely chopped/minced garlic to about 150mL of milk and add about 150mL of double cream (this ensures the texture of the sauce is creamier instead of just milky).

Season the top layer with cracked pepper prior to baking.

Sprinkle some grated cheese over the bake once it is ready and put back into the oven for a further 10 minutes, or until the cheese has melted.

Made half a recipe, for 2, and baked in a 10 1/2 ovenproof saute pan.  Served as 4 wedges.  DH suggested adding some mushrooms next time, but he enjoyed the recipe just as it was.  Will also try again using cheddar broccoli soup mix. Will make often, thanks for posting.  Made for 1-2-3 Hit Wonders.

I made this on 8/27/08 for mine and my SO's dinner.Since there was only two of us, the recipe was adjusted accordingly. I did have to make a couple of substitutions, since I didn't have exactly what was called for.Breaded chicken fillets were used instead of the patties and, for the cheese, havarti was used instead of swiss.This was really a very quick and easy recipe that had a very pleasing taste and will be made again. Thank you for posting and, "Keep Smiling :)"
Awesome meal! I added frozen peas and used regular, full-fat cheese and soup and it was soooo good! My partner ate 6 of them! Thanks!

I've tried to make risotto  a few times and always failed.
This recipe was easy to follow and came out perfectly.
I used parmesan cheese.
I soaked about a half cup of dried porcini mushrooms in boiling water for a  few minutes, then added to fresh sauteed mushrooms.
I saved the mushroom liquid and added to the hot broth along with about 1/2 tsp white truffle oil.
I'm not sure how much hot stock I ended up using. I just kept adding and stirring and tasting until it was almost cooked through.
Thanks so much for sharing a great recipe.

Made this the day ahead for "pre-dinner" nibbles.  Only had a salmon steak in the freezer and bought cream cheese instead of sour cream and I wasn't fighting my way thru the supermarket again !!!  The small amount of gelatine is just sufficient to 'hold' the mousse together, I cut the lemon juice down to 1 tablespoon and added a 'smidgeon' of horseraddish to give it some 'oooomph'.  It was delicious,  had a lovely light texture and none of the flavours overpowered,  I sprinkled the top with fresh chopped dill just before serving with melba toast and crackers.  Thankyou for sharing this super simple, practical and tasty recipe.

Love me some Sambar--and this recipe is close to what I got at friends houses in Kerala State, South India.  Tuvar dal is the little orange lentils(get the split ones, they cook superfast)  Urad dal is the little white lentil that is also used in my favorite accompaniments to Sambar--Dosas and Idli.  We use garlic in place of hing.
My son loved this -- so easy, and he doesn't like buns with his hotdogs (pulls them apart and eats them seperately, making a mess), so this worked great!

I had everything (except jicima which I have never seen available in these parts) on hand to make this for todays lunch. Total yumm factor going on here. I did have to question the "2 cups mesclun or 1 sprig cilantro" as there's a big amount difference between 2 cups and a sprig, lol. I used baby spring mix greens in this and whole wheat tortillas. One of these wraps is very filling and I'd make one to split with DH next time. Thanks Gert for a quick easy lunch. :D

A single serving of this in a croissant made for a delicious leisurely Saturday breakfast.  My only additions were some caramelised onion and garlic (which I'd transferred from the freezer to the fridge last night), some grindings of black pepper and a small sprinkling of oregano.  My sandwich was warmed through and the cheese had nicely melted in about 15 minutes.  Wonderful!  Made for 1-2-3 Hit Wonders.

5+ stars all the way. This is very tasty. I served it over Recipe #256215 but used angel hair pasta instead. This has a nice garlic, butter flavor to it. Not an overpowering taste. Thanks for posting.
We love it.  Eating them now!

OMG!  I wish I could give this 10 stars.  I made these for a community get together and they were gone in a flash.  Everyone loved them.  One person said, "I never eat hamburgers but after a bite of my husband's I couldn't resist".  I found the perfect rolls- Kings Hawaiian Saory Butter Rolls- 12 to a package.  You have to split the rolls yourself, but they are the perfect size and shape.  In my store, Publix, they are in the deli section, not in the bread section.   This is definitely a "keeper" of a recipe.

Wonderful recipe!  My daughter Cheyenne made this for her boyfriend's birthday, and the instructions were simple, the spices were perfect as was the cooking time.  Thanks for the tip about covering with foil the last 10 minutes of cooking -- perfect and needed info!  Will definitely make this again.  This is our new family favorite recipe for apple crumb pie!  It's no-fail!  Yummy...

Yum!  The blue cheese makes for excellent flavor. I used canned chicken, and only fat-free plain yogurt. Used red grapes, also added celery. Served on a hearty 8-grain bread. ext time, I'll increase the walnuts, and maybe a bit of finely chopped onions.

I have to be honest, I omitted the almonds.  I know it's part of the recipe, but when I was doing them, my almonds were not toasted.  And I knew DH wouldn't like almonds on the green beans.  He's fussy.  Instead of olive oil, I used butter to give it more flavour.  And I cooked the green beans in the microwave, covered for 15 minutes.  They were tender like we like them.  I didn't rinse.  Thanks Sage.  Made for 123 hit wonders
Yummy broccoli! I used less butter, more lemon, and toasted sliced almonds. I loved the nuts and lemon together.

Very yummy & ultra rich! I forgot the nuts, and that would have made these bars even better. I sprinkled some coconut on top just for kicks...I also used a gourmet white chocolate peanut butter, which may have pushed it over the limit from rich to decadent. Will make again -- with nuts (or maybe almonds) !
A great way to start off the morning! I used almond milk, it's so good! Thanks Elmotoo! Made for the Vegetarian Swap#2!

This is a keeper for us. It will be a great meal to prepare on a weekday when time and energy are short. I used diced tomatoes with garlic and olive oil which did make it a bit oily but gave it a great flavour. Thanks for sharing this great soup recipe.

This homemade ganola was a hit at my family reunion this year.  We made breakfast parfaits with this nutty version by layering fresh berries & low-fat vanilla yogurt with the granola in tall plastic cups.  Also, I didn't want to use all my real maple syrup, so I substituted about 1/3 of the amount with wildflower honey & it still had a great maple favor without being too sweet.   Note: If you add raisins be sure to added them after you bake in the oven so they won't dry out. 
Sam's Wholesale had a Member's Mark brand of blended PREMIUM NUT MIX (raw & unsalted) which is 5 of the finest nuts (almonds, cashews, pecans, macadamias & walnuts) that worked perfectly for this recipe (use half of the 32 oz. bag or about 2 cups).

I thought these would be really great because who doesn't like cream cheese, pickles, and white bread? They were okay. I can see how they would go over well at a Superbowl party or poker night, but for my taste, these were not great, just okay. Ease of preparation and few ingredients make this easy. I will try this again but maybe add red pepper flakes or jalapeno to kick it up a bit. Thanks for posting.
This was an easy tasty recipe, even though I had to change it a little bit based on what I had available.  I will try it again with the correct ingredients.
yep!

I loved this macaroni salad using tomatoes and cucumbers from my garden.  So fresh and delicous!  Other than adding some celery, I made as posted and used Hellman's mayonnaise along with some salt and pepper to taste.  Next time I may add a little bit of Louisiana hot sauce in with it to flavor it up a little more, but it really was delicious just like this.  I loved it and so did my kids!  Karen
Delicious!  I never think to add pepperoni and cheese to my salads but it was so good combined with the croutons and Italian dressing.
Delicious! absolutely wonderful! I plan on making it often! thanks for sharing! What a wonderful flavor! :)
really easy and delicious! my cake cracked though.

THE perfect chocolate sauce!  I've made others on the Zaar, but this is the best, I think - thick and gooey and super fast.  I was craving some chocolate, and this hit the spot in a big way!  Thanks, Steve - you made my day!

Excellent! Very Spicy! Next time I will elect not to dip into additional sauce but enjoy what I had on the wrap which blended well with all the other ingredients. I will also try the cream cheese because I love the combo of cream cheese with a hot jelly/jam on crackers and this sauce rocks! My DH doubled the recipe using sherry, and kept the adobe sauce. Since you can't really eat alot of the sauce due to the heat I opted to freeze in very small quantities. Will try it on grilled chicken tonight. The sauce was a great hit at my husband's workplace and he had to copy off for 6 of the men who requested the recipe.

First off let me just say that for my 7 pint jars I used about 14 decent sized peaches. So there's no way a "bushel" is correct for this recipe when a bushel is 50lbs of peaches! You'd need a lot more Bourbon!! Or in my case I followed suite and used Brandy since I prefer it anyway. I like the way these came out and I'm sure I'll make them again. Each time I tried the syrup while cooking it got better and better!I'd say I simmered mine for about 15-20 mins. Only thing I would change is that I think they need a bit more spice. I used about 1/2 tsp of cinnamon, 1/4 tsp nutmeg, the 10 allspice berries and I added 5 whole cloves. It's only been 9 days though so the flavors may intensify.
My son is peanut allergic so I will be subbing Soy Nut Butter but I KNOW he will LOVE LOVE LOVE this!  He's such a "P" B& J kid!!
Delicious!  I didn't have a leek or parsnips, but it still tasted great.  Thanks very much!
I added in some thin slices of onion, fresh mozzarella slices and used basil in ours.  Great addition to the dinner table anytime!
Good...also good to try adding some thyme to give it some additional flaver

This was great and really easy to make. I cook orzo often but usually as part of a main dish with some kind of meat. I had never thought of it as a potential side-dish until now. It's faster and easier than rice and tastes wonderful. I substituted fresh parsley instead of basil (personal preference) and sliced almonds instead of pine nuts as I didn't have any and it worked really well.

I swore I reviewed this already! Oh well, here goes...
This is my "perfect" chocolate cake. I'm a cake decorator (hobby, not pro) and this is my go-to recipe for chocolate cake. Perfect chocolate-y flavor and density. I don't know who made it "first" (I got it off cake central) but I love them! I've never had a problem with it sinking or cracking, and it tortes beautifully. Thanks!

Absolutely delicious- just having another slice now!! Very moist even the next day. I don't really like icing, but my husband LOVES it and ate the icing off my cake and the rest of the contents of the bowl. Have decided to make the cake one with icing , one without!! yum yum yum. We used Kittencal's Chocolate Buttercream Frosting/Icing made with whipping cream.

Very easy and tasty. Didn't have the soup, but I did have frozen broccoli. I just microed it, chopped it up into very tiny pieces, added some finely chopped onion, seasoning salt, paprika and lots of fresh cracked pepper to a can of regular cream of chicken soup, added the water and some Thai rice. Popped it in the oven and ended up with a hit! Chicken was moist and tender, rice was creamy and yummy. Thanks for posting, bert!

This cod is delicious.  I marinated the fillets in Italian Dressing for a few hours first.  Omitted the onions and sauted the peppers before putting them on the fish. It was easy to prepare, looked quite gourmet and tasted just perfect.  Thank you, I will be making this again.

This was definitely a very tasty and attractive dish that looks like you put a lot of effort into it, but truly is "fast and easy".  I discovered I was out of fresh tomatoes at the last minute and had to substitute a can of Italian style peeled tomatoes.  It still worked very well.

A delicious dish that is so easy to put together.  I used green onion, white and green parts, in place of the bell pepper.  The tomato was a fresh from the garden tomato.  This was served with recipe #243336 and a green side salad.
This recipe was simple to make. The peppers and onions were refreshing while the tomaotes and basil added additional flavors to this dish.
We liked this. I doubled the sauce ingredients, but otherwise I followed the recipe very closely. This is very flavorful, but it was a little too sweet for us. Thanks for posting.

Almost as good as the full fat/sugar cobbler I made a couple days ago. I had to use butter in this recipe, and I also used whole wheat flour which added an extra "healthy" flavor and I'm sure that white flour would have been better. The topping also never browned. Overall for such low sugar and butter, really good!

These cookies were great! The took very little time to put together and even less time to bake! I used this recipe to make cut out cookies of cars and airplanes for a baby shower and every one loved them!

This is yummy.  I used pecans because i did not have walnuts.  Also used left over barbequed chicken which added good flavor.
Good recipe.

Thanks Randy this was fantastic.  I always have the listed ingredients on hand and they really made the rice wonderful.  I served it with some grilled boneless chicken and grilled veggies.  A definite keeper.
These were good tonight.  Only changes I made , I used lite sour cream, and I added an extra teaspoon of taco seasoning. I also used mild salsa. All in all it was good.  Made for potluck tag.

No wonder these are so popular at the markets. They are delicious and so easy to make (don't tell the market-goers). I doubled the recipe -- to feed a horde of hungry exchange students -- but still used only 6 sheets of puff pastry. Each roll was nicely plump. I'll make these often. It's wonderful to know what's gone into a sausage roll.

This IS the best chocolate cake.  I don't know how many times I heard that at my son's birthday party.  This was easy to put together and was enjoyed by all.  I did not use the caramel frosting, as my son had requested a football cake, but I used a chocolate buttercream instead.  I'll definitely try this again with the caramel frosting!

We had this recipe for lunch yesterday and really enjoyed it.  It was an extra bonus because I was looking to use up many of the ingredients called for.  I thought I was using ground chicken that I had in the freezer in a ziplock bag, but it ended up being ground beef (oops!).  The dish was really good, regardless.  Loved the taste of the fresh veggies.  I made my own salsa to use (Recipe #15196), but would experiment with other fresh salsas in the future.  Also, I only had corn tortillas on hand, and I think they detracted from the taste.  I ended up eating mine just plain on the plate and still enjoyed it very much.  I would definitely recommend flour tortillas or rice.  We topped ours with a shredded Mexican cheese blend.  Thanks for postingt this recipe.  We would make it again.

Excellent flavor and very easy to prepare.  We loved the crispy bacon mixed in the burger as opposed to just sitting on top.  I added 1 egg to hold the mixture together.  Thank you for a great burger!
This is a great simple recipe.  Gravy is GREAT!  My family and friends all rave about it!
My family and I enjoyed this recipe !. We will definitelly be having it again. Thanks for posting it.

YummY I am spoiled now.. no cake will taste as good as this.

Amy:-)
Made this for a Greek themed potluck and everyone raved about the flavor. Very very yummy!
These were great and went over well with guests. Ours never got really crispy on the bottom, but they were tasty!

Wonderful recipe! All the greek salad dressing recipes I've seen on here have been way too heavy on the oil. This was much better. We will definitely be making this again. Changes were: omitted cucumber, used Mezzetta Mediterranean Olive Antipasto instead of kalamata olives, used white vinegar instead of balsamic (replaced 1 Tbsp of the vinegar with lemon juice), used lettuce as a base for the salad (not mentioned in ingredients).

Just going thru new recipes here and saw this one.   I can rate it because I must have made dozens when our girls were teenagers. This is the casserole they requested most often and I made many different ones (with add ins). I imagine that today they would not be so thrilled with something so ordinary, but I bet that most kids (and adults) will like it.

I'll add my kudos in as well. I was a self-proclaimed fried eggplant lover and this recipe changed my mind. I had two large eggplants so I had to double the batch, and also we ran out of mayo so I used sour cream instead. Still turned out wonderful. : ) Thank you James!

With 106 great reviews this really doesn't need another one. I prepared this in advance up to step #4. I took them on a RV trip and threw them on the grill. These come out so tender and tasty. I did use a smoky barbecue sauce. We also enjoyed the leftovers the next day cold. Thanks for posting.
What a fantastic cake!  Very easy and very quick to make, yet one of the best recipes ever!  It's a very moist and flavorful cake and my family loved it!
Oh yum...photo coming soon:)

This was a great clam-CORN chowder recipe, which is what I was looking for. Didn't have leeks on hand. Used 1can evap. milk and 2 cups skim milk. Thickened with corn starch Also loved the fact that there is no bacon, my husband doesn't eat pork. My whole family loved it and I will make it again. If you aren't looking to taste the corn, choose another recipe without it in the recipe title.
We made this with Minute Maid Light Orange Juice + Calcium and Fat Free Cream, as that is what we had in the fridge.  The kids loved it!  I am sure they will be asking for this time and time again!

I was looking for a homemade chocolate cake that was super moist and tasted more like a box mix without all the "yuck-stuff" (ie preservatives, trans fats, etc).  Something I could feed to children and not feel guilty about! I tried A LOT of recipes, and this was the winner.  I make them as cupcakes, and I do have issues with them settling a bit when cooling, so I will take the hint from Marg and reduce to 3/4 cup liquid next time.  A nice sub. for boiling water is hot, fresh coffee.  A flavored coffee, like hazlenut works well too.  No coffee? Swing thru a Starbucks and grab a tall (small) to go! I have topped these with my Crushed Strawberry, Raspberry, Chocolate, and Cafe Mocha Buttercreams... all have turned out yummy!  When making a batch for adults, especially for the office, they go nuts for the cafe mochas.  I top them with a chocolate covered esspresso bean... Gone in minutes!  It's funny to watch full-grown adults sneaking seconds and thirds with guilty little grins on their faces!!

Delicious!  I made this for breakfast and everyone raved over it.  There are so many fabulous flavors going on in this dish - gouda, asiago, bacon, and artichokes - no wonder everyone loved it.  I used a smoke gouda (which I think is a must), and artichoke bottoms instead of hearts (they're less woody and my preference in cooking).  I baked this in a 7x11" dish for 45 mins.  Served with sour cream and salsa, although neither were needed as it was so good by itself.  Thanks for sharing this wonderful recipe...it is definitely a keeper!
*Made for Aus/NZ swap #20*

This was a nice surprise. I was looking for something different for lunch, and to use some cream cheese. Wouldn't ya know, this fit the bill. I used pear slices, with a sprinkle of cinnamon sugar, and it was scrumptious. I had enough leftover date spread to make one sandwich too, and though I had made date/cr cheese sandwiches before, grilling them took them to an incredible new level. The pear was wonderful; just slightly warmed and softened by the heat, but not mushy, and the cream cheese was so good softened by the heat. I made it on my homemade bread (#277723), and I thought the complex flavors enhanced this recipe, and the substance should make an otherwise light sandwich last until dinner. Thanks for a great idea!
Nice dishes, but found a bit unbalanced in flavour, so I have adjusted by added some hot pepper and smoked paprika.

These were outstanding! I took them to a "bring a snack" table at work and they evaporated. Co-worker next to me was nibbling on hers while we circled the table, and she had room on her plate for a second one by the time we came back around to the beginning.
Very tasty.  This is quick, simple and healthy.  I used less oil and more garlic but otherwise kept to the recipe.  I served it over a mix of barley and brown rice.  Thanks for posting.
These tasted just like cheesecake but were so easy to make! The crumbly topping was so delicious and everyone thought they looked gorgeous.
Excellent, tasty recipe.  We had baked potato, sweet potato and squash with it and they went together nicely.

I used Lite Firm Silken Tofu for this, regular cream cheese and an extra 1/2 banana. It's very good, but not as solid and thick as regular cream pies. I don't think you'd fool any hard core tofu haters. The pineapple and nuts are what really make this pie! I also added some flaked coconut on top which was perfect for this. Next time I'll try mixing some coconut through the tofu to thicken it a bit. I'd also like to try this method with mango and see what happens! Thanks Lennie!

I used panko instead of regular bread crumbs and ran out of crumb mixture halfway through. I ended up doubling the crumbs, but still only using a little less than a lb. of eggplant. Nevertheless, no one in my family really liked this eggplant. We all got through one piece and I threw the rest out.

It's too runny for good tapioca pudding/cream unless you use 1 1/2 tablespoons quick-cooking tapioca.  I don't know how they get the idea it's two servings though since it's just enough for one (tapioca lover that is).
I didn't think this recipe was good at all. Hope I find better ones.
This was delicious with turkey, but for some reason I found that it was much, much targer the next day.  That was easily remedied by reheating and adding a tad more sugar.  Thanks for sharing.

Delcious cookies. Very soft and chewey. My dough was a little loose so I took Pam-I- Am's advice and let it sit for about 10 minutes. They turned out great! . I will make these often. Next time I will add cranberries and maybe white chocolate chips.Thanks Kitten for another winner.
This was good. I added fresh minced garlic cloves to the sauce. Thanks for posting.

Wonderful dish, thanks, Sharon! Made as directed, except when I made it, the instructions didn't say what to do with the optional peas. I missed adding them to step #4 (made sense to add them with the corn), so I ended up adding them last and "poked" them down under the top layer of macaroni before baking. Made for Vegetarian Recipe Swap #2.

Absolutely delicious! We used 1 cup of mexican 4 cheese blend, 1 cup of fontina and 1/2 cup of freshly shaved parmesan and it was fabulous. We polished off the entire quiche in like 5 minutes. Will definitely make again!
Thank you for posting

My mom and I just made this together last weekend, and I thought I'd died and gone to heaven.  This is one of the most delicious things I've ever eaten.  I can't say enough good things about it.  Thanks for posting this recipe, so I don't have to!  ;-)

this was super duper simple and yet so wonderfully delicious....i can make this everyday...and i made it without using the mixer...i merely used the ladle and it worked really well...quite superb texture...i even added in some grinded peanuts to add some crunchy flavor....soooo easy....will be a keeper in my kitchen...
Terrific story and the soup is wonderful. Thanks!!! Alan
This just didn't make it for us, but thanks for sharing anyway.

I made this for my son's 10th birthday.I doubled the recipe to get 2 large and 1 small cake to make a castle cake.Everyone loved it.I', making it again today for my kids and to take to darts tonight.Thanks for a fantastic recipe that is going to be in my "make again" folder :)

This was delicious and so easy to make.  I wasn't able to get shiitake mushrooms so I substituted cremini mushrooms.  Next time I will cut back on the rosemary but otherwise the recipe is fine as is.  We are looking forward to enjoying the leftovers!
I made this for dinner tonight. It was ok. DH asked for more gravy and more cheese. I added more garlic salt for additional flavor.
YUM-MEE!!!!   This is a GREAT blue cheese dressing... think and rich and great tasting.  thnx for the recipe...
We used a bag of frozen mango and I mashed the mangos so that it was more like a sauce. This was excellent. Lots of healthy vitiman C.
Very nice pizza that is basic and simple. I omitted the ricotta due to personal preference, but followed the rest of the ingredients. Thanks for sharing this pizza recipe.
We made this tonight and it was delicious!  It was easy to make and easy on the calorie budget.  We served it over plain couscous.  We'll definitely make it again.  Yum!

Love it.  I sauteed the onions & garlic, then piled everything into the crock pot for the day.  I also substituted 2 cans of drained & rinsed navy beans for the dried,  so only used 6 c. of the water.  The result was a hearty, full flavored but mild soup.  I'll definitely make this again.

The turnovers were pretty good.  The crust was just a bit difficult to work with (too crumbly, didn't roll easily), but not enough to scrap the recipe altogether.  The recipe states 1/2 cinnamon---is that 1/2 tablespoon or 1/2 teaspoon...or what?  I just guessed and used 1/2 teaspoon, and I didn't detect any cinnamon flavor in the pastry shell.  Maybe next time I'll try 1/2 tablespoon and see if that kicks up the cinnamon flavoring.  Other than that, I think I would make this again if I can figure out the cinnamon and crumbly pastry issues.  This would be a great treat for a lady's tea, a brunch or just as a replacement for the usual sugary doughnuts.
the best Guasacaca i've tasted in all my life. Even better than the one they serve at Venezuelan Restaurants
What excellent flavor. Very delicious.  We really enjoyed 100%. Made for Market tag.

Delicious!  The crock pot is my best friend when my days are very busy, so I love finding recipes like this that go together quickly and easily and are very tasty.  My family loved this rich, hearty stew, and I loved that I only had a few minutes preparation in the morning and dinner was done!  I browned the meat in "Kitchen Bouquet" for extra flavor and added a few extra carrots and potatoes to stretch the servings.  Thank you for sharing this wonderful recipe!
*Made for Football Pool 2008*
Perfect!  Is there any better combination than sugar, lime and vodka?  Will make this often.  Thanks diner!
I wanted to like this dish.  I was trying to use up items in my kitchen, and this had all the right ingredients.  This dish was kind of bland and only so so.  Won't be making this again.

I was very hesitant to try this recipe because it sounded bland to me.  It was actually fantastic.  I used more fresh basil than called for, fresh thyme instead of oregano (didn't have any), and a 15oz can of the tomatoes along with some chopped fresh tomatoes and it was the greatest!!   I had to fight my husband to let me bring a small plate to a neighbor to try because he loved it also!
Great Cookies! I swapped out half the white sugar for brown sugar (as I ran out) and they were fantastic! Will be making again :-D

We really liked this.  I used an aged English cheddar for the cheese, and a mild beer.   A tablespoon of dijon seemed huge when I scooped it out - so I only added 1/2 T.  We served over whole wheat toast; the kids and I loved the sauce but not the toast so I really think this deserves a better toast such as a crusty white bread.

This soup has a very mild onion flavor.  We all enjoyed it.  I followed it exactly.  I think next time I will add an extra clove of garlic and  maybe another 1/2 red onion to give it a little more flavor.
Thanks Irish Rose!

This was a nice change from our ordinary turkey sandwiches.  I like the combination of the ranch dressing and salsa.  I chopped up some cilantro and also used some shredded lettuce instead of the mesclun.  We will definitely make this again.  Thanks gert!

Followed the recipe and this was a bit dry, I did add an onion in rings and that was the only difference. Kept waiting all day for the wonderful aroma and it never came. I am sorry to say I think I will stick with oven roasting.
This was so delicious. I really enjoyed the fresh, sweet and tart flavor of this drink. I used frozen raspberries, they worked great. Thanks so much for sharing this recipe Shelby Jo.

I agree - I never would have tried this recipe if I hadn't read the reviews.  The combination of ingredients is strange, but tasty.  I did change it up just a bit (I always do!).  I used natural peanut butter, and since it is not as sweet I added a touch of sugar.  I was also just short on salsa so I added chili sauce.  It was even spicier the next day, but just as good.  We call it African Groundnut Chicken here too - since it doesn't see like Thai to me either.

This was really good! I love hummus! For me, this is more like 8 servings, but I'm not a big eater LOL. I used garlic hummus, about 1/2 cup lettuce, used a low fat parmesan garlic ranch dressing & didn't use any tomato. Used red onions for a wonderful crunc & low fat feta cheese. Wonderful, fast & easy!! Thanks for giving me another way to enjoy hummus.

These muffins are a new breakfast treat at my house!  They are more like dessert than a muffin, which is fine by me, as I love my sweets!  We all couldn't wait to try one, and that first bite was spectacular!  I had along with my first cup of coffee and this was an added bonus to breakfast this morning!  Thanks for sharing!
Tasty with crisp edges - made fluffy-textured waffles. Thank you for sharing.

Beautiful!  Rich and moist.  Going by previous reviews I was going to make a double recipe so the shrinking wouldn't affect the size of my completed cake.  Well I am glad I stuck to the single! It didn't shrink nearly as much as expected.  I filled it with a vanilla buttercream flavoured with boysenberries and juice and iced it with a chocolate ganache and chocolate curls.  Delish! Thanks so much!!!

This was amazing!  I cut the oil way back to 3/4 cup plus 1 heaping tbsp. f/f sour cream.  My family is enjoying it now! :)  It does taste just like Mom's! :)  I will make it again as muffins and will add choc. chips....just like my mom did!

Deish! I used fresh roma tomatoes and it turned out great.  Our zucchini is almost done for this year, but we'll certainly keep this gem on hand for next summer with the zuc's are taking over Southern Indiana.

This tasted just as good as I thought it would.  I cut the recipe in half but still used the 8 oz of cheddar.  We love a cheesey mac and cheese.  I had a little trouble getting my bread crumbs to brown but I just put the oven on broil for about 3 min. and that did the trick.  Plus, it gave it a nice crust on top and around the edges.  Thanks so much for sharing.  Made for PRMR.

amazing and soooo moist!!!!!!!!!! Great, easy recipie. Bye bye mixes

This is a delicious treat!  It's very creative and fun, and of course yummy.  The combination of apples with the cinnamon crispas is wonderful.  Made for Fall PAC 2008.

This is a lovely combination of vegetables. I used curry paste as I don't have any of the spices apart from the cinnamon on hand. Thanks for this tasty meal!

These were so good.  My kids loved these in their lunch this week.  They also enjoyed helping me make them.  What a nice change from the everyday sandwich.  Thanks for sharing.  Made for PAC Fall/2008.

This is wonderful!  I paired down the servings for DH and myself.  Easy and delicious!  I served this with Fall off the bone ribs (317198) and a salad.  This will be made again and again.  Thank you for sharing.
Great recipe!  I used fresh pumpkin.  The dough wasn't stiff, but the cookies still turned out great, because I refrigerated it for a little while.

WOW - this made a wonderful meatloaf - spicy and very moist. I wondered how it would turn out with so few ingredients but the flavors were delicious.  I made this in my 11x7 baking dish and it came out very nicely done. Thanks DesertRose15 for a great new twist on an old favorite. Made for Fall 2008 PAC.
Very nice and simple little dish. Good flavors. Definitely a keeper.

Great comfort dish! I cut back on the butter a bit so it was a little healthier and used turkey bacon. This made a nice belly warming soup. I really enjoyed these cookies.  They were very moist and cake like.  The only changes that I believe these cookies could use are...at least 1 Tbs of cin and 1/2 tsp of pumpkin pie spice.  I would also add extra maple to the frosting.  They were really easy to make and everyone loved eating them.

This was great, I severed it cold at a BBQ. I also added almonds and carrots which made it look so colourful ;-)  I didn't have any parsley, so used spring onions. Mad as part of the Aus/Nz recipe swap # 21 October 2008.

Yup...these are perfect.  The brown sugar really gives them a rich toffee like texture and they are snap to whip up.  The name could not be more clever!  I doubled it and baked in a 9x13..will be serving tomorrow for a tailgate party, but couldn't resist a sneak peek...they are moist, chewy, with a nice crust on top...everything you want a blondie to be!  Thanks PanNan!
Very rich! I think I will add a bit more reg milk next time, but we will be making this again! Made for Fall PAC 08.

These are the best ribs I have eaten!!!  We recently ate at Chili's and their's were not nearly as good!    I have also been using Sweet Baby Ray's BBQ sauce for the last 5 years, and it can't be beat.  Don't hesitate, try these - you won't regret it!
Delicious! This was so easy and had great flavor. I followed the recipe exactly. Thanks for another fantastic recipe. :)
I was expecting these to be damn good but they were even better than that!  I think they're perfect, I'm definitely going to make them again and again.  Thanks so much!

This was good - but VERY sweet - almost like a candy.  The glaze set up perfectly.  I used a bag of frozen baby carrots and nuked them for 5 minutes before adding to the glaze.  I omitted the cinnamon and sprinkled dried tarragon on top insted.  It looked pretty and the tarragon has a slight licrorice-y flavor that went with the sweetness very nicely.  The kids liked it a lot.
Tasted like tacos. Next time gonna try to deep fry to get the wonton wrappers more crunchy.
This was my first attempt at bread and it turned out great. A Winner.

This was good, but not what I am used to as scampi...maybe we do scampi differently on the Gulf Coast!  It was a little bland.  I've never seen scampi without any lemon, but I refrained from adding any to test the "true" recipe.  I went down to the docks and purchased shrimp at the fish market so it would be fresh and tastey.  The shrimp were beautiful, and I served it over linguine.

This was my 1st cake from scratch and it came out really nice.  Had to make some adjustments since I live in Colorado.  Did add 1 extra egg.  My cake came out perfect, didn't sink.  It is a little work but well worth it.
This bread has a very nice flavor and was easy to prepare.  I did, however, find it a little heavy and dry. I have discovered that if it is thinly sliced and toasted it makes a lovely breakfast item.

Great breakfast.  Not too filling.  I used parmesan but will try it with Fontina next time I can afford it! :)

I cut the "baking" time down to about 10 minutes.  Made for Fall 2008 PAC.
A simple, yummy ranch ball you can make up in no time!  I used 1/3 less fat cream cheese and the hidden valley ranch dip.  Thanks JenJenMarie for posting this here!  Made for PAC fall 2008.
Really good! My husband loved it and I loved getting rid of the leftover mashed potatoes I had. My kids didn't really eat it. I found that butter works better than oil. Thanks for the great recipe!
These were excellent.  I worried that they'd just fall apart and be a mess, like sloppy joe's, but the cheese held them together nicely.  The family gobbled them up and looked for more!

I've never roasted a chicken before, but true to its name, this recipe was very easy. This macaroni was wonderful.  I usually do mac with out sour cream, and though I tested different cheeses and seasonings, none had quite the flavor and creaminess this had.  Thanks for a great recipe.  I think I can finally stop searching!  Oh, and another poster was asking the baking time: I baked mine for 30 minutes.  :)
These are great!  I followed the recipe and came out with a wonderful crispy chicken tender.  They are much better than chicken tenders from a restaurant.  Thank you for posting.

After making these little tasties, I shared them with a friend of mine who is nuts about those really awful PB cups, & guess what? He grudgingly admitted that these were much better tasting, by far! Thank you so much for a great treat & a keeper of a recipe! [Tagged, made & reviewed for one of my adoptees in the current Pick-A-Chef]
simple, quick, moist, beautiful!  I did double the topping - and brought the butter/sugar mix to a boil for 1 minute b4 adding the nuts.  When reheating, I let it boil again - and it was WONDERFUL!

I am not a candy girl but I Loved this! Very festive, easy and yummy!
Thanks for a new holiday fav!

Connie, This is such a great salad, thanks so much for sharing! I found some arugula had popped back up in the garden so this morning I searched for a new salad recipe. And am I glad I did! I used the Stonewall Kitchens brand of roasted garlic and sweet onion jam. I was out of Dijon but really did not miss it as the jam holds it all together. This salad with the blue cheese and toasted pecans and slightly sweet dressing with the peppery arugula is wonderful! We're having it tonight with some Parmesan crusted Turkey cutlets, and baked fennel in Vermouth.

This is the best. It is funny because I haven't thought of these in years. My Mom who passed away quite a few years ago made these all the time. She did not use the flour and butter was a must in our household.

Hubby loved it!  Took a little longer to cook in my old oven - maybe because the meat was thicker, too...added the mushrooms to the gravy & served with mashed potatoes.  Thanks a bunch!

I'll be making this again very soon, since the family complained that they hardly  got any!

thanks, Sharon!

Very, very unusual sauce, from my point of view, AND a pleasure to make! Thanks for posting the recipe! [Tagged, made & reviewed for one of my adoptees in the current Pick-A-Chef]

LOVED THIS BREAD, & found the combo of peanuts & pineapple baked this way to be refreshing! Great with cream cheese & pineapple preserves! You have a great recipe here! [Tagged, made & reviewed for one of my partners in the Aus/NZ Recipe Swap #21]
Excellent toasted with butter!  I substituted craisins for the raisins and it came out wonderful.  Plan to make it again for sure.
wow this was so good! the potatoes were a great addition, really stepped up the plain old soup beans my mom always made.

This are very dry the next day.

Super yummy! Healthy! Fast and Easy! My Favorite Freezer recipe!

Good recipe.  Edible and nothing huge to complain about thats for sure.  I just didnt care for the garlicly taste as much.  I love garlic but just didnt taste the way I wanted my meatloaf to taste. awesome!!!!

My diabetic DH found he can snack on these as they have minimal carbohydrates. Thanks PugMomma Brenda for posting!
I enjoyed this using vegetable broth. I scaled the recipe down for two. Thanks Nichol!
I didn't use the pine nuts, and did add sauteed mushrooms and 2 tsp. garlic in the jar.  It was excellent with my Chicken Francese!  I will use this many times now that I tried the recipe!

Thanks alot for this recipe, I had alot of pears that I did not want to throw out and found your recipe very usefull, but even better soooo delicious! This smelled fantastic while it was baking! I made this with tart cooking apples and yellow carrots. The flavor was a bit sweet for my tastes, but certainly was well suited for autumn! Thanks for sharing. ~Sue

A great alternative to deep fried zuchhini.  Loved the flavor the cheese gave it.  Next time I think I'll add a few sprinkles of red pepper too.   Thanks for posting A!  Made for I Recommend Tag Game.
A tasty Mac & Cheese.  My family enjoyed it.  Thank you for sharing!

very good! the only thing that i did different is added corn too :)

Thank you!  This is a wonderful recipe.

I gave this 5 stars for #1 speed and ease of preparation, #2 eye appeal, and #3 taste appeal.  It was very good, but not quite comfort food.  But then is fish ever comfort food?

Made this this week-end for my family and friends that were coming for the week-end. I made it the week-end before and baked it. What a great little appetizer(or lunch for kids)My DS(9) ate about 10 of them!! I will definitely make again!!!

I have searched for years for good macaroni salad and I can say this one IS IT! I did use real mayonaise instead of the salad dressing and only because I prefer real mayo. Just made this recipe and it is great!! The only thing I did different was I added 1 Tbsp. tomato paste to thicken.  I couldn't wait the 2 hours for it to thicken.  Also I add 1 more tsp. garlic powder.  Thanks can't wait to try it on nachos!!
My guests for this years Halloween party loved this cheese ball.  I served it with Ritz crackers and Triscuits around the plate.  Very cute idea!

delicious!  just what i was craving.  for a little extra something i dipped one edge in melted chocolate and then in toasted, crushed almost.  thank you for an amazing recipe that i will make again and again.

As a regular Hooters customer who, in his lifetime, has consumed more than his share of their fine wings, I feel more than qualified to be able to compare this recipe to the taste of the actual Hooters sauce. This is de-li-cious!  I served this at a lodge I worked at to guests.  It got rave reviews, it was a real staff and guest favorite.  I am going to make it for my family tonight.  It's not lowcal, but if you're in the mood to indulge do it, you won't regret it.
This is a wonderful cake!  I wasn't sure about the icing but decided to go for it.  I was so glad I did!  My kids now want this as their birthday cake.  :)  Thanks!

This soup is great, and love the name. I can just see those guys. The aroma of it cooking filled the house. I also cooked for about 5 hours in crockpot, it's just too hot for on the top of the stove right now. I used Irish potatoes, no reds. DH seemed to like, but no raving but that's nothing new for him. Will make again for sure.

This was very good. I don't think I liked the flavor better than oven roasting, but it was definitely much less fuss! I added some liquid smoke and one apple chopped up, as suggested by other reviewers. Also, I only cooked mine for about 6 hours, but I think it could have been taken out an hour sooner. Very good over all, and I would make again. Thanks!

Top notch mac&cheese. If you've never had homemade mac&cheese - you must try it! Dh didn't grow up on homemade but he's coming around. I used odds and ends of cheese - some sharp cheddar, colby/jack, a bit of swiss and munster. Very good!

This muffin has a very nice flavour and isn't too sweet. I used buttermilk in place of plain milk since it needed to be used up and Macintosh apples. The pecans add a nice crunch.
