I made 12 regular sized muffins rather than 6 huge ones. Thanks for posting, Sam. I'm always looking for healthy foods to pack in DD's lunches.
The meat had a good flavor; but it was the first time I have roasted a sirloin tip and it was extremely tough.  The horseradish sauce was amazing.
Fabulous! I don't think I'll ever buy jarred again. I didn't use all red, as I had a yellow pepper that needed some attention. :)

Delicious
I played around with this recipe.  more than I should have.  I added 1 tbsp of baking soda, 1 tsp cinnamon, 1/8 tsp cloves and one more egg.

Oops- been making this soup for awhile now & forgot to review it.. my family despises cabbage, loves kielbasa. I made this & now they think cabbage is delicious! Especially good when you grill the sausage, throw on some hickory chips for smokey flavor. Slurp.

Served this for dessert and it received rave reviews. I also served it in a wine glass with whipped cream.  I used semi sweet chocolate....perfect. Easy to make and soooo delicious.  Will be making this again soon. Thanks CountryLady.

This is a great couscous recipe, it is real quick and easy to make and has a wonderful flavour. My son absolutely loved it and ate a huge plate of it that I never thought he would get through. I served this with Recipe#220465 another of Chef floWer and it was a delicious meal. I will be saving this couscous recipe as it would pair well with a lot of dishes. I will look forward to making again thanks for a real winner!!!

Excellent recipe!  I used regular mayo and homemade breadcrumbs and this was still so much simpler and healthier than frying the eggplant!  I went on to use this in eggplant parmesan but this would also be wonderful on a sandwich!  I've made this three times, but this time I peeled the eggplant and used onion powder instead of minced onion to save time and it was the best yet!  Thanks for a great recipe.

Wonderful, wonderful! The farm was just begging for some comfort today. light, moist, delicious and easy. I used 1 1/2 cups sugar. Next time I want to add some nuts (hazelnuts or almonds).
This was really good! First of all it was the right amount of curry. Secondly, I just loved the colours. It was so nice to enjoy too (I can't forget that!)
This is absolutely the BEST way to make a corned beef.  The brisket turned out so juicy and delicious.  I'm convined, there is not other way to make corned beef!

Yummm, this is different and delicious. What a treat. It was smooth in places and crunchy in other places while being sweetly spiced all at the same time! I wish it was summer and I'd had the melon to put it in. BK this is terrific!

This cake was simple to do and taste great ! I made it last weekend to take to my aunt at the nursing home. She liked it so much that she asked me to rake it to the nurses for the Halloween Holiday. I am not a big drinker so I wasn't sure how I would take to this drink but I wanted to try it. I ended up enjoying it for sure. We really enjoyed this simple and comforting dish! I really liked the dry minced onions cooked in the butter, definitely a first for me! These were great! We had 3 extra kids sleep over last night, which gave me a total of 5 kids and 2 adults to feed for brekkie this morning! I tripled this recipe, and they were a hit! it was very good but a little bland for my tastes

love this !!!!!!!!!!!!

Phenomenal!  Enjoyed exactly as is :)

This Beef Stew was really enjoyed at my difficult household.  It was very easy to make and was very tasty.  I just add about 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce to add a little zety kick to it.

I loved 'em, loved 'em, loved 'em!

Delicious!  So light, yet full of flavor and so easy to prepare! Thanks for sharing this recipe! Made for My 3 Chefs Fall 08'

Sensational! I made this for my brother and sister's joint birthday and the family loved it. I used a chocolate glaze and decorated it with strawberries and blue berries, and served it with a thick quality cream. Very moist, and not overly sweet, or too rich. Will definitely use it again.

This is almost identical to the lasagna recipe that I have been making for years. I hate boiling the noodles first, and this recipe comes through for that need.  I used the stewed tomatoes, but no wine, which I replaced with chicken stock. I must stress that it is VERY IMPORTANT to let this dish stand at LEAST 15 minutes before cutting it. If you don't, you will end up with lasagna soup in the pan. Made and Reviewed for Bevy Tag - Thanks :)

I love egg drop soup and was so excited about this recipe. I used vegetarian chicken broth seasoning and water and didn't have any fresh coriander. Made a great meal with my vegetable fried rice and some potstickers. Yum! Thanks Charlotte! Made for Asian Soup Tag.

These little morsels could be very dangerous ~ so simple to prepare in one pan, chewy, loaded with chocolate and soooo tasty!  I'm insisting on getting a full 48 bars out of this pan so my "bars" are very small, about one bite each and would be very easy to eat one after another ~ I have to keep reminding myself, "Moderation is the key" ; ) I made as directed in a 13x9" pan.  Thanks for a wonderful bar recipe, Sharon!
Very moist.  I omitted the wors. sauce and also followed NC-QT suggestion with the apples/onion.  Thanks for the recipe, this is a keeper!

I am making this one for the second time, I love it, it is fresh, delicious and healthy!
Nice to bring to work for parties!

Marie Conny, Buffalo NY

Probably the best way I've ever had broccoli.  This was super tasty and highly recommended!  I loved the addition of the cashews and I loved the carmelization process.  I doubled the garlic but followed the rest of the recipe as stated.  LOVED it!  Even my picky kids managed to eat some of this.  Wonderful!  Thank you for sharing!
Simple to make , and it tastes just as good reheated. I will always make a double batch of this.

This was so yummy. I did change a few things. I added about 1/2 cup of diced onions, 1/2 tsp of salt. I only had dried chives. I put 3 tsp of dried chives in. I used green split peas (couldn't find yellow). I used homemade chicken stock. That always makes such a difference for me with soups. Also, I'm assuming that the dried tomatoes are sun dried tomatoes. I bought the jared kind and chopped a little bit to make smaller pieces. The key to this is the smoked turkey. I used leftovers from my husbands last hunting trip. The turkey was a Wal-mart purchase... not a result from hunting. Ha! This soup needed to go longer than 7 hours on my crock pot. But, that will vary from crock pot to crock pot. Yum, I'm sitting here eating a tiny bowl waiting for my husband to come home from work so that we can eat it together.
Great simple soup. I used a little anchovy paste (on hand) instead of fish sauce and mint instead of basil. I also added hot sauce at the table instead of the hot pepper flakes.

These are very tasty little appetizers Noo. I have never tried these before.  I enjoyed them very much. I especially liked the taste and texture of the bacon and cherries together. Nice juicy, sweet cherries and salty, crisp, meaty bacon.  Thanks so much for sharing.
Mmmmm these are very good indeed. Try using dates,or dried plums very good also.Thanks for posting.

This is very good and the DH voted to repeat this one!  Frankly, when I put the ingredients into the crock pot in the morning I thought the taste would be boring and run of the mill.  Instead, it was amazingly flavorful.  This recipe half-filled a 4 qt crock pot.  I set the timer for 8 hours then the pot automatically switches to warm.  I had to add more vegetable juice after 6 hrs of cooking and 8 hours was slightly too long for cook time.  Didn't ruin anything tho!

Like everyone else who has tried this recipe, I love these cookies!  For the crust, I used brown sugar splenda and some of Penzey's baking spice and freshly ground nutmeg and it  tasted good even before I baked it.  I'll be using this crust again in other recipes.  I used fat free cream cheese with extra lemon juice and grated rind.  I was a little worried at how thin the batter was.  It was in the oven the initial 15 min, plus about 45 min more to finish baking, but it was well worth the wait.  I topped it with raspberry topping and it went over big with my husband.  From one Bev to another, these are amazing cookies!  Thanks.
This was good.  Easy...
This was a very good dish dish.  The potatoes were nicely roasted, and the rosemary perfectly seasoned the dish.  And it was such an easy dish to prepare.

A very tasty, very chocolate-y, very fudgy brownie.  I didn't have oat bran so whizzed some old-fashioned oats in the blender.  SoupCookie is absolutely correct....this is a very sticky batter but so worth it.  :-)
A unique way of cooking this. I will increase the garlic next time. It was yummy and I will make it again.

We followed the ingredient list, but added some meat to it. We sauteed some sliced artichoke and mozzarella stuffed italian sausage, then added it after the tomato step in the directions. It was absolutely delicious. My two-year-old loved it.
Delicious! We're not even big eggplant fans but this is very, very good.

Oh my! This was so delicious! I made a few really minor changes: I substituted 1-inch lengths of green onions, placed on top of the chicken, for the chopped onion, and instead of using blue cheese dressing to dip the pizza in, I spread some over the crust under the mozzarella. I also sprinkled a little more mozzarella over the top to help it all stick together. Thanks so much for posting, krisdecam! Made for My 3 Chefs November 2008.

I'm glad that I read reviews before trying any recipes.  I'm a fan of KittenCal's and saw that she gave this recipe 5 stars so that prompted me to try it.  I followed the recipe but had to add a bit more flour, it was still a bit too sticky to work with.  Didn't effect the outcome.  They rose just enough and were very flaky.  I do not recommend them as a egg biscuit.  Fell apart too easily.  Toasted them the following day and they were great.  I initially had these with country fried steak & white gravy.  Worked well, though the recipe I had gotten for the gravy was very bland.  Will keep this recipe.  Thanks for posting!!

Growing up, a family friend made this often and I never thought about it until I ran across this recipe. My DH really liked it and it was a very inexpensive and filling meal. I used noodles instead of macaroni and added  a bit of pepper. Thanks for the memories.
Served at my monthly dinner party club last night and these are fantastic.  Thank you so much for posting.

I wish I could give you more than 5 stars for this one!  I absolutely loved it!  The sweet and sour taste this recipe has is so pleasant.  It was a big hit at my party.  I must say thought that my German DH was a bit skeptical about this because of the interesting use of sauerkraut, but this recipe definitely made a believer out of him that sauerkraut has other uses :).  Thank you for this recipe!

This was a wonderful easy chocolate pudding.  I doubled it and used whole milk and Tropical Source semisweet chocolate chips from Whole Foods.  My chips weren't completely melted so my son thought I had small soft lumps!
Thanks for sharing your wonderful recipes with us!

If we can eat tomatoes and basil without mozzarella and not miss it, it's a great recipe! I used dried basil and I'm not sure why because I have a garden full of fresh basil...I just spaced on that one I guess. I added a dash of balsamic vinegar and let these sit for about 7 hours so I had plenty of juice...even soaked it up with a baguette.
this is a very good homemade mayo one of the best I have found on this site or others thank you for posting will make this again very easy to put together
Made as directed but the nutmeg overpowered the small amount of potatoes in went into.  Suggest using 1/4 tsp.
Thanks for a nice cooscous side dish. I added a crushed garlic clove at step # 1 and it was the only change I made. The toasted almonds are a must because they gave the dish crunch and texture.

I wanted to love this, but the cake was so dry, even with the mousse, it just crumbled when slicing. (this surprises me with the buttermik as the liquid) I made it exactly as written with no deviations and don't usually have any problems baking, but for some reason this just didn't turn out like I'd hoped.  The batter was extremely thick too and I can't help wonder if there was too much flour.  Not sure what the problem was, but would like to try it again sometime to see if I can get it right.
I miss Vietnamese food so much since I moved to Vermont (not so much with the ethnic variety around here) so this soup really helps me get my fix! Thanks for posting it!

This was a good recipe but I was surprised at how sweet it was. We liked it but I think my family prefers something that tastes more like beef! I might try it again without the brown sugar topper. Thank you!

This was a great, tasty and easy to make bread!  I only used 2 cups of sugar instead of 3--just a preference for less sweet breads.  It baked perfectly in 45 minutes in a convection oven, and was surprisingly light: maybe because of the lower sugar?  Anyway, it was a hit at home and at work.  Thanks again, Kittencal!
As written this recipe is okay; however, when I made this the second time I added a 1/2 tsp of cinnamon into the batter and used 1/3 cup oil instead of butter.  It greatly improved the recipe.

This was a decent cookie but I doubt I'll make it again. The dough seemed way too thick (i could have hand formed the cookies), which made for a dense cake/muffin type of a cookie. It still tasted fine but I just finished making them about 20 minutes ago and they are already starting to dry out a bit and get hard on the sides and bottom. I appreciate that there is no white flour or white sugar but some tweaking of the other ingredients might be in order.

I doubled the recipe - for 3 of us - and panfried the sandwiches in butter, a few minutes on each side. My only additions were some grindings of black pepper and a small sprinkling of fresh basil. Made for a yummy weekend brunch: a great blend of flavours and very easy to assemble. Thanks for sharing, bmcnicol and son! Made for Newest Zaar Tag.

Very good Recipe and I will have it again.
Chef' Bob
This recipe is superb, and my guests are awe-struck by it. However, I cut the 7 cups of sugar to 5, and I would recommend that. Such a splendid blend of flavours!
I added mustard, ketchup and relish to this. Nice comfort!

This was an easy alternative to my dad's favorite German chocolate birthday cake...It was so delicious, and the chocolate chips really add to the frosting!  This was perfect with a scoop of vanilla ice cream:)
Wow..I'm not a huge rib fan, but these were great! They are so simple to make and sooo good! I now keep them in regular rotation. Thanks for the great recipe!
It is a great recipe! Will never make any others! They are soooooooooooooooooooo good! Will make them alot.

This was WONDERFUL! I froze it in individual bowls for lunches. It reheats BEAUTIFULLY! Also, I would have never thought to bake my butternuts (I make butternut pies for Thanksgiving). No more scraped knuckles from trying to peel and boil those blasted things! Thanks for posting!
A delicious  tagine - I made it for 2 servings.  I really liked how the taste came through on this one without any one item overpowering.  Thank you for posting.

I made these for senior canasta night, and they were barely touched. I heard one person say they were too onion-y. The flavors with the raisins, green onions, basil and turkey together did taste odd to me, too. Sorry. I really wanted to like these.

I had NEVER made Chicken & Dumplings and then I tried this recipe. I loved it!! It was almost exactly like my mom makes it. My husband thought that it had too much pepper for his taste but, it hit the spot for me! Thanks, I'll be making it again and again. I have tried to submit photos, hopefully they will help others determine if this is the recipe that they are looking for.

Used the last of my Amarula for this one. *Whew* what a potent drink. I had to pour into a couple of glasses and add some cream. I really enjoyed *These* Thanks for sharing all my favorites in one or shall I say 3 glasses ;) (Made for Bevy Tag 11/08) Cheers ~V

This lasagna is so good.  I made it more healthy by using only 1 egg, low-fat mozzarella cheese.  I used lean ground beef instead of sausages so didn't use olive oil.  I loved the taste of the sauce with the red wine.  Even DH who doesn't like cottage cheese loved it.  DS and my MIL also.  Thanks Appleydapply.  Made for Healthy Choices tag.

I made this yesterday, I thought it was very tasty, my only problem was the juices didn't thicken so it was pretty runny. Next time I will not use all the juice from the canned peaches, I will take out a cup. I only baked it for 30 minutes and the crust was brown.  I will try this recipe again.
---Ann in Seattle

This recipe is excelent for people who love rice. THis is a good way to make rice. I've been looking for a  jollof rice recipe in a long time. The only problem is that I think it should serve about 8-9, not 4. Perhaps this was a mistake?

Wonderful muffins. I used vegetable oil and regular white sugar, and it worked out fine. I didn't have a mini muffin tin, so I ended up with 14 large muffins. I think I would add some walnuts next time to add to the banana flavor. Made and Reviewed for 123 Hit Wonders - Thanks! :)

This was AMAZING!  I served it with roasted garlic mashed potatoes and it was a definite hit.  I forgot to add the chicken broth or wine so my chicken was  a bit dry, but the onions, plantains and potatoes mixed all together were SO good that I didn't even care.

This is my 2nd cherry bar recipe of the day, but the two, both GREAT BARS, are still very different from one another! I always enjoy cherry pie filling (A cherry pie was the first birthday 'cake' I remember having, candles & all!) & THESE BARS ARE VERY TASTY, VERY SATISFYING! Thanks for sharing! [Tagged, made & reviewed as part of my Bars theme in My-3-Chefs]
We loved this dish.  Very easy to make and the amount of black pepper I used really added to the flavor and made it "pop".
There were very tasty muffins! The banana and oat flavors really pulled through and made these very yummy. The muffins are very easy and quick to prepare. Made and reviewed for 123 Hit Wonders.

Ever since I discovered it is much cheaper to make my own spice mixes, and Market Spice in Seattle is a great place to get bulk spices, I have been trying different Garam Masalas.  There are almost as many recipes as there are chefs :)
This one is one of the best I have tried.  It is the first one I have found with nutmeg.  Was great in a lentil dish.  Very nice blend, and mild enough for those who do not like "spicy"!  Will be making this often.  Made for Fall 2008 My-3-Chefs.

It truly doesn't get much better than this.  Simple Chocolate Fudge....everyone's favourite I'm sure.  I used milk chocolate with a pinch of salt, and 1/2 cup walnuts.  Sooooo good.  Thanks for posting.

AMAZING! As a newbie, I love these recipes that are just chicken breasts baking in a simple sauce. The chicken turns out perfectly tender. I made the mistake of making the onion soup mix w/ 3 cups of water, so I tripled the ketchup & brown sugar and had a ton left over. The good news is that I used the sauce two more times for two more excellent meals!

This recipe tastes delicious and is so quick and easy! I needed to make 5 hoagies and was not planning on making enough for leftovers so I decided to use 25 meatballs instead. I cooked 25 frozen italian meatballs in my 2 qt slow cooker for 4 hours on LOW. (I have the 3 in 1 cooker) My LOW setting really cooks on low heat but if you decide to adjust the quantity be careful that your sauce doesn't scorch. I eliminated the onion, used traditional Ragu sauce with my own seasonings added in, and sliced mozzarella cheese to go on top. I used 5 meatballs for each toasted sandwich and sliced the meatballs in half, lining each side to make it easier to eat. Top with some extra sauce and broil to melt the cheese. This made 5 hearty sandwiches. I made this with fresh sub buns from the bakery. A new favorite in our house!

I did as is, without the butter. It was too runny for me. Maybe if I had let it rest for a while after taking it out of the oven? The taste was ok but I wanted a little more oomph. I wish I could have fit it in my pie pan but it was too much so it went in a rectangular casserole dish. I was hoping for a firm pie slice with layers.

What a healthy way to make eggplant- thx for posting! My changes: Had no mayo on hand- used dijonaise instead and added a little bit of olive oil, garlic powder, cayenne pepper, and mild paprika. The tatse was similar to horseradish w/o the kick. (which I liked) The parmesan chz I thought was overkill- a bit on the salty side and you def tasted the parmesan flavor. I will cut back the parm or find an alternate sub next time.  The trick is to cut the eggplant thin- mine were very done and not mushy. I used panko crumbs- turned out VERY crispy!!
Excellent!  So easy and so delicious! It's a keeper. I served it over meatballs. Thank you!!!

Liked it, didn't love it.  The sauce turned into more of a paste, next time I will use less peanut butter, and more soya sauce.  I was a little concerned about only 4 hours cooking on low - my slow cooker's minimum setting for low is 6.5 hours.  I checked it at 4 hours though, and sure enough, it was done.  Pretty tasty, just needs a few tweeks!

This was a very good base recipe and we've eaten it 2 days in a row now, my family loves it!  We used dark chicken meat, skipped the potatoes all together, and were a little more generous with the spices all around.  We didn't have plain paprika, so I used a mild cajun-type season we had on had, which worked wonderfully.  I did add a little mayo and lemon juice to the sauce, just a personal preference.  Served this up on homemade flatbread, YUM!

These plump tasty morsels are wonderful, they were enjoyed by all who tried them. My neighbors couldn't believe I made them. For the filling I followed your directions and used hot italian sausage, italian breadcrumbs, dried spices, bourbon bbq sauce, spicy tomato sauce, sweet onions and baby carrots. I rolled them up like cinnamon rolls. The rolls puffed up beautifully, they were flavorful, crisp, light, tender and crunchy. I loved the flavors and textures in this new family favourite. Thanks so much for sharing.
Very good grilled cheese! Love the kick for a change of pace. Made for the Aussie/New Zealand Recipe Swap #22.
I am so glad I found this.  Really simple and really good.  Due to personal preferences, I only added 2 tbsp. powdered sugar.  I can't wait to put it on my vegan pumpkin pie!

This is a really great cake. I was having a serious chocolate craving the other night and didn't feel like running to the store. This recipe was all ingredients I normally have on hand. I used dark cocoa and added some instant coffee to the boiling water. It was incredibly moist. Even now, two days later.

This was a very quick & easy recipe to prepare!  As a personal preference, I served over rotini rather than rice.  I didn't like it very much at all - the sauce was too sweet.  But, my husband loved it!  So, I gave the 4 star rating as a compromise!
YUM! YUM! YUM! This was definitely a treat.  We drizzled homemade caramel sauce and homemade whipped cream.  Delicious!

This recipe was awesome. One night, I randomly only really had cauliflower, carrots, and half an onion in my fridge and was pondering what to cook. I stumbled upon this recipe and decided to try it. It came out great! I am also lactose intolerant, so I substituted fat-free Lactaid milk in the recipe which worked out great. And with the nutmeg in it, it's great for a cold winter night!
So easy and tasty. Definitely a keeper. Thanks. :P
Very tasty with a nice, creamy texture and a delightful kick.

These are great cookies.  The dough is easy to put together and rolls out like a dream.  I love that you don't have to chill it too.  I mixed the whole thing in my Kitchenaid mixer.  I did not work the last 3/4 cup flour in by hand.  Then I threw it in a ziploc bag and took it to a Girl Scout meeting where the girls rolled it out and made cookies for wounded veterans from Iraq and Afghanistan.  Thanks for such a great recipe.  I'll be using it again I'm sure.

These quick and easy to make zucchini slices were really nice, they made a great side dish.  The parmesan adds a lovely flavor to this vegetable. The zucchini baked up tender, juicy and flavorful. Thanks for sharing  this winner Anna.

Finally found the perfect chocolate cake recipe!. My husband loves dark chocolate and most other recipes just end up too sweet for our taste. I used Hershey's special dark cocoa (dutch processed) and voila! nice texture, rich & delicious cake!. The only thing different that I did is I used orange extract instead of vanilla and added 1 teaspoon of rum & 1/4 cup of roughly chopped 70 % dark chocolate bar into the batter. This is definitely a keeper for years to come... I can't wait to make one for thanksgiving and show it off. 
Thank you so-so much Marg.
This was so easy to make.  My whole family enjoyed it (the kids love the chips).  Thanks for a quick, cheap , and tasty meal ida.

I actually prefered this without the addition of the oil,lemon and sugar.I also didn't think that my children would eat it after I had added the extras (and they are the couscous fans in the house).They didn't seem to mind it,but I think that next time I will omit the oil etc and add a little more curry powder,as I thought that it could do with a little more zip.
Made for 1-2-3 Hit Wonders.

Excellent recipe!! Very quick and easy.  I used leftover chicken.  My only complaint is it was a little salty.  I will try to find a reduced fat/reduced sodium soup.  Other than that this was family friendly - my very picky son loved this.  I had a guest over and she asked for seconds!!!  next time I will try adding vegetables.  Delicious!!!  Thank you for giving me another option for my leftovers!

The only complaint my picky BF had about this sauce is that I didn't make enough! This was delicious. I served it over homemade meatballs and rice and we were literally scraping the bottom of the pan to get the last bits! I didn't have cornstarch on hand but the consistency was still great. I left out the red pepper but I did stir in a tablespoon of chinese chili sauce (we like it spicy) and it was perfect. Thanks!

This was very good and slightly different than the usual "fish" casserole. I like the creole seasoning, gave it a little added punch. Wasn't quite done at 25 minutes, took slightly longer. Would make again.

This was good, but 6 hours on low burnt the edges and we felt like it was too mushy - like it needed something crunchy to be added on-top, something to give it a little more texture.  It's also a bit sweet for us.

5 STARS +++...but...
The recipe needs to be "simplified" for us "Hard-of-Cooking" guys.

It also calls for "1/2 (1 1/4 ounce) package onion soup mix". (aaauuugghh...what does this mean??!!).

Besides the bizarre (to me) instructions, this was INCREDIBLE! My son and his friends are already asking if I can make it again. This goes in my "Hall of Fame" recipe collection! 
I'm a rookie-cook...that's why I complained. I want to send this recipe to my friends back home but those guys will NEVER figure out the amounts.

MY SON AND HIS FRIENDS THOUGHT THIS WAS AWESOME!!

I first tried this at William-Sonoma... I LOVE IT! This Recipe is wonderful.... Just make sure you cut up the rind small enough. I had a friend that made it and they were huge lol. She missed the "small" dice.

I came across this recipe and realized I'd made it a few years ago and didn't post a review, and it is definitely worthy of one!  These were great!  I did bake the wontons in the mini muffin pan for a few minutes before filling.  I liked them crisped up.  Thanks for sharing!

this is FANTASTIC-have done it now 2 yrs,only thing i do different is i rub olive oil on and then coat heavily with kosher salt,salt does not take out juices,but tenderizes it,and everone says it is mild like tuna,i love turkey.
This is by far the best chocolate cake I've ever made.  I used this recipe a few weeks ago for my brother's birthday --everyone loved it-- and am planning on making it again today.

A good, easy, healthy recipe. Thanks!
I used 4-5 cloves of garlic, and would use a small onion next time. Otherwise, perfect.
what a great receipt!! My family loves this and it's so much better for you.

This was a very yummy supper.  I used instant potatoes and gravy out of a jar because I was feeling lazy.  I did cut back on the veggies some...I probably used about 3 cups instead of the 4.  This is something that I will probably make again.  Delish.  The cream cheese and cheddar cheese in the potatoes was a very nice touch.  Thanks for posting!  Made for Football Tag 2008 :)

I can see why this is a favorite of yours.  My only regret with this is that I forgot the crusty bread.  I wished I had that to dunk in the broth.  I scaled back the recipe to serve one, with some leftovers, of course.  I highly recommend this dish to anyone.  Thanks Irishcolleen for posting such a fabulous recipe.

I am so very honored! How on earth did I not see that you had created this delicious soup before now? Once I saw it I had to make it! I am so glad that I did! This was a really easy and yummy creation! Thank you my dear friend! Many many hugs!

This was very good, and super quick, which makes it even more likeable!  I used prepared mashed potatoes from the refrigerated section of the supermarket, and followed the recipe exactly as written.  I will be making this again.  Made for Football Tag 2008.
Rich and delish. Excellent garlic flavor, a real keeper. Made for Nov. Bev. Tag. I used Russets, Yukons were too spendy for me.

A good, easy-to-please dip. I also used a block of cream cheese and added some half-and-half to soften it up. I had some left over and have been using it as a spread on the bread for turkey sandwiches - really works well together.
Oh, what a wonderful recipe!!!  These are cupcakes that you can serve at an adult party and get rave reviews.  I highly recommend using the coconut milk. Thx. for sharing this great recipe.

Absolutely delicious!! I've tried many banana muffin recipes and this proved to be the best yet. The muffins were large, fluffy and very moist as stated.  I substituted the pecans for chocolate chips and doubled the recipe. It worked perfectly, not too sweet, not dry or flavorless. Thanks for a great recipe, I will definitely use it again!!!

WOW!! I am jus learning to cook and bake, im only 20 after all! But this is my first perfect cake!! THANKS A MILLION! Its the perfect recipe.
Iam soooo on top of the world! Everyone loved it and its definately a keeper :) thanks!
we really didn't like the taste of this. It was a little to bitter and we didn't think it tasted anything like the restrants.
Excellent with the added sugar as suggested by some!   Easy to make and more economical than store bought.  Thanks!

This is the tastiest cake!  I have made this with various combinations of fruit - both fresh and dried combined and it has been delicious each time.  I have even replaced my family recipe for Christmas Cake with this one!  I don't soak the cake in brandy after it is baked, but I do boil a 1/2 cup brandy with the fruit and coffee.  Thanks for a wonderful keeper recipe!

What a great grilled sandwich. We loved it. I used challah bread, old cheddar, sweet tomato and leftover roasted turkey. It was so good. The textures and flavor made for one delicious sandwich. I can't wait to make this treat again. Thanks so much for sharing.

These are perfect. They taste just like they do when you go to a restaraunt and order honey carrots. I have made them a bunch of times already and they have become the only sugared carrot recipe I will use. Thanks for posting!!

Wow, if I would have known that making pudding was this easy, I would have been making it for years now instead of using boxed!  I used semi sweet chocolate, but I think next time I will use dark bittersweet as it was a tad bit too sweet, but then again can anything really be too sweet?....I will definately be making this over and over!  Thanks so much CountryLady!

Delicious! a garlic lovers pasta dish!
I didnt have any parsley so i just went without. still great! very easy as well.

Outstanding soup! I made 1/2 recipe for my husband and I and it turned out great.  Since I used the hot Italian sausage, I didn't add the pepper flakes for extra spice. Just a dash of salt and pepper were the only other spices I used. 
This is a meal in itself along with garlic bread! There is enough left over for 1 more bowl...only problem is who will get it !
Thanks for a super soup!

Excellent!Excellent!I love these!I just finished making a batch.I found the dough came together very easily with 6 cups of icing sugar.It was easy to work with when I was rolling it out also.I used the top of a shot glass to form circles.I then put them in the freezer to dry.I took out 8 at a time for dipping..That way they would not all get too soft to dip.I didn't use shortening,just chocolate is fine.I used semi-sweet chocolate for dipping,it was perfect.These are going to be perfect Christmas gifts.

My husband loved it, and I thought it was pretty good too. I did add salt, and I used a little less lime than was called for. If you do a half teaspoon per side as instructed, you end up with quite a bit of extra spice mixture for next time.

Wonderful recipe!  Very easy to make.  I used applesauce instead of vegetable oil and made both mini cupcakes and a round cake.

Thankyou so much for the recipe!

I'm a huge Hannah Swensen fan, and I was so excited to make these cookies. Unfortunately, they were just OK for me. They spread way too much and I just hate that. The flavors were great, though. Probably won't try this again, but it was a fun experiment.

This is yummy, inexpensive and easy vegetable soup!  I used fat free half and half in place of milk to get a richer flavor without tons of fat.  The only thing I added was a little minced garlic.  It makes for a nice warm lunch.  Thanx!

This was so super easy and quick to make! And restaurant worthy to say the least.  I would definitely serve it to company with a side of risotto.  I used real Reggiano parmesan with Basa fillets. The DH took one bite and asked me to make it again soon.  Thanks for a keeper!
This was very delicious and easy to make. The cloves make it a great Fall dish.
I tried this tonight and my family thought it was yummy! My husband loves garlic and he was pleased.  I didn't use fresh parmesan chees, but it was still good.  Great Recipe!
Easy to make and yummy! I made a little adjustment though, i made only 1/4 cup of brown sugar and 1/3 cup of sugar. But, still it's delicious! Thanks a lot Bev.

I really loved this recipe. I've never added cheese to the breading before. My roommate was head over heels for this recipe when I made it. I added steamed broccoli to the chicken. And I agree about the lemon. Thank You for sharing this recipe.

Made as a *pressie* for the Dec Aussie/NZ Recipe Swap, this easy-fix & tasty sammie is my idea of comfort food & boy was it ever welcome on this snowy dy in Iceland. This is without a doubt the best s&s sause recipe out there, it is simply delisious and so easy to make. I added some fresh chopped tomato (1/2-3/4 chunks) and 4 drops of red food coloring. MarieAlice, OMG!!! these biscuits are the best.  Light, fluffy, tender,  flavorful and so easy to do.  I didn't knead it at all.  I just pat the dough into 1 inch thick and baked for 20 minutes.  To Die For!!  Thank you for sharing your mom's recipe.

Excellent cake. Whats not to love about spices coffee? when add you add cake to the formula it can't be anything but a winner. It has a rich coffee flavor without being overpowering. I may have upped the cinnamon just a touch (cough, doubled). I used 1/2 regular instant coffee and 1/2 espresso powder. Splenda replaced the sugar with no problem. Thanks BK for another great recipe. Made for Santa's Secret in Photo Tag.
This was great, I added the juice of 1 and a half pink grapefruits, and kept the sugar the same. I also cooked it longer to reduce it more. It was so good the whole family licked their plates clean.

It's amazing just how much flavour this potato has without the addition of butter or sour cream. I've already made this twice and will be making it again. The first time I baked a large potato at 425F for  1 hour and the second time I baked 4 small potatoes for an hour at 350F. Both were done to perfection. Made for Newest Zaar Tag

An excellent no-bake cookie and I like that it isn't overly sweet.  Made a trial batch this morning before adding these to my Christmas cookie tray.  Using a 1 1/2 T cookie scoop the recipe made-as you said it would-15 cookies.  This one's a keeper.  TFS, made for New Zaar Cookbooks.

LOVED IT!  I've made this twice now and it's a wonderful recipe.  Very quick and easy to make with a ton of flavor.  I used regular mayo.  Thank you for posting, please see my rating system as I rate tougher than most.
Yummy. I wouldn't change a thing. Well, ok I did find if you let the salad dressing blend for at least 4 hours - the taste is better.
All i can say is these are nasty.  If this is what white castle serves i am glad i have never been to one.

It was really good.  I didn't have yogurt so omitted it entirely from the recipe. I used 2% shredded cheddar to cut back on calories and fat.   It tasted great!   A great way to use leftover chicken! Thanks!

I made this in Memory of John. No, I didn't know him but I'm sure he was an incredible man. So sorry for Carols loss. Everytime I make this bread I will be thinking of Carol and her family. These came out wonderful!  Very much like rice crispy treats in ingredients and flavor. Thank you for explaining how to turn bread into breadcrumbs - other recipes skip this step and if you are new to cooking, sometimes the basics haven't been learned.  Great recipe.

Well, this is my first time making Split Pea Soup. Not as good as my grandmothers but it's my best! LOL I added 1-1/2 tsp garlic, omitted celery (for lack of having some), 1 cup cooked ham and about two slices cooked chopped bacon. I removed the Bay Leaf about 30 minutes in because Im not a big fan of the flavour. THANKS for the great recipe!

What a lovely soup!  It was spicy, but not hot, flavorful, but no single flavor stood out, simply a beautiful blend.

I didn't have extra strength broth, so I added about 1 Tbsp. demi glace.  I think that may have impacted the flavor somewhat.  However, I could tell that it would have been fine without it.  Otherwise I stuck to the recipe as closely as possible given the vagaries of "small head of cabbage" and "large yellow squash."

Thanks Pot Scrubber for the great recipe and equally charming intro.
I thought this would be good to munch on with crackers while I was watching TV and I was right, it's awesome!  Thanks for your creation Lennie!
A lot of different flavors in this cookie. I omitted the glaze as it would have ben too much and I used all semi-sweet choc. chips.

Honestly, this wasn't my favorite, but my guests just raved about it and my kids love it. It made the house smell fantastic in preparation for my holiday party. I did put it in the crock pot rather than doing it in the oven and they turned out wonderful.
Amazingly delicious and neither I nor any of my guests are even diabetic. This was fantastic and full of flavor and interesting texture. Thanks for the recipe.
We've been making this for almost 25 years now.  It is my brother's favorite Christmas cookie.  They are a fun addition to a Christmas cookie tray!

This was a *huge* hit at our house. So easy, so yummy. We like the meat fairly rare, and this was, but I'd add another minute or two to each side for those who prefer meat less rare. Next time, I will definitely add mushrooms to the gravy. Since I was inspired by the Rachel Ray show but wanted a different gravy, I did as she did with a side of roasted broccoli (cut in long spears with salt, pepper, pieces of crushed garlic and drizzled with olive oil in oven at 425 degrees for 15 minutes). Plus baked potatoes. Perfection! Thank you so much for sharing this recipe!

This was a good basic rib recipe. It was easy and delicious. I cooked the ribs in the Dr. Pepper about 1 hour and 20 min before I grilled them with Sweet Baby Ray's bbq sauce. The meat was tender and not dry. Thank you for posting it.

These cookies are incredibly easy and really good. If you need a quick cookie to bring to a party or to serve up to your guests, look no further. If you don't feel like buying raspberry chips, just double the chocolate chip amount. My one complaint is that the raspberry flavor did not come through as much as I would have liked, but I did not use the raspberry chips, so that's probably why. Great recipe, especially for beginner bakers!
These were good, but not what I was expecting.  Basically just tasted like butterscotch chips with marshmallows.  Very easy though.    I didn't like this enough to make it again.

These are delicious and easy roll out cookies. I did add a teaspoon of almond extract as well as the vanilla.

I live in Florida, and I did have to chill the dough before rolling it out, but my comfort level in rolling isn't up there yet!

I've graduated this from 3 to 4 stars (mostly because the garlic made this work) but even though we adore shrimp we weren't raving about it. Loved it.  I used splenda but other than that made as directed.  Thanks diner.  Made for Zarr Stars
These turned out great. I used peppermint oil (3/4 teaspoon) instead of the extract. I also did not let dry before dipping. They were fine.

This is a great oatmeal dish and I am not crazy about oatmeal.  Went back for seconds.  I checked out penzey's spices online and ordered from them.  Fantastic selection and quality of spices.  Great dish and great spices!

I assembled mine on French bread toast and garnished with the bacon.  I will be trying this with Monterey Jack and a bit of finely minced onion too.  This has lots of options and I like for that.  Made for New Kids on the Block, a tag game.

I am allergic to Dairy and this recipe was easy to use and substitute with Non-Dairy products.  Even with Soy Milk and Vegetable Oil Margarine, this Cake was delicious and got rave reviews.  I used a bundt pan to cook and had a seperate dish for extra batter.  Thanks for this recipe.

What a lovely simple recipe this is!  I used half a banana and a splash of original soymilk ... I added a few ice cubes and some water to it, so maybe that's why it wasn't as thick as it could have been.  But it had a lovely cinnamon-banana flavor -- I added about half a teaspoon of vanilla extract and maybe a quarter teaspoon cinnamon.  Thanks for posting!
My mother and I have made these every Christmas since before I can remember.  Now I make them with my children.  They are an easy kid friendly recipe and they never fail to impress.
I've made these on three different occasions and every time they've turned out well.  They taste kind of like junior mints and they always get eaten quick.

I absolutely cannot understand why I am the first person to try this! It is wonderful! I feel like I prepared a dish in a fancy restaurant. It's easy, delicious, and impressive. I didn't change a thing. But DON'T leave out the saffron threads,. It will not be the same if you do. A classy dish! thanks for something simple and delicious to try.
I just tried this recipe.  The brownies have the consistency of pancakes.  Tastes of the cocoa but not chewy.  I will try the other recipe on this web site.
This was hands down the favorite of the new treats I made this year for Christmas! So easy to make and simply fantastic!These are a must to be made again. Thanks for sharing.

This quesadilla is simple to prepare and very tasty! You can't go wrong with melted cheese and diced green chiles. Yum! Served with leftover Recipe#75677, pinto beans, diced green onions, cilantro, avocado, and salsa. Thanks!
VERY GOOD!  I love that it is creamy and EASY!!!  THANKS
Perfect stress-free dessert for my work potluck.  Felt like I didn't put in too much effort for my coworkers to gobble up the small squares of cheesecakey goodness.  Will make again.
Most Excellent,  Thanks for sharing.
Made this at Thanksgiving and it was requested again for Christmas.  This time I am cutting down on the cinnamon a little.  I also added the zest of one of the oranges. We really love it.

Gosh, what nice icing.  I was also a bit skeptical in the beginning because of the runny mixture, but it poofed up beautifully after several minutes.  I substituted a bit of lemon juice for some of the water and it was a nice, subtle sweet-tart taste.  It went perfectly on the Recipe #78700 I made for tonight's Christmas party.  Thanks for a goody.

This is the best cake ever! I am a ten year old who hates milk chocolate and loves dark chocolate! I made this for Christmas Eve and asked my family to rate it from one to five and it was unanimous that this was the best cake we ever had. Even my brother, who is a very picky eater and the world's biggest food critic said he would eat the whole thing if he could. My compliments to the creator of this recipe. Thanks for the best cake recipe ever! :o)
Awesome sandwich!  I served with tomato soup for a delicious and satisfying lunch.  I will most definitely be making these again.  Thanks for posting!

Oooh, la la!  These were my favorite part of Christmas dinner I prepared in advance and served at my MIL's, and I was not allowed to take any leftovers home with me.  Everyone had seconds.  The peaches complemented the sweet potatoes well, and the cranberries in the streusel added great zing!  This crowd expects me to make this for Christmas from now on.  This filled a 1 3/4-quart casserole dish.  Thanks for posting, Sydney Mike!   Made for Please Review My Recipe.

Take the plunge and try this method!!  I cannot believe it but this turkey was juicier and more flavorful than the brined turkeys I've been doing for years and sooooo much easier.  I did use "uncle bill's" method of shrinking the skin around the bird with boiling water (cool looking even if it doesn't add anything :0) ).  I rubbed the turkey with herbs, pepper, butter and oil mixed together.  So simple and quick!  Thank you very much for posting!
This was very good!  It was so easy to put together, and was a hit with the whole family.  It was very sweet, and the flavor from the bacon really made it rich-tasting.  Thanks Lainey!
Got good reviews from my guests on Christmas.  I never got to try one though, so will have to make another batch!!!

Big hit with my guests!  I did wind up with an extra twelve - but that's better than ok!  I followed the suggestions and pre-baked the won tons and also sprayed them with non-stick spray - inside the cup and the unfilled won ton.  I made them up early in the day and then finished them in the oven when my guests arrived.  Also, I just put the ground beef and cheese and baked them - people topped them with salsa as they ate them.

Tasty, yummy! A different take on sweet and sour from the Chinese version I'm used to. I used boneless chicken breast instead but nevertheless, I love it and the sauce when baked became thick.  Served with white rice and oh boy, my craving for sweet and sour's satisfied. Thanks for sharing, Lavender Lynn! Made as a pressie for Aus Recipe Swap#23

Excellent, excellent cake. Moist, tender, not crumbly. I am doing this for a wedding cake in January. The first time I made it, it fell, but I think that I just opened the door too soon. Just don't touch it until you reeeally think that it's done, then check it. This fit two 8x2 round pans just perfectly. Yields 4 and 3/4 Cups of batter, but that's deceiving. The 8x2 pans should take 3.5 cups to fill them once baked, but this recipe rises a lot, and split between those two pans it fits them exactly. 

To determine how much batter you need for specific pans, you should use 79% of the ammount the pan usually takes.

I made this today to use in a stir fry to use up some left over turkey. My family found it to be too sweet and my kids didn't really like it. However, I will be making this again, but with less sugar.Thank you for posting.  Made for I recommend tag.
This was easy to make and great tasting!  I used cherry preserves instead of red raspbery because they were on sale and I didn't want to deal with the seeds.  It taste like a wonderful cherry crisp.

I made these this year for Christmas cookie trays and will make them again. I crushed the Oreos in the food processor and that worked out well although I had to crush a few more to cover all the balls.
I didn't dip them in chocolate although I believe that would have taken them to even a higher level.
They mellowed in the refrigerator overnight and the Kahlua flavor came through more, I think.

I served this for Christmas dinner and it was a hit! I had a 3 pound sirloin tip roast, cooked it to 140 degrees and it was perfect! The sauce is delicious. I realized I was out of thyme and had to substitute steak seasoning, used 2 cloves of garlic and added some dried rosemary that I chopped up, it was wonderful and everyone requested it for next Christmas.
really good
This is an excellent gravy for cornbread dressing. Simple, fast and the subtle flavor needed for the star. This has become a holiday staple for all those reasons.
Outstanding! Crispy delicious duck with such a simple preparation. This is the easiest most elegant duck recipe I've come across. Thank you for a lovely recipe I will make again & again.

I am giving this 5 stars for the concept and the taste.  I did these for a fun diner tonight but did 'play' with them a bit.   I only had half the meat I needed and I didn't have any salsa in the house.  So, I chopped up half an onion and half a red pepper and did them in with the beef and taco mixture.  I did pre-bake the wontons for a couple minutes and then to stretch out the beef mixture and to give me peace of mind that the mixture wouldn't make the base too soggy I spooned a bit of re-fried beans straight from the can into the bottom of the cups.  I them put the beef on top of that and then the cheese.  That worked out great and the bottoms didn't feel soggy at all.

Tasty & easy! To make it easier, I used the prepackaged cole slaw mix (it was on sale this week) instead of a chopping a head of cabbage. I also added a tsp of Kosher salt, personal preference, and used at least 2 cups of cooked rice. Yum! Perfect! I love it.

Having Celiac Disease, I made these gluten free. I used a gluten-free flour mix in place of the all purpose flour and added a little bit of xanthan gum. Besides that, I followed the directions exactly. Pretty tasty, but did not get fluffy like regular pancakes (not that I was expecting it to). Will make again.

Good, easy, homemade chocolate cake! I am glad I read reviews that mentioned the thinness of the batter, because  I was doubtful about whether or not it would bake properly, and may have added some flour to thicken the consistency. I was pleased with the taste of the cake, although the cake cracked on the top when I baked it - maybe it was my technique?
Not bad, but the glaze turned to "taffy" quite quickly after adding to carrots. I'm not sure why because I followed the directions, note for note.
This was wonderful! So refreshing and full of flavor. Thanks for sharing.

Although this tasted wonderful, I didn't take a picture because it didn't look very nice. Gently folding the egg whites back in made it "lumpy looking" and I was afraid to cream it because I didn't want to loose the lift. It did taste wonderful though!  Made for Chef's Alphabet Soup Game
This is wonderful. Who knew making your own pancake syrup could be so easy! I halved this recipe because I don't usually can. This is so good and simple. Thanks for sharing!

i tried this recipe and i was really happy with the results.. but i did make a few changes  to it however. i added a 1/3 cup of oats 2 my flour mixture and i did not bake them but popped them straight into the fridge overnight. they were all gone the next day! GREAT RECIPE!!

I just made this for Christmas breakfast/brunch. It was pretty easy with the Pillsbury cresent sheets that they're selling now. In the future, I may try making the filling ahead to cut down on prep time in the morning. Overall, a satisfying breakfast!

Oh how yummy!  I forgot the tabasco and had to use dried parsley and was generous with the green onions!  I used extra sharp cheddar and minced garlic that comes in the big jar.  I split this into 2 cheese balls. One I topped with leftover bacon and the other I rolled in chopped walnuts.  They were both awesome and my guests loved it.  It is even better after the 2nd day.  Thanks for another great one Kitten!
These were amazing!  I halved the recipe, added 1/4 tsp vanilla extract, 1/4 tsp water, and made one big delicious pancake!

What a great icing!!! This is THE royal icing to use for any of your decorating needs! It works perfectly. If you don't want to bite into an overly sweet cookie, just don't use too much or too thick of a layer of this icing to decorate your cookies.

I've made this chili many times. I first learned of it on allrecipes.com. If you visit the recipe on that site, you'll see how many people really enjoy this chili. It's my go-to recipe for chili!! So good.

This recipe is a sure thing! It is deceivingly elegant, and no one who has found out my secret believes how easy it is! I took it to a dinner party last week, and someone asked, "so tell me...first do you slice the cake layers and then what?" I don't know if it's better before you know it is just ice cream sandwiches and cool whip, or after!

A tasty variation on Shepherd's Pie! I doubled the spices (not the sugar) because I thought it was too bland. I also added 1/2 teaspoon of smoked paprika to the spice mixture for a nice balance. This one is a keeper!

It was very good. I had to make a few changes to go along with what ingredients I had on hand. I didn't have any real onion, so I used 4 tbsp of dried and added about a tbsp of olive oil and heated them through. I was surprised I hardly noticed the difference, plus the onion was cut very small and not chewy in the dish. It went very will with our "Smooch's Light Tilapia" recipe #324981. The tastes blended well together, only thing I'd add to the second would be some lemon juice.

These were a huge hit for Holiday dessert. the kids and adults went mad for them. I did not add the pecans, but used a mix of milk and white chocolate chips. The sugar was the perfect proportion; the end result was not too sweet. This are a keeper. I will def make them again!
These turned out really well (my husband coaches a kid's hockey team and we brought these for a Christmas party).  Mine didn't turn out as cute as yours, but they were certainly a hit with the kids!

I have never made anything quite like this before but it is really fabulous.  The whole family ate it up.  Made as directed except cut down on the olive oil and eliminated the butter altogether to cut down on fat and I decided to use a balsamic vinegar instead of wine vinegar on a whim. Thanks so much for posting!

These little cookies are so delectable!  They are much easier to make than it may appear -- the process is really very simple and quick.  The result is a very gourmet-looking cookie.  You can add just a pinch of cinnamon or ginger (or mint/fruit extracts) to the dough and can top with crystalized ginger, melted chocolates (I like to dip in white chocolate melted with a little lemon or orange extract, then sprinkle with a few more ground pecans).  Delicious as is, but you can really make it your own, too!  Thanks for sharing, Steve!  I had misplaced my recipe (think I got it from the back of a Karo label long ago) and was so happy to find it posted here! :)
OMGosh I just made this and it tasted great.  I only had 1 cup sour cream but it came out good because I used 1 cup cream and 1/2 cup milk.  This is a keeper, thanks!

I'm giving this 5 stars for 2 reasons.  First, risotto doesn't get any easier than this.  Super easy dish to make while doing other cooking.  2nd is the taste.  It is tangy and cheesy.  The combination of tomatoes with the cheese makes it.  Next time, I'll be adding in the garlic!  Thanks for posting!

Wow! This is great. I've never had Greek yogurt b4 and the instructions were super easy. I think toasting the walnuts in the oven would be easier, but I can never remember how to do it! This is a great easy recipe. I added sliced almonds as my nut it is amazing. Thanks.

Recipes passed down are the GREATEST gift !! This one is a treasure !! We loved the sweet, buttery, popcorn and will make again and again !

This is one of those "if I can do it, anybody can do it" recipes. I'm the world's worst bread baker, but I managed to turn out just about perfect focaccia with this recipe.  These are TDF. I added some chopped pecans, otherwise followed to a "T". This will be a repeat muffin recipe for sure!

Not the best playdough recipe I've used, but alright. It turned out gritty and dry - not sure why? But good enough to play with!

Delicious! I love the simplicity of this recipe. I didn't have orange juice, so I substituted peach/mango juice with a splash of lemon juice. Turned out great!

These onions were really good!  I enjoyed them with black beans and rice.  I used extra virgin oil and redwine vinegar beause that is what I had on hand.  I'm sure these onions would be delicious on a sandwich as well.  Thanks!
Awesome awesome recipe. Turned out beautifully for me. I also added a cup of chocolate chips in the batter. This is my go to recipe now for chocolate cake.

Thanks for a great quick fix.

We love this recipe though I didn't give it five stars because it did get "improved" by us.  If you add a bit of Sherry, it really improves the dish dramatically. My husband ate 5 of these before I could put away two for my lunch the next day!  Next time I'll add a bit of onion to the mix but this receipe was wonderful and incredibly easy to make.  I was thinking of trying Turkey breast with low fat turkey chili and low fat cheese. Served it with a salad and was a wonderful meal.

I can't remember if I've reviewed this before, but I am here making this cake again and thought I would share my thoughts.  I LOVE this recipe! This was my mothers favorite although left out the clove an chili powder. She instead added a can of corn and topped it off with croutons sauted in butter which got nice and crunchy on top. I made this as a casserole by chopping in my peppers.

This was quite the adventure for me...first time ever making caramel sauce.It took a good 15 minutes to get the sugar and water to turn to caramel but it was worth all the fretting I did. I debated whether to give this recipe a 5 or a 4.  It tasted great!  The two reasons why I considered giving it a lower rating was because the baking time was really off.  I had a package of 5 boneless, skinless chicken breasts that I had gotten from Angel Food which was already marinated with lemon and herbs.  The 5th breast was at least 1/2 the size of the other 4.  I followed the directions exactly except that I didn't use the lemon pepper since the meat was already marinated with it.  I expected the meat to be quite sweet with all that honey in it.  It wasn't at all.  In fact the honey taste was VERY slight.  At the end of an hour two of the breasts which were in the middle of the baking dish were still raw.  (visibly from the top in fact.)  I baked it another 45 minutes.  Possibly because I had to bake it for so long I only had about 3/4 cup of juices to which I added about another 1/2 cup of water so that I would have more sauce.  Since the meat was so white with no browning coloring, I added a couple of drops of yellow food coloring to my sauce so that it would look more appetizing.  It was loved by all of us.  It was really tasty.  I will make this again but will increase the temperature to 375 so that they will cook quicker than 1 3/4 hours.  I think the addition of some paprika on the top of the meat before cooking would also enhance the color.  But make no mistake!!!  This is a wonderful dish and amazingly easy to make.  I will be making it again.  Because it is sooo good and easy to make I decided to give it a '5'.   (by the way in case someone wants to know, even with the long baking time, the breasts were still nice and moist and not dried out.)  BTW in case anyone should think my oven was at fault, it is a new stove and the oven is extremely accurate.  Thanks Kaylin for sharing this new addition to my list of regular cooked meals.

Uncle Bill, In a word...Fantastic! Thanks so much for sharing this delicious recipe. We were given a bushel of locally grown oranges for Christmas and needed to do something with them in January. Thanks for the recipe though!

This is probably the best tasting chocolate cake I have ever had, I am only giving it four stars though because I have noticed it is kind of a touchy recipe. I have probably made this cake about eight times, and only once has it turned out perfect. Most of the time it falls, or sticks to the pan pretty badly (but it's more my fault that it sticks!). I live in Salt Lake City at about 4,000 ft., but can normally get away without doing the high altitude adjustments. I'm not sure if my problems have been from that or not. I finally found that 2/3 cup water and an extra half cup of flour work perfectly for my elevation and oven. I have tried using cake flour in this recipe (I do for most cake recipes), but this one really doesn't need it. The cake is already really soft, if that makes sense. It really tastes fabulous and chocolately, though. It is really moist and fudgy too. Thanks so much for posting, it was well worth the work trying to figure out the conversions! Oh, just one more thing I noticed about it sticking- I can normally just spray my cake pans with non stick spray, but this cake always sticks when I do that even though I have pretty good pans. If I grease with crisco and flour them, they come out much better. Just thought I would point that out- Thanks again!

5 stars with the lemon juice added just before serving. Do not leave it out it adds a nice freshness. I substituted a lot in this because I was using what I had on hand. Soup just doesn't get simpler!  Why open a tin of soup again, this is so easy, with just a little prep.  To be perfectly honest I didn't expect this to be as good as it is, because the ingredients are so simple.  But I love it! Very tasty and very easy. My DH and his friends loved it. I will definitely be making this again. Thanks for posting. Made for Alphabet Soup Tag.
These turned out okay but none of us were crazy about them.  hey seemed pretty bland somehow and even my kids weren't crazy about it.  Thanks for the novel idea, though!

My favorite kind of recipe: I can make many variations. I am going to try this next time with pineapple preserves and cinnamon, and the meat can be cubed and kabobbed. Thanks for a wonderful recipe Kitcharen. Made and enjoyed for PAC Spring '09.

This is such a great recipe!  I used the supermarket roasted chicken and it only took me a couple minutes to prepare.  The only problem I had was with the fat content.  The biscuits I used were 9 grams of fat EACH.  Next time I'll shop around for a low fat variety.
Wonderful sauce for a ham.  I used this at this years Easter and the smell was to die for in the kitchen!  All the flavors really did absorb into our ham and it was super moist and flavorful!

I used this recipe to make my first ever ham-from-scratch. I usually get a spiral cut/glazed ham. I found out the hard way that I should have bought a fully cooked ham. I did not... This is by far the best biscuits I have ever made.    They are light and fluffy.  Thanks so muchg for the recipe.

I've never eaten black bean burgers before and these were a great first try! I use an Uncle Ben's brown rice and vegetable medley pouch for the rice, and I added extra cumin and chili powder. I was trying these out on my husband as part of a meatless meal but he thought they didn't have enough flavor for his taste, but he says that about nearly everything, lol!
Enjoyed this very much!
We really loved this one!  This Asian inspired recipe was a great find for my family, as we love dishes like this!
Everyone dipped into these and they were so good!  I loved the frosting!  These went great with my Halloween theme.  I just added a little orange food coloring to the frosting!
This was a welcome addition to my Halloween table this year.  My guests ate it right up!  So cute as the centerpiece for my table too!

Changes:  We skipped the shallots since we didn't have any, and used extra green beans.  I forgot to double the canned items when I doubled the recipe, but I think the chickpeas were better this way, while the tomatoes would've been better at full proportion.  I missed the sea salt and pepper since the instructions printed onto a second page and I was following that instead of looking at the ingredients list.  Where *do* you add those in, anyway?

Results:  We both thought it was very good.  Scanting the pepper flakes so they didn't overwhelm was a prudent move.  I used the minimum on the vinegar, and that was about right for me after giving it time to "off-gas" since I am pretty sensitive to the smell of vinegar. Quantity: I would guess that doubling the recipe gave the two of us enough for maybe four meals as we don't tend to eat additional sides with pasta dishes.

I love carrots and this one sounded so good I had to try it on my family for Easter.   They loved these and asked that they be added to our menu for every holiday.  Now, that's quite a compliment!  Thank you for sharing Kikimony!  Your carrots made our Easter dinner better than usual!

Thank you, thank you, thank you

Just the right balance of sweet, salt, and vinegar, these rate a "nummy" from this lifelong lover of marinated cukes. Easy to make with clear instructions and simple ingredients.  Made for Pick A Chef, April 09.

Thank you so much!!

This bread gets like 10 stars for flavor but not so much for appearance so it still works out for me as a 5 star...I tagged this playing "I Recommend" and was told by Karen Elizabeth not to expect much of a rise...between that warning and my own knowledge of my abilities {{or rather lack there of ;) }} , I decided to embrace the notion of a flat bread and placed my dough mixture right on a coconut buttered cookie sheet where it didn't rise as much as spread...I got a HUGE lovely loaf with a delicious buttery crunch to it...I sliced it into a gazillion slices and then the appearance didn't matter much (besides at the rate it was being gobbled no-one but me seem to notice that it was so flattish)- we have enjoyed it at every type of meal/snack & at every time of day (breakie, lunch, dinner and after midnite)...super good oven toasted too & if you want a real "slice-o-heaven" smear a little almond butter on it :) :) :)...about the only thing I did different than the stated instructions (besides the cookie sheet) was that I ground some of the oats and sunflower seeds- {{i just like extra textures}}...really a must try for a seed/nut lover- THANKS so much for the recipe share:) YUMMY!!

We have this often in the summer and it always makes such a good side!  We had ours with barbecue chicken and enjoyed it so much!  I used broccoli, grape tomatoes, vadalia onions, carrots, green pepper and black olives.  Deelicious!

Excellent tzatziki recipe. I used dried mint, which was a very nice addition, and just regular cucumbers, since that was the only thing available in my local store. Next time I would like to try it with the dill. Thank you for sharing this recipe.

This was a really delicious way to cook ribs.  I used half Dr. Pepper and half chicken stock; just enough to cover.  Also added onions, carrots and celery and some onion powder and garlic powder. We had macaroni and cheese along with it and all everyone could say was YUM!  Thank you so much for this awesome recipe, for sure I will be making this again and again.

Very quick prep for these TASTY LITTLE TREATS! My first several were included not only the icing given here, but also a small drizzle of homemade caramel sauce ~ VERY, VERY NICE! [Tagged, made & reviewed for one of my adoptees at the tail end of the current Pick A Chef]

On 4/29/09 I was looking for a chicken recipe,and came across this one. Despite the 2 star review, I took a chance with the recipe. great cake!

Fabulous cake.  I saved a bit back and cooked it in a mug in the microwave for a couple of minutes because I couldn't wait!  Absolutely delicious and really rich but not too heavy.  Took 1 hour to cook in a square tin but my oven is a bit erratic!

I have a feeling this really is Grandma's recipe written down for someone who had made the rolls with Grandma. Like a "reminder" recipe. It left out a few things for us that hadn't made these before. It's o.k. because I used the internet and Zaar to reference other cinnamon roll recipes. First, I warmed my water for the yeast to 110 degrees F (just a few seconds in the microwave and then stuck my kitchen thermometer to check the temp). Next, the recipe has baking soda in the ingredient list but does not say where to add it and so I left that out, it was really not needed. Also, it says to add salt in the directions but no salt is in the ingredient list so I found that this amount of flour in other recipes took 1 tsp salt so I added that much. I used King Arthur all-purpose flour, Red Star yeast, and double strength vanilla. For the cinnamon filling, I used the same amounts of cinnamon and butter here but I mixed 1/4 cup brown sugar and 1/4 cup white sugar instead of all brown sugar. Used a serrated knife to cut the rolls and it worked great!! I let these rise for 1 hour and 25 minutes in a warm place and I baked them for 25 minutes. I love the icing with the evaporated milk, so creamy!! I am glad I took the time to make these even with the extra research because the sour cream really makes them moist and gooey!!!! I will definitely make these rolls again!!!! Thanks for posting!!
